lines.text: Cui dono lepidum novum libellum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:1" n="1">Cui dono lepidum novum libellum</l>

lines.text: arido modo pumice expolitum?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:1" n="2">arido modo pumice expolitum?</l>

lines.text: Corneli, tibi; namque tu solebas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:1" n="3">Corneli, tibi; namque tu solebas</l>

lines.text: meas esse aliquid putare nugas,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:1" n="4">meas esse aliquid putare nugas,</l>

lines.text: iam tum cum ausus es unus Italorum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:1" n="5">iam tum cum ausus es unus Italorum</l>

lines.text: omne aevum tribus explicare chartis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:1" n="6">omne aevum tribus explicare chartis,</l>

lines.text: doctis, Iuppiter, et laboriosis!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:1" n="7">doctis, Iuppiter, et laboriosis!</l>

lines.text: quare habe tibi quidquid hoc libelli
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:1" n="8">quare habe tibi quidquid hoc libelli</l>

lines.text: qualecumque, quod, o patrona virgo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:1" n="9">qualecumque, quod, o patrona virgo,</l>

lines.text: plus uno maneat perenne saeclo.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:1" n="10">plus uno maneat perenne saeclo.</l>

lines.text: Passer, deliciae meae puellae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:2" n="1">Passer, deliciae meae puellae,</l>

lines.text: quicum ludere, quem in sinu tenere,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:2" n="2">quicum ludere, quem in sinu tenere,</l>

lines.text: cui primum digitum dare adpetenti
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:2" n="3">cui primum digitum dare adpetenti</l>

lines.text: et acris solet incitare morsus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:2" n="4">et acris solet incitare morsus,</l>

lines.text: cum desiderio meo nitenti
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:2" n="5">cum desiderio meo nitenti</l>

lines.text: carum nescio quid libet iocari
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:2" n="6">carum nescio quid libet iocari</l>

lines.text: (et solaciolum sui doloris,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:2" n="7">(et solaciolum sui doloris,</l>

lines.text: credo, ut tum gravis adquiescat ardor),
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:2" n="8">credo, ut tum gravis adquiescat ardor),</l>

lines.text: tecum ludere sicut ipsa possem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:2" n="9">tecum ludere sicut ipsa possem</l>

lines.text: et tristis animi levare curas!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:2" n="10">et tristis animi levare curas!</l>

<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:2" n="10a"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="2a_0"/><gap reason="lost" rend=" . . . . . . . . "/><note resp="perseus" xml:lang="eng">Lines 10a ff are represented as poem 2a in some editions.</note></l>

lines.text: Tam gratum est mihi quam ferunt puellae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:2" n="11"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="2a_1"/>Tam gratum est mihi quam ferunt puellae</l>

lines.text: pernici aureolum fuisse malum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:2" n="12"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="2a_2"/>pernici aureolum fuisse malum,</l>

lines.text: quod zonam solvit diu ligatam.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:2" n="13"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="2a_3"/>quod zonam solvit diu ligatam.</l>

notes: Lines 10a ff are represented as poem 2a in some editions.

lines.text: Lugete, o Veneres Cupidinesque
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="1">Lugete, o Veneres Cupidinesque</l>

lines.text: et quantum est hominum venustiorum!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="2">et quantum est hominum venustiorum!</l>

lines.text: passer mortuus est meae puellae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="3">passer mortuus est meae puellae,</l>

lines.text: passer, deliciae meae puellae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="4">passer, deliciae meae puellae,</l>

lines.text: quem plus illa oculis suis amabat;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="5">quem plus illa oculis suis amabat;</l>

lines.text: nam mellitus erat, suamque norat
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="6">nam mellitus erat, suamque norat</l>

lines.text: ipsa tam bene quam puella matrem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="7">ipsa tam bene quam puella matrem,</l>

lines.text: nec sese a gremio illius movebat,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="8">nec sese a gremio illius movebat,</l>

lines.text: sed circumsiliens modo huc modo illuc
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="9">sed circumsiliens modo huc modo illuc</l>

lines.text: ad solam dominam usque pipiabat.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="10">ad solam dominam usque pipiabat.</l>

lines.text: qui nunc it per iter tenebricosum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="11">qui nunc it per iter tenebricosum</l>

lines.text: illuc unde negant redire quemquam.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="12">illuc unde negant redire quemquam.</l>

lines.text: at vobis male sit, malae tenebrae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="13">at vobis male sit, malae tenebrae</l>

lines.text: Orci, quae omnia bella devoratis;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="14">Orci, quae omnia bella devoratis;</l>

lines.text: tam bellum mihi passerem abstulistis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="15">tam bellum mihi passerem abstulistis.</l>

lines.text: o factum male! o miselle passer!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="16">o factum male! o miselle passer!</l>

lines.text: tua nunc opera meae puellae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="17">tua nunc opera meae puellae</l>

lines.text: flendo turgiduli rubent ocelli.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:3" n="18">flendo turgiduli rubent ocelli.</l>

lines.text: Phasellus ille, quem videtis, hospites,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="1">Phasellus ille, quem videtis, hospites,</l>

lines.text: ait fuisse navium celerrimus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="2">ait fuisse navium celerrimus,</l>

lines.text: neque ullius natantis impetum trabis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="3">neque ullius natantis impetum trabis</l>

lines.text: nequisse praeterire, sive palmulis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="4">nequisse praeterire, sive palmulis</l>

lines.text: opus foret volare sive linteo.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="5">opus foret volare sive linteo.</l>

lines.text: et hoc negat minacis Hadriatici
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="6">et hoc negat minacis Hadriatici</l>

lines.text: negare litus insulasve Cycladas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="7">negare litus insulasve Cycladas</l>

lines.text: Rhodumque nobilem horridamque Thraciam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="8">Rhodumque nobilem horridamque Thraciam</l>

lines.text: Propontida trucemve Ponticum sinum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="9">Propontida trucemve Ponticum sinum,</l>

lines.text: ubi iste post phasellus antea fuit
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="10">ubi iste post phasellus antea fuit</l>

lines.text: comata silva: nam Cytorio in iugo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="11">comata silva: nam Cytorio in iugo</l>

lines.text: loquente saepe sibilum edidit coma.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="12">loquente saepe sibilum edidit coma.</l>

lines.text: Amastri Pontica et Cytore buxifer,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="13">Amastri Pontica et Cytore buxifer,</l>

lines.text: tibi haec fuisse et esse cognitissima
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="14">tibi haec fuisse et esse cognitissima</l>

lines.text: ait phasellus; ultima ex origine
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="15">ait phasellus; ultima ex origine</l>

lines.text: tuo stetisse dicit in cacumine,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="16">tuo stetisse dicit in cacumine,</l>

lines.text: tuo imbuisse palmulas in aequore,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="17">tuo imbuisse palmulas in aequore,</l>

lines.text: et inde tot per impotentia freta
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="18">et inde tot per impotentia freta</l>

lines.text: erum tulisse, laeva sive dextera
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="19">erum tulisse, laeva sive dextera</l>

lines.text: vocaret aura, sive utrumque Iuppiter
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="20">vocaret aura, sive utrumque Iuppiter</l>

lines.text: simul secundus incidisset in pedem;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="21">simul secundus incidisset in pedem;</l>

lines.text: neque ulla vota litoralibus diis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="22">neque ulla vota litoralibus diis</l>

lines.text: sibi esse facta, cum veniret a mari
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="23">sibi esse facta, cum veniret a mari</l>

lines.text: novissimo hunc ad usque limpidum lacum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="24">novissimo hunc ad usque limpidum lacum.</l>

lines.text: sed haec prius fuere: nunc recondita
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="25">sed haec prius fuere: nunc recondita</l>

lines.text: senet quiete seque dedicat tibi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="26">senet quiete seque dedicat tibi,</l>

lines.text: gemelle Castor et gemelle Castoris.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:4" n="27">gemelle Castor et gemelle Castoris.</l>

lines.text: Vivamus, mea Lesbia, atque amemus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:5" n="1">Vivamus, mea Lesbia, atque amemus,</l>

lines.text: rumoresque senum severiorum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:5" n="2">rumoresque senum severiorum</l>

lines.text: omnes unius aestimemus assis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:5" n="3">omnes unius aestimemus assis.</l>

lines.text: soles occidere et redire possunt:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:5" n="4">soles occidere et redire possunt:</l>

lines.text: nobis, cum semel occidit brevis lux,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:5" n="5">nobis, cum semel occidit brevis lux,</l>

lines.text: nox est perpetua una dormienda.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:5" n="6">nox est perpetua una dormienda.</l>

lines.text: da mi basia mille, deinde centum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:5" n="7">da mi basia mille, deinde centum,</l>

lines.text: dein mille altera, dein secunda centum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:5" n="8">dein mille altera, dein secunda centum,</l>

lines.text: deinde usque altera mille, deinde centum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:5" n="9">deinde usque altera mille, deinde centum,</l>

lines.text: dein, cum milia multa fecerimus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:5" n="10">dein, cum milia multa fecerimus,</l>

lines.text: conturbabimus illa, ne sciamus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:5" n="11">conturbabimus illa, ne sciamus,</l>

lines.text: aut ne quis malus invidere possit,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:5" n="12">aut ne quis malus invidere possit,</l>

lines.text: cum tantum sciat esse basiorum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:5" n="13">cum tantum sciat esse basiorum.</l>

lines.text: Flavi, delicias tuas Catullo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:6" n="1">Flavi, delicias tuas Catullo,</l>

lines.text: ni sint inlepidae atque inelegantes,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:6" n="2">ni sint inlepidae atque inelegantes,</l>

lines.text: velles dicere, nec tacere posses.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:6" n="3">velles dicere, nec tacere posses.</l>

lines.text: verum nescio quid febriculosi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:6" n="4">verum nescio quid febriculosi</l>

lines.text: scorti diligis: hoc pudet fateri.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:6" n="5">scorti diligis: hoc pudet fateri.</l>

lines.text: nam te non viduas iacere noctes
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:6" n="6">nam te non viduas iacere noctes</l>

lines.text: nequiquam tacitum cubile clamat
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:6" n="7">nequiquam tacitum cubile clamat</l>

lines.text: sertis ac Syrio fragrans olivo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:6" n="8">sertis ac Syrio fragrans olivo,</l>

lines.text: pulvinusque peraeque et hic et ille
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:6" n="9">pulvinusque peraeque et hic et ille</l>

lines.text: attritus, tremulique quassa lecti
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:6" n="10">attritus, tremulique quassa lecti</l>

lines.text: argutatio inambulatioque.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:6" n="11">argutatio inambulatioque.</l>

lines.text: nam nil stupra valet, nihil, tacere.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:6" n="12">nam nil stupra valet, nihil, tacere.</l>

lines.text: cur? non tam latera ecfututa pandas,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:6" n="13">cur? non tam latera ecfututa pandas,</l>

lines.text: ni tu quid facias ineptiarum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:6" n="14">ni tu quid facias ineptiarum.</l>

lines.text: quare, quidquid habes boni malique,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:6" n="15">quare, quidquid habes boni malique,</l>

lines.text: dic nobis: volo te ac tuos amores
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:6" n="16">dic nobis: volo te ac tuos amores</l>

lines.text: ad caelum lepido vocare versu.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:6" n="17">ad caelum lepido vocare versu.</l>

lines.text: Quaeris quot mihi basiationes
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:7" n="1">Quaeris quot mihi basiationes</l>

lines.text: tuae, Lesbia, sint satis superque.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:7" n="2">tuae, Lesbia, sint satis superque.</l>

lines.text: quam magnus numerus Libyssae harenae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:7" n="3">quam magnus numerus Libyssae harenae</l>

lines.text: laserpiciferis iacet Cyrenis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:7" n="4">laserpiciferis iacet Cyrenis,</l>

lines.text: oraclum Iovis inter aestuosi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:7" n="5">oraclum Iovis inter aestuosi</l>

lines.text: et Batti veteris sacrum sepulcrum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:7" n="6">et Batti veteris sacrum sepulcrum,</l>

lines.text: aut quam sidera multa, cum tacet nox,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:7" n="7">aut quam sidera multa, cum tacet nox,</l>

lines.text: furtivos hominum vident amores,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:7" n="8">furtivos hominum vident amores,</l>

lines.text: tam te basia multa basiare
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:7" n="9">tam te basia multa basiare</l>

lines.text: vesano satis et super Catullo est,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:7" n="10">vesano satis et super Catullo est,</l>

lines.text: quae nec pernumerare curiosi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:7" n="11">quae nec pernumerare curiosi</l>

lines.text: possint nec mala fascinare lingua.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:7" n="12">possint nec mala fascinare lingua.</l>

lines.text: Miser Catulle, desinas ineptire,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="1">Miser Catulle, desinas ineptire,</l>

lines.text: et quod vides perisse perditum ducas.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="2">et quod vides perisse perditum ducas.</l>

lines.text: fulsere quondam candidi tibi soles,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="3">fulsere quondam candidi tibi soles,</l>

lines.text: cum ventitabas quo puella ducebat
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="4">cum ventitabas quo puella ducebat</l>

lines.text: amata nobis quantum amabitur nulla.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="5">amata nobis quantum amabitur nulla.</l>

lines.text: ibi illa multa tum iocosa fiebant,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="6">ibi illa multa tum iocosa fiebant,</l>

lines.text: quae tu volebas nec puella nolebat.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="7">quae tu volebas nec puella nolebat.</l>

lines.text: fulsere vere candidi tibi soles.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="8">fulsere vere candidi tibi soles.</l>

lines.text: nunc iam illa non vult: tu quoque, impotens, noli,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="9">nunc iam illa non vult: tu quoque, impotens, noli,</l>

lines.text: nec quae fugit sectare, nec miser vive,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="10">nec quae fugit sectare, nec miser vive,</l>

lines.text: sed obstinata mente perfer, obdura.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="11">sed obstinata mente perfer, obdura.</l>

lines.text: vale, puella! iam Catullus obdurat,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="12">vale, puella! iam Catullus obdurat,</l>

lines.text: nec te requiret nec rogabit invitam:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="13">nec te requiret nec rogabit invitam:</l>

lines.text: at tu dolebis, cum rogaberis nulla.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="14">at tu dolebis, cum rogaberis nulla.</l>

lines.text: scelesta, vae te! quae tibi manet vita!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="15">scelesta, vae te! quae tibi manet vita!</l>

lines.text: quis nunc te adibit? cui videberis bella?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="16">quis nunc te adibit? cui videberis bella?</l>

lines.text: quem nunc amabis? cuius esse diceris?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="17">quem nunc amabis? cuius esse diceris?</l>

lines.text: quem basiabis? cui labella mordebis?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="18">quem basiabis? cui labella mordebis?</l>

lines.text: at tu, Catulle, destinatus obdura.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:8" n="19">at tu, Catulle, destinatus obdura.</l>

lines.text: Verani, omnibus e meis amicis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:9" n="1">Verani, omnibus e meis amicis</l>

lines.text: antistans mihi milibus trecentis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:9" n="2">antistans mihi milibus trecentis,</l>

lines.text: venistine domum ad tuos penates
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:9" n="3">venistine domum ad tuos penates</l>

lines.text: fratresque unanimos anumque matrem?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:9" n="4">fratresque unanimos anumque matrem?</l>

lines.text: venisti! o mihi nuntii beati!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:9" n="5">venisti! o mihi nuntii beati!</l>

lines.text: visam te incolumem audiamque Hiberum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:9" n="6">visam te incolumem audiamque Hiberum</l>

lines.text: narrantem loca, facta, nationes,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:9" n="7">narrantem loca, facta, nationes,</l>

lines.text: ut mos est tuus, applicansque collum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:9" n="8">ut mos est tuus, applicansque collum</l>

lines.text: iucundum os oculosque saviabor.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:9" n="9">iucundum os oculosque saviabor.</l>

lines.text: o, quantum est hominum beatiorum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:9" n="10">o, quantum est hominum beatiorum,</l>

lines.text: quid me laetius est beatiusve?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:9" n="11">quid me laetius est beatiusve?</l>

lines.text: Varus me meus ad suos amores
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="1">Varus me meus ad suos amores</l>

lines.text: visum duxerat e foro otiosum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="2">visum duxerat e foro otiosum,</l>

lines.text: scortillum, ut mihi tunc repente visum est,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="3">scortillum, ut mihi tunc repente visum est,</l>

lines.text: non sane inlepidum neque invenustum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="4">non sane inlepidum neque invenustum.</l>

lines.text: huc ut venimus, incidere nobis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="5">huc ut venimus, incidere nobis</l>

lines.text: sermones varii, in quibus, quid esset
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="6">sermones varii, in quibus, quid esset</l>

lines.text: iam Bithynia, quo modo se haberet,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="7">iam Bithynia, quo modo se haberet,</l>

lines.text: ecquonam mihi profuisset aere.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="8">ecquonam mihi profuisset aere.</l>

lines.text: respondi id quod erat, nihil neque ipsis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="9">respondi id quod erat, nihil neque ipsis</l>

lines.text: nec praetoribus esse nec cohorti,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="10">nec praetoribus esse nec cohorti,</l>

lines.text: cur quisquam caput unctius referret,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="11">cur quisquam caput unctius referret,</l>

lines.text: praesertim quibus esset irrumator
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="12">praesertim quibus esset irrumator</l>

lines.text: praetor nec faceret pili cohortem.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="13">praetor nec faceret pili cohortem.</l>

lines.text: at certe tamen, inquiunt, quod illic
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="14"><q rend="single">at certe tamen,</q> inquiunt, <q rend="single">quod illic</q></l>

lines.text: natum dicitur esse comparasti,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="15"><q rend="single; merge">natum dicitur esse comparasti,</q></l>

lines.text: ad lecticam homines. ego, ut puellae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="16"><q rend="single; merge">ad lecticam homines.</q> ego, ut puellae</l>

lines.text: unum me facerem beatiorem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="17">unum me facerem beatiorem,</l>

lines.text: non, inquam, mihi tam fuit maligne,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="18"><q rend="single">non,</q> inquam, <q rend="single">mihi tam fuit maligne,</q></l>

lines.text: ut, provincia quod mala incidisset,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="19"><q rend="single; merge">ut, provincia quod mala incidisset,</q></l>

lines.text: non possem octo homines parare rectos.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="20"><q rend="single; merge">non possem octo homines parare rectos.</q></l>

lines.text: at mi nullus erat neque hic neque illic
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="21">at mi nullus erat neque hic neque illic</l>

lines.text: fractum qui veteris pedem grabati
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="22">fractum qui veteris pedem grabati</l>

lines.text: in collo sibi conlocare posset.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="23">in collo sibi conlocare posset.</l>

lines.text: hic illa, ut decuit cinaediorem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="24">hic illa, ut decuit cinaediorem,</l>

lines.text: quaeso, inquit, mihi, mi Catulle, paulum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="25"><q rend="single">quaeso,</q> inquit, <q rend="single">mihi, mi Catulle, paulum</q></l>

lines.text: istos commoda: nam volo ad Sarapim
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="26"><q rend="single; merge">istos commoda: nam volo ad Sarapim</q></l>

lines.text: deferri.Mane, inquii puellae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="27"><q rend="single; merge">deferri.</q><q rend="single">Mane,</q> inquii puellae,</l>

lines.text: istud quod modo dixeram, me habere,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="28"><q rend="single">istud quod modo dixeram, me habere,</q></l>

lines.text: fugit me ratio: meus sodalis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="29"><q rend="single; merge">fugit me ratio: meus sodalis</q></l>

lines.text: Cinna est Gaius; is sibi paravit.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="30"><q rend="single; merge">Cinna est Gaius; is sibi paravit.</q></l>

lines.text: verum, utrum illius an mei, quid ad me?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="31"><q rend="single; merge">verum, utrum illius an mei, quid ad me?</q></l>

lines.text: utor tam bene quam mihi pararim.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="32"><q rend="single; merge">utor tam bene quam mihi pararim.</q></l>

lines.text: sed tu insulsa male et molesta vivis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="33"><q rend="single; merge">sed tu insulsa male et molesta vivis,</q></l>

lines.text: per quam non licet esse neglegentem.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:10" n="34"><q rend="single; merge">per quam non licet esse neglegentem.</q></l>

lines.text: Furi et Aureli, comites Catulli,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="1">Furi et Aureli, comites Catulli,</l>

lines.text: sive in extremos penetrabit Indos,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="2">sive in extremos penetrabit Indos,</l>

lines.text: litus ut longe resonante Eoa
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="3">litus ut longe resonante Eoa</l>

lines.text: tunditur unda,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="4">tunditur unda,</l>

lines.text: sive in Hyrcanos Arabasve molles,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="5">sive in Hyrcanos Arabasve molles,</l>

lines.text: seu Sacas sagittiferosve Parthos,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="6">seu Sacas sagittiferosve Parthos,</l>

lines.text: sive quae septemgeminus colorat
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="7">sive quae septemgeminus colorat</l>

lines.text: aequora Nilus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="8">aequora Nilus,</l>

lines.text: sive trans altas gradietur Alpes
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="9">sive trans altas gradietur Alpes</l>

lines.text: Caesaris visens monimenta magni,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="10">Caesaris visens monimenta magni,</l>

lines.text: Gallicum Rhenum, horribile aequor, ulti-
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="11">Gallicum Rhenum, horribile aequor, ulti-</l>

lines.text: mosque Britannos,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="12">mosque Britannos,</l>

lines.text: omnia haec, quaecumque feret voluntas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="13">omnia haec, quaecumque feret voluntas</l>

lines.text: caelitum, temptare simul parati,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="14">caelitum, temptare simul parati,</l>

lines.text: pauca nuntiate meae puellae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="15">pauca nuntiate meae puellae</l>

lines.text: non bona dicta.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="16">non bona dicta.</l>

lines.text: cum suis vivat valeatque moechis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="17">cum suis vivat valeatque moechis,</l>

lines.text: quos simul complexa tenet trecentos,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="18">quos simul complexa tenet trecentos,</l>

lines.text: nullum amans vere, sed identidem omnium
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="19">nullum amans vere, sed identidem omnium</l>

lines.text: ilia rumpens;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="20">ilia rumpens;</l>

lines.text: nec meum respectet, ut ante, amorem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="21">nec meum respectet, ut ante, amorem,</l>

lines.text: qui illius culpa cecidit velut prati
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="22">qui illius culpa cecidit velut prati</l>

lines.text: ultimi flos, praetereunte postquam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="23">ultimi flos, praetereunte postquam</l>

lines.text: tactus aratro est.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:11" n="24">tactus aratro est.</l>

lines.text: Marrucine Asini, manu sinistra
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:12" n="1">Marrucine Asini, manu sinistra</l>

lines.text: non belle uteris in ioco atque vino:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:12" n="2">non belle uteris in ioco atque vino:</l>

lines.text: tollis lintea neglegentiorum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:12" n="3">tollis lintea neglegentiorum.</l>

lines.text: hoc salsum esse putas? fugit te, inepte!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:12" n="4">hoc salsum esse putas? fugit te, inepte!</l>

lines.text: quamvis sordida res et invenusta est
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:12" n="5">quamvis sordida res et invenusta est</l>

lines.text: non credis mihi?crede Pollioni
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:12" n="6">non credis mihi?crede Pollioni</l>

lines.text: fratri, qui tua furta vel talento
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:12" n="7">fratri, qui tua furta vel talento</l>

lines.text: mutari velit; est enim leporum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:12" n="8">mutari velit; est enim leporum</l>

lines.text: disertus puer ac facetiarum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:12" n="9">disertus puer ac facetiarum.</l>

lines.text: quare aut hendecasyllabos trecentos
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:12" n="10">quare aut hendecasyllabos trecentos</l>

lines.text: exspecta, aut mihi linteum remitte,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:12" n="11">exspecta, aut mihi linteum remitte,</l>

lines.text: quod me non movet aestimatione,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:12" n="12">quod me non movet aestimatione,</l>

lines.text: verum est mnemosynum mei sodalis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:12" n="13">verum est mnemosynum mei sodalis.</l>

lines.text: nam sudaria Saetaba ex Hiberis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:12" n="14">nam sudaria Saetaba ex Hiberis</l>

lines.text: miserunt mihi muneri Fabullus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:12" n="15">miserunt mihi muneri Fabullus</l>

lines.text: et Veranius: haec amem necesse est
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:12" n="16">et Veranius: haec amem necesse est</l>

lines.text: et Veraniolum meum et Fabullum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:12" n="17">et Veraniolum meum et Fabullum.</l>

lines.text: Cenabis bene, mi Fabulle, apud me
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:13" n="1">Cenabis bene, mi Fabulle, apud me</l>

lines.text: paucis, si tibi di favent, diebus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:13" n="2">paucis, si tibi di favent, diebus,</l>

lines.text: si tecum attuleris bonam atque magnam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:13" n="3">si tecum attuleris bonam atque magnam</l>

lines.text: cenam, non sine candida puella
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:13" n="4">cenam, non sine candida puella</l>

lines.text: et vino et sale et omnibus cachinnis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:13" n="5">et vino et sale et omnibus cachinnis.</l>

lines.text: haec si, inquam, attuleris, venuste noster
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:13" n="6">haec si, inquam, attuleris, venuste noster</l>

lines.text: cenabis bene; nam tui Catulli
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:13" n="7">cenabis bene; nam tui Catulli</l>

lines.text: plenus sacculus est aranearum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:13" n="8">plenus sacculus est aranearum.</l>

lines.text: sed contra accipies meros amores
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:13" n="9">sed contra accipies meros amores</l>

lines.text: seu quid suavius elegantiusve est:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:13" n="10">seu quid suavius elegantiusve est:</l>

lines.text: nam unguentum dabo, quod meae puellae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:13" n="11">nam unguentum dabo, quod meae puellae</l>

lines.text: donarunt Veneres Cupidinesque,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:13" n="12">donarunt Veneres Cupidinesque,</l>

lines.text: quod tu cum olfacies, deos rogabis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:13" n="13">quod tu cum olfacies, deos rogabis</l>

lines.text: totum ut te faciant, Fabulle, nasum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:13" n="14">totum ut te faciant, Fabulle, nasum.</l>

lines.text: Ni te plus oculis meis amarem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="1">Ni te plus oculis meis amarem,</l>

lines.text: iucundissime Calve, munere isto
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="2">iucundissime Calve, munere isto</l>

lines.text: odissem te odio Vatiniano:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="3">odissem te odio Vatiniano:</l>

lines.text: nam quid feci ego quidve sum locutus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="4">nam quid feci ego quidve sum locutus,</l>

lines.text: cur me tot male perderes poetis?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="5">cur me tot male perderes poetis?</l>

lines.text: isti di mala multa dent clienti
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="6">isti di mala multa dent clienti</l>

lines.text: qui tantum tibi misit impiorum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="7">qui tantum tibi misit impiorum.</l>

lines.text: quod si, ut suspicor, hoc novum ac repertum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="8">quod si, ut suspicor, hoc novum ac repertum</l>

lines.text: munus dat tibi Sulla litterator,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="9">munus dat tibi Sulla litterator,</l>

lines.text: non est mi male, sed bene ac beate,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="10">non est mi male, sed bene ac beate,</l>

lines.text: quod non dispereunt tui labores.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="11">quod non dispereunt tui labores.</l>

lines.text: di magni, horribilem et sacrum libellum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="12">di magni, horribilem et sacrum libellum,</l>

lines.text: quem tu scilicet ad tuum Catullum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="13">quem tu scilicet ad tuum Catullum</l>

lines.text: misti, continuo ut die periret,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="14">misti, continuo ut die periret,</l>

lines.text: Saturnalibus, optimo dierum!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="15">Saturnalibus, optimo dierum!</l>

lines.text: non, non hoc tibi, false, sic abibit:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="16">non, non hoc tibi, false, sic abibit:</l>

lines.text: nam, si luxerit, ad librariorum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="17">nam, si luxerit, ad librariorum</l>

lines.text: curram scrinia, Caesios, Aquinos,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="18">curram scrinia, Caesios, Aquinos,</l>

lines.text: Suffenum, omnia colligam venena,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="19">Suffenum, omnia colligam venena,</l>

lines.text: ac te his suppliciis remunerabor.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="20">ac te his suppliciis remunerabor.</l>

lines.text: vos hinc interea valete, abite
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="21">vos hinc interea valete, abite</l>

lines.text: illuc unde malum pedem attulistis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="22">illuc unde malum pedem attulistis,</l>

lines.text: saecli incommoda, pessimi poetae.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14" n="23">saecli incommoda, pessimi poetae.</l>

lines.text: Si qui forte mearum ineptiarum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14a" n="1">Si qui forte mearum ineptiarum</l>

lines.text: lectores eritis manusque vestras
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14a" n="2">lectores eritis manusque vestras</l>

lines.text: non horrebitis admovere nobis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14a" n="3">non horrebitis admovere nobis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:14a" n="3ff"><gap reason="lost" rend="*"/></l>

notes: Labeled 14b in the print.

lines.text: Commendo tibi me ac meos amores,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="1">Commendo tibi me ac meos amores,</l>

lines.text: Aureli. Veniam peto pudentem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="2">Aureli. Veniam peto pudentem,</l>

lines.text: ut, si quicquam animo tuo cupisti
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="3">ut, si quicquam animo tuo cupisti</l>

lines.text: quod castum expeteres et integellum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="4">quod castum expeteres et integellum,</l>

lines.text: conserves puerum mihi pudice,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="5">conserves puerum mihi pudice,</l>

lines.text: non dico a populo: nihil veremur
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="6">non dico a populo: nihil veremur</l>

lines.text: istos qui in platea modo huc modo illuc
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="7">istos qui in platea modo huc modo illuc</l>

lines.text: in re praetereunt sua occupati;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="8">in re praetereunt sua occupati;</l>

lines.text: verum a te metuo tuoque pene
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="9">verum a te metuo tuoque pene</l>

lines.text: infesto pueris bonis malisque.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="10">infesto pueris bonis malisque.</l>

lines.text: quem tu qua libet, ut libet moveto
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="11">quem tu qua libet, ut libet moveto</l>

lines.text: quantum vis, ubi erit foris paratum:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="12">quantum vis, ubi erit foris paratum:</l>

lines.text: hunc unum excipio, ut puto, pudenter.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="13">hunc unum excipio, ut puto, pudenter.</l>

lines.text: quod si te mala mens furorque vecors
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="14">quod si te mala mens furorque vecors</l>

lines.text: in tantam impulerit, sceleste, culpam,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="15">in tantam impulerit, sceleste, culpam,</l>

lines.text: ut nostrum insidiis caput lacessas,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="16">ut nostrum insidiis caput lacessas,</l>

lines.text: ah tum te miserum malique fati,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="17">ah tum te miserum malique fati,</l>

lines.text: quem attractis pedibus patente porta
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="18">quem attractis pedibus patente porta</l>

lines.text: percurrent raphanique mugilesque.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:15" n="19">percurrent raphanique mugilesque.</l>

lines.text: Pedicabo ego vos et irrumabo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:16" n="1">Pedicabo ego vos et irrumabo,</l>

lines.text: Aureli pathice et cinaede Furi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:16" n="2">Aureli pathice et cinaede Furi,</l>

lines.text: qui me ex versiculis meis putastis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:16" n="3">qui me ex versiculis meis putastis,</l>

lines.text: quod sunt molliculi, parum pudicum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:16" n="4">quod sunt molliculi, parum pudicum.</l>

lines.text: nam castum esse decet pium poetam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:16" n="5">nam castum esse decet pium poetam</l>

lines.text: ipsum, versiculos nihil necesse est,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:16" n="6">ipsum, versiculos nihil necesse est,</l>

lines.text: qui tum denique habent salem ac leporem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:16" n="7">qui tum denique habent salem ac leporem,</l>

lines.text: si sunt molliculi ac parum pudici
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:16" n="8">si sunt molliculi ac parum pudici</l>

lines.text: et quod pruriat incitare possunt,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:16" n="9">et quod pruriat incitare possunt,</l>

lines.text: non dico pueris, sed his pilosis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:16" n="10">non dico pueris, sed his pilosis,</l>

lines.text: qui duros nequeunt movere lumbos.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:16" n="11">qui duros nequeunt movere lumbos.</l>

lines.text: vos quod milia multa basiorum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:16" n="12">vos quod milia multa basiorum</l>

lines.text: legistis, male me marem putatis?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:16" n="13">legistis, male me marem putatis?</l>

lines.text: pedicabo ego vos et irrumabo.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:16" n="14">pedicabo ego vos et irrumabo.</l>

lines.text: O Colonia, quae cupis ponte ludere longo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="1">O Colonia, quae cupis ponte ludere longo,</l>

lines.text: et salire paratum habes, sed vereris inepta
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="2">et salire paratum habes, sed vereris inepta</l>

lines.text: crura ponticuli assulis stantis in redivivis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="3">crura ponticuli assulis stantis in redivivis,</l>

lines.text: ne supinus eat cavaque in palude recumbat,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="4">ne supinus eat cavaque in palude recumbat,</l>

lines.text: sic tibi bonus ex tua pons libidine fiat,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="5">sic tibi bonus ex tua pons libidine fiat,</l>

lines.text: in quo vel Salisubsili sacra suscipiantur,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="6">in quo vel Salisubsili sacra suscipiantur,</l>

lines.text: munus hoc mihi maximi da, Colonia, risus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="7">munus hoc mihi maximi da, Colonia, risus.</l>

lines.text: quendam municipem meum de tuo volo ponte
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="8">quendam municipem meum de tuo volo ponte</l>

lines.text: ire praecipitem in lutum per caputque pedesque,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="9">ire praecipitem in lutum per caputque pedesque,</l>

lines.text: verum totius ut lacus putidaeque paludis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="10">verum totius ut lacus putidaeque paludis</l>

lines.text: lividissima maximeque est profunda vorago.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="11">lividissima maximeque est profunda vorago.</l>

lines.text: insulsissimus est homo, nec sapit pueri instar
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="12">insulsissimus est homo, nec sapit pueri instar</l>

lines.text: bimuli tremula patris dormientis in ulna:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="13">bimuli tremula patris dormientis in ulna:</l>

lines.text: cui cum sit viridissimo nupta flore puella
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="14">cui cum sit viridissimo nupta flore puella</l>

lines.text: (et puella tenellulo delicatior haedo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="15">(et puella tenellulo delicatior haedo,</l>

lines.text: adservanda nigerrimis diligentius uvis),
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="16">adservanda nigerrimis diligentius uvis),</l>

lines.text: ludere hanc sinit ut libet, nec pili facit uni,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="17">ludere hanc sinit ut libet, nec pili facit uni,</l>

lines.text: nec se sublevat ex sua parte, sed velut alnus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="18">nec se sublevat ex sua parte, sed velut alnus</l>

lines.text: in fossa Liguri iacet suppernata securi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="19">in fossa Liguri iacet suppernata securi,</l>

lines.text: tantundem omnia sentiens quam si nulla sit usquam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="20">tantundem omnia sentiens quam si nulla sit usquam</l>

lines.text: talis iste meus stupor nil videt, nihil audit,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="21">talis iste meus stupor nil videt, nihil audit,</l>

lines.text: ipse qui sit, utrum sit an non sit, id quoque nescit.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="22">ipse qui sit, utrum sit an non sit, id quoque nescit.</l>

lines.text: nunc eum volo de tuo ponte mittere pronum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="23">nunc eum volo de tuo ponte mittere pronum,</l>

lines.text: si pote stolidum repente excitare veternum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="24">si pote stolidum repente excitare veternum</l>

lines.text: et supinum animum in gravi derelinquere caeno,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="25">et supinum animum in gravi derelinquere caeno,</l>

lines.text: ferream ut soleam tenaci in voragine mula.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:17" n="26">ferream ut soleam tenaci in voragine mula.</l>

lines.text: Aureli, pater esuritionum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:21" n="1">Aureli, pater esuritionum,</l>

lines.text: non harum modo, sed quot aut fuerunt
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:21" n="2">non harum modo, sed quot aut fuerunt</l>

lines.text: aut sunt aut aliis erunt in annis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:21" n="3">aut sunt aut aliis erunt in annis,</l>

lines.text: pedicare cupis meos amores.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:21" n="4">pedicare cupis meos amores.</l>

lines.text: nec clam: nam simul es, iocaris una,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:21" n="5">nec clam: nam simul es, iocaris una,</l>

lines.text: haerens ad latus omnia experiris.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:21" n="6">haerens ad latus omnia experiris.</l>

lines.text: frustra: nam insidias mihi instruentem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:21" n="7">frustra: nam insidias mihi instruentem</l>

lines.text: tangam te prior irrumatione.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:21" n="8">tangam te prior irrumatione.</l>

lines.text: atque id si faceres satur, tacerem:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:21" n="9">atque id si faceres satur, tacerem:</l>

lines.text: nunc ipsum id doleo, quod esurire,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:21" n="10">nunc ipsum id doleo, quod esurire,</l>

lines.text: ah me me, puer et sitire discet.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:21" n="11">ah me me, puer et sitire discet.</l>

lines.text: quare desine, dum licet pudico,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:21" n="12">quare desine, dum licet pudico,</l>

lines.text: ne finem facias, sed irrumatus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:21" n="13">ne finem facias, sed irrumatus.</l>

notes: Desunt cetera 18-20.

lines.text: Suffenus iste, Vare, quem probe nosti,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="1">Suffenus iste, Vare, quem probe nosti,</l>

lines.text: homo est venustus et dicax et urbanus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="2">homo est venustus et dicax et urbanus,</l>

lines.text: idemque longe plurimos facit versus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="3">idemque longe plurimos facit versus.</l>

lines.text: puto esse ego illi milia aut decem aut plura
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="4">puto esse ego illi milia aut decem aut plura</l>

lines.text: perscripta, nec sic, ut fit, in palimpsesto
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="5">perscripta, nec sic, ut fit, in palimpsesto</l>

lines.text: relata: chartae regiae, novi libri,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="6">relata: chartae regiae, novi libri,</l>

lines.text: novi umbilici, lora, rubra membrana,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="7">novi umbilici, lora, rubra membrana,</l>

lines.text: derecta plumbo et pumice omnia aequata.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="8">derecta plumbo et pumice omnia aequata.</l>

lines.text: haec cum legas tu, bellus ille et urbanus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="9">haec cum legas tu, bellus ille et urbanus</l>

lines.text: Suffenus unus caprimulgus aut fossor
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="10">Suffenus unus caprimulgus aut fossor</l>

lines.text: rursus videtur: tantum abhorret ac mutat.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="11">rursus videtur: tantum abhorret ac mutat.</l>

lines.text: hoc quid putemus esse? Qui modo scurra
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="12">hoc quid putemus esse? Qui modo scurra</l>

lines.text: aut si quid hac re tritius videbatur,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="13">aut si quid hac re tritius videbatur,</l>

lines.text: idem infaceto est infacetior rure
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="14">idem infaceto est infacetior rure</l>

lines.text: simul poemata attigit, neque idem unquam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="15">simul poemata attigit, neque idem unquam</l>

lines.text: aeque est beatus ac poema cum scribit:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="16">aeque est beatus ac poema cum scribit:</l>

lines.text: tam gaudet in se tamque se ipse miratur.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="17">tam gaudet in se tamque se ipse miratur.</l>

lines.text: nimirum idem omnes fallimur, neque est quisquam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="18">nimirum idem omnes fallimur, neque est quisquam</l>

lines.text: quem non in aliqua re videre Suffenum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="19">quem non in aliqua re videre Suffenum</l>

lines.text: possis. Suus cuique attributus est error,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="20">possis. Suus cuique attributus est error,</l>

lines.text: sed non videmus manticae quod in tergo est.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:22" n="21">sed non videmus manticae quod in tergo est.</l>

lines.text: Furi, cui neque servus est neque arca
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="1">Furi, cui neque servus est neque arca</l>

lines.text: nec cimex neque araneus neque ignis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="2">nec cimex neque araneus neque ignis,</l>

lines.text: verum est et pater et noverca, quorum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="3">verum est et pater et noverca, quorum</l>

lines.text: dentes vel silicem comesse possunt,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="4">dentes vel silicem comesse possunt,</l>

lines.text: est pulchre tibi cum tuo parente
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="5">est pulchre tibi cum tuo parente</l>

lines.text: et cum coniuge lignea parentis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="6">et cum coniuge lignea parentis.</l>

lines.text: nec mirum: bene nam valetis omnes,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="7">nec mirum: bene nam valetis omnes,</l>

lines.text: pulchre concoquitis, nihil timetis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="8">pulchre concoquitis, nihil timetis,</l>

lines.text: non incendia, non graves ruinas,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="9">non incendia, non graves ruinas,</l>

lines.text: non furta impia, non dolos veneni,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="10">non furta impia, non dolos veneni,</l>

lines.text: non casus alios periculorum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="11">non casus alios periculorum.</l>

lines.text: atqui corpora sicciora cornu
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="12">atqui corpora sicciora cornu</l>

lines.text: aut si quid magis aridum est habetis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="13">aut si quid magis aridum est habetis</l>

lines.text: sole et frigore et esuritione.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="14">sole et frigore et esuritione.</l>

lines.text: quare non tibi sit bene ac beate?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="15">quare non tibi sit bene ac beate?</l>

lines.text: a te sudor abest, abest saliva,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="16">a te sudor abest, abest saliva,</l>

lines.text: mucusque et mala pituita nasi.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="17">mucusque et mala pituita nasi.</l>

lines.text: hanc ad munditiem adde mundiorem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="18">hanc ad munditiem adde mundiorem,</l>

lines.text: quod culus tibi purior salillo est,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="19">quod culus tibi purior salillo est,</l>

lines.text: nec toto decies cacas in anno;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="20">nec toto decies cacas in anno;</l>

lines.text: atque id durius est faba et lapillis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="21">atque id durius est faba et lapillis,</l>

lines.text: quod tu si manibus teras fricesque,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="22">quod tu si manibus teras fricesque,</l>

lines.text: non unquam digitum inquinare possis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="23">non unquam digitum inquinare possis.</l>

lines.text: haec tu commoda tam beata, Furi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="24">haec tu commoda tam beata, Furi,</l>

lines.text: noli spernere nec putare parvi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="25">noli spernere nec putare parvi,</l>

lines.text: et sestertia quae soles precari
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="26">et sestertia quae soles precari</l>

lines.text: centum desine: nam satis beatu's.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:23" n="27">centum desine: nam satis beatu's.</l>

lines.text: O qui flosculus es Iuventiorum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:24" n="1">O qui flosculus es Iuventiorum,</l>

lines.text: non horum modo, sed quot aut fuerunt
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:24" n="2">non horum modo, sed quot aut fuerunt</l>

lines.text: aut posthac aliis erunt in annis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:24" n="3">aut posthac aliis erunt in annis,</l>

lines.text: mallem divitias Midae dedisses
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:24" n="4">mallem divitias Midae dedisses</l>

lines.text: isti cui neque servus est neque arca,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:24" n="5">isti cui neque servus est neque arca,</l>

lines.text: quam sic te sineres ab illo amari.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:24" n="6">quam sic te sineres ab illo amari.</l>

lines.text: quid? Non est homo bellus? inquies. est:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:24" n="7"><q rend="single">quid? Non est homo bellus?</q> inquies. est:</l>

lines.text: sed bello huic neque servus est neque arca.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:24" n="8">sed bello huic neque servus est neque arca.</l>

lines.text: hoc tu quam libet abice elevaque:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:24" n="9">hoc tu quam libet abice elevaque:</l>

lines.text: nec servum tamen ille habet neque arcam.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:24" n="10">nec servum tamen ille habet neque arcam.</l>

lines.text: Cinaede Thalle, mollior cuniculi capillo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:25" n="1">Cinaede Thalle, mollior cuniculi capillo</l>

lines.text: vel anseris medullula vel imula auricilla
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:25" n="2">vel anseris medullula vel imula auricilla</l>

lines.text: vel pene languido senis situque araneoso,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:25" n="3">vel pene languido senis situque araneoso,</l>

lines.text: idemque Thalle turbida rapacior procella,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:25" n="4">idemque Thalle turbida rapacior procella,</l>

lines.text: cum † diva mulier aries ostendit oscitantes,
