lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:25" n="5">cum † diva mulier aries ostendit oscitantes,</l>

lines.text: remitte pallium mihi meum quod involasti
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:25" n="6">remitte pallium mihi meum quod involasti</l>

lines.text: sudariumque Saetabum catagraphosque Thynos,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:25" n="7">sudariumque Saetabum catagraphosque Thynos,</l>

lines.text: inepte, quae palam soles habere tanquam avita.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:25" n="8">inepte, quae palam soles habere tanquam avita.</l>

lines.text: quae nunc tuis ab unguibus reglutina et remitte,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:25" n="9">quae nunc tuis ab unguibus reglutina et remitte,</l>

lines.text: ne laneum latusculum manusque mollicellas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:25" n="10">ne laneum latusculum manusque mollicellas</l>

lines.text: inusta turpiter tibi flagella conscribillent,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:25" n="11">inusta turpiter tibi flagella conscribillent,</l>

lines.text: et insolenter aestues velut minuta magno
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:25" n="12">et insolenter aestues velut minuta magno</l>

lines.text: deprensa navis in mari vesaniente vento.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:25" n="13">deprensa navis in mari vesaniente vento.</l>

lines.text: Furi, villula vestra non ad Austri
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:26" n="1">Furi, villula vestra non ad Austri</l>

lines.text: flatus opposita est neque ad Favoni
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:26" n="2">flatus opposita est neque ad Favoni</l>

lines.text: nec saevi Boreae aut Apeliotae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:26" n="3">nec saevi Boreae aut Apeliotae,</l>

lines.text: verum ad milia quindecim et ducentos.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:26" n="4">verum ad milia quindecim et ducentos.</l>

lines.text: o ventum horribilem atque pestilentem!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:26" n="5">o ventum horribilem atque pestilentem!</l>

lines.text: Minister vetuli puer Falerni
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:27" n="1">Minister vetuli puer Falerni</l>

lines.text: inger mi calices amariores,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:27" n="2">inger mi calices amariores,</l>

lines.text: ut lex Postumiae iubet magistrae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:27" n="3">ut lex Postumiae iubet magistrae,</l>

lines.text: ebrioso acino ebriosioris.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:27" n="4">ebrioso acino ebriosioris.</l>

lines.text: at vos quo libet hinc abite, lymphae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:27" n="5">at vos quo libet hinc abite, lymphae,</l>

lines.text: vini pernicies, et ad severos
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:27" n="6">vini pernicies, et ad severos</l>

lines.text: migrate: hic merus est Thyonianus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:27" n="7">migrate: hic merus est Thyonianus.</l>

lines.text: Pisonis comites, cohors inanis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:28" n="1">Pisonis comites, cohors inanis</l>

lines.text: aptis sarcinulis et expeditis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:28" n="2">aptis sarcinulis et expeditis,</l>

lines.text: Verani optime tuque mi Fabulle,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:28" n="3">Verani optime tuque mi Fabulle,</l>

lines.text: quid rerum geritis? Satisne cum isto
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:28" n="4">quid rerum geritis? Satisne cum isto</l>

lines.text: vappa frigoraque et famem tulistis?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:28" n="5">vappa frigoraque et famem tulistis?</l>

lines.text: ecquidnam in tabulis patet lucelli
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:28" n="6">ecquidnam in tabulis patet lucelli</l>

lines.text: expensum, ut mihi, qui meum secutus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:28" n="7">expensum, ut mihi, qui meum secutus</l>

lines.text: praetorem refero datum lucello,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:28" n="8">praetorem refero datum lucello,</l>

lines.text: o Memmi, bene me ac diu supinum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:28" n="9"><q rend="single">o Memmi, bene me ac diu supinum</q></l>

lines.text: tota ista trabe lentus irrumasti.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:28" n="10"><q rend="single; merge">tota ista trabe lentus irrumasti.</q></l>

lines.text: sed, quantum video, pari fuistis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:28" n="11">sed, quantum video, pari fuistis</l>

lines.text: casu: nam nihilo minore verpa
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:28" n="12">casu: nam nihilo minore verpa</l>

lines.text: farti estis. pete nobiles amicos.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:28" n="13">farti estis. pete nobiles amicos.</l>

lines.text: at vobis mala multa di deaeque
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:28" n="14">at vobis mala multa di deaeque</l>

lines.text: dent, opprobria Romuli Remique.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:28" n="15">dent, opprobria Romuli Remique.</l>

lines.text: Quis hoc potest videre, quis potest pati,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:29" n="1">Quis hoc potest videre, quis potest pati,</l>

lines.text: nisi impudicus et vorax et aleo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:29" n="2">nisi impudicus et vorax et aleo,</l>

lines.text: Mamurram habere quod comata Gallia
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:29" n="3">Mamurram habere quod comata Gallia</l>

lines.text: habebat ante et ultima Britannia?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:29" n="4">habebat ante et ultima Britannia?</l>

lines.text: Cinaede Romule, haec videbis et feres?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:29" n="5">Cinaede Romule, haec videbis et feres?</l>

lines.text: et ille nunc superbus et superfluens
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:29" n="6">et ille nunc superbus et superfluens</l>

lines.text: perambulabit omnium cubilia
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:29" n="7">perambulabit omnium cubilia</l>

lines.text: ut albulus columbus aut Adoneus?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:29" n="8">ut albulus columbus aut Adoneus?</l>

lines.text: cinaede Romule, haec videbis et feres?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:29" n="9">cinaede Romule, haec videbis et feres?</l>

lines.text: es impudicus et vorax et aleo.

lines.text: Hibera, quam scit amnis aurifer Tagus.

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:29" n="21">quid hunc malum fovetis? aut quid hic potest</l>

lines.text: nisi uncta devorare patrimonia?

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:30" n="5">quae tu neglegis, ac me miserum deseris in malis.</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:30" n="7">certe tute iubebas animam tradere, inique, me</l>

lines.text: inducens in amorem, quasi tuta omnia mi forent.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:30" n="8">inducens in amorem, quasi tuta omnia mi forent.</l>

lines.text: idem nunc retrahis te ac tua dicta omnia factaque
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:30" n="9">idem nunc retrahis te ac tua dicta omnia factaque</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:30" n="12">quae te ut paeniteat postmodo facti faciet tui.</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:31" n="6">liquisse campos et videre te in tuto!</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:31" n="11">hoc est quod unum est pro laboribus tantis.</l>

lines.text: salve, o venusta Sirmio, atque ero gaude;
