lines.text: nam quasdam volo cogitationes
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:35" n="5">nam quasdam volo cogitationes</l>

lines.text: amici accipiat sui meique.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:35" n="6">amici accipiat sui meique.</l>

lines.text: quare, si sapiet, viam vorabit,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:35" n="7">quare, si sapiet, viam vorabit,</l>

lines.text: quamvis candida milies puella
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:35" n="8">quamvis candida milies puella</l>

lines.text: euntem revocet manusque collo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:35" n="9">euntem revocet manusque collo</l>

lines.text: ambas iniciens roget morari,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:35" n="10">ambas iniciens roget morari,</l>

lines.text: quae nunc, si mihi vera nuntiantur,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:35" n="11">quae nunc, si mihi vera nuntiantur,</l>

lines.text: illum deperit impotente amore:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:35" n="12">illum deperit impotente amore:</l>

lines.text: nam quo tempore legit incohatam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:35" n="13">nam quo tempore legit incohatam</l>

lines.text: Dindymi dominam, ex eo misellae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:35" n="14">Dindymi dominam, ex eo misellae</l>

lines.text: ignes interiorem edunt medullam.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:35" n="15">ignes interiorem edunt medullam.</l>

lines.text: ignosco tibi, Sapphica puella
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:35" n="16">ignosco tibi, Sapphica puella</l>

lines.text: Musa doctior: est enim venuste
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:35" n="17">Musa doctior: est enim venuste</l>

lines.text: Magna Caecilio incohata Mater.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:35" n="18">Magna Caecilio incohata Mater.</l>

lines.text: Annales Volusi, cacata charta,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="1">Annales Volusi, cacata charta,</l>

lines.text: votum solvite pro mea puella:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="2">votum solvite pro mea puella:</l>

lines.text: nam sanctae Veneri Cupidinique
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="3">nam sanctae Veneri Cupidinique</l>

lines.text: vovit, si sibi restitutus essem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="4">vovit, si sibi restitutus essem</l>

lines.text: desissemque truces vibrare iambos,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="5">desissemque truces vibrare iambos,</l>

lines.text: electissima pessimi poetae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="6">electissima pessimi poetae</l>

lines.text: scripta tardipedi deo daturam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="7">scripta tardipedi deo daturam</l>

lines.text: infelicibus ustilanda lignis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="8">infelicibus ustilanda lignis.</l>

lines.text: et hoc pessima se puella vidit
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="9">et hoc pessima se puella vidit</l>

lines.text: iocose lepide vovere divis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="10">iocose lepide vovere divis.</l>

lines.text: nunc, o caeruleo creata ponto,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="11">nunc, o caeruleo creata ponto,</l>

lines.text: quae sanctum Idalium Uriosque apertos,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="12">quae sanctum Idalium Uriosque apertos,</l>

lines.text: quaeque Ancona Cnidumque harundinosam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="13">quaeque Ancona Cnidumque harundinosam</l>

lines.text: colis, quaeque Amathunta, quaeque Golgos,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="14">colis, quaeque Amathunta, quaeque Golgos,</l>

lines.text: quaeque Durrachium Hadriae tabernam,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="15">quaeque Durrachium Hadriae tabernam,</l>

lines.text: acceptum face redditumque votum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="16">acceptum face redditumque votum,</l>

lines.text: si non inlepidum neque invenustum est.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="17">si non inlepidum neque invenustum est.</l>

lines.text: at vos interea venite in ignem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="18">at vos interea venite in ignem,</l>

lines.text: pleni ruris et inficetiarum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="19">pleni ruris et inficetiarum</l>

lines.text: Annales Volusi, cacata charta.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:36" n="20">Annales Volusi, cacata charta.</l>

lines.text: Salax taberna vosque contubernales,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="1">Salax taberna vosque contubernales,</l>

lines.text: a pilleatis nona fratribus pila,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="2">a pilleatis nona fratribus pila,</l>

lines.text: solis putatis esse mentulas vobis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="3">solis putatis esse mentulas vobis,</l>

lines.text: solis licere quidquid est puellarum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="4">solis licere quidquid est puellarum</l>

lines.text: confutuere et putare ceteros hircos?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="5">confutuere et putare ceteros hircos?</l>

lines.text: an, continenter quod sedetis insulsi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="6">an, continenter quod sedetis insulsi</l>

lines.text: centum an ducenti, non putatis ausurum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="7">centum an ducenti, non putatis ausurum</l>

lines.text: me una ducentos irrumare sessores?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="8">me una ducentos irrumare sessores?</l>

lines.text: atqui putate: namque totius vobis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="9">atqui putate: namque totius vobis</l>

lines.text: frontem tabernae sopionibus scribam.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="10">frontem tabernae sopionibus scribam.</l>

lines.text: puella nam mi, quae meo sinu fugit,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="11">puella nam mi, quae meo sinu fugit,</l>

lines.text: amata tantum quantum amabitur nulla,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="12">amata tantum quantum amabitur nulla,</l>

lines.text: pro qua mihi sunt magna bella pugnata,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="13">pro qua mihi sunt magna bella pugnata,</l>

lines.text: consedit istic. hanc boni beatique
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="14">consedit istic. hanc boni beatique</l>

lines.text: omnes amatis, et quidem, quod indignum est,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="15">omnes amatis, et quidem, quod indignum est,</l>

lines.text: omnes pusilli et semitarii moechi:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="16">omnes pusilli et semitarii moechi:</l>

lines.text: tu praeter omnes une de capillatis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="17">tu praeter omnes une de capillatis,</l>

lines.text: cuniculosae Celtiberiae fili,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="18">cuniculosae Celtiberiae fili,</l>

lines.text: Egnati, opaca quem bonum facit barba
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="19">Egnati, opaca quem bonum facit barba</l>

lines.text: et dens Hibera defricatus urina.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:37" n="20">et dens Hibera defricatus urina.</l>

lines.text: Male est, Cornifici, tuo Catullo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:38" n="1">Male est, Cornifici, tuo Catullo,</l>

lines.text: male est me hercule ei et laboriose,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:38" n="2">male est me hercule ei et laboriose,</l>

lines.text: et magis magis in dies et horas.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:38" n="3">et magis magis in dies et horas.</l>

lines.text: quem tu, quod minimum facillimumque est,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:38" n="4">quem tu, quod minimum facillimumque est,</l>

lines.text: qua solatus es adlocutione?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:38" n="5">qua solatus es adlocutione?</l>

lines.text: irascor tibi.sic meos amores?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:38" n="6">irascor tibi.sic meos amores?</l>

lines.text: paulum quid libet adlocutionis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:38" n="7">paulum quid libet adlocutionis,</l>

lines.text: maestius lacrimis Simonideis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:38" n="8">maestius lacrimis Simonideis.</l>

lines.text: Egnatius, quod candidos habet dentes,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="1">Egnatius, quod candidos habet dentes,</l>

lines.text: renidet usque quaque.si ad rei ventum est
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="2">renidet usque quaque.si ad rei ventum est</l>

lines.text: subsellium, cum orator excitat fletum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="3">subsellium, cum orator excitat fletum,</l>

lines.text: renidet ille. si ad pii rogum fili
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="4">renidet ille. si ad pii rogum fili</l>

lines.text: lugetur, orba cum flet unicum mater,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="5">lugetur, orba cum flet unicum mater,</l>

lines.text: renidet ille.quidquid est, ubicumque est,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="6">renidet ille.quidquid est, ubicumque est,</l>

lines.text: quodcumque agit, renidet.hunc habet morbum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="7">quodcumque agit, renidet.hunc habet morbum</l>

lines.text: neque elegantem, ut arbitror, neque urbanum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="8">neque elegantem, ut arbitror, neque urbanum.</l>

lines.text: quare monendum est te mihi, bone Egnati.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="9">quare monendum est te mihi, bone Egnati.</l>

lines.text: si urbanus esses aut Sabinus aut Tiburs
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="10">si urbanus esses aut Sabinus aut Tiburs</l>

lines.text: aut parcus Umber aut obesus Etruscus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="11">aut parcus Umber aut obesus Etruscus</l>

lines.text: aut Lanuvinus ater atque dentatus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="12">aut Lanuvinus ater atque dentatus</l>

lines.text: aut Transpadanus, ut meos quoque attingam,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="13">aut Transpadanus, ut meos quoque attingam,</l>

lines.text: aut qui libet qui puriter lavit dentes,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="14">aut qui libet qui puriter lavit dentes,</l>

lines.text: tamen renidere usque quaque te nollem;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="15">tamen renidere usque quaque te nollem;</l>

lines.text: nam risu inepto res ineptior nulla est.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="16">nam risu inepto res ineptior nulla est.</l>

lines.text: nunc Celtiber es: Celtiberia in terra,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="17">nunc Celtiber es: Celtiberia in terra,</l>

lines.text: quod quisque minxit, hoc sibi solet mane
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="18">quod quisque minxit, hoc sibi solet mane</l>

lines.text: dentem atque russam defricare gingivam,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="19">dentem atque russam defricare gingivam,</l>

lines.text: ut quo iste vester expolitior dens est,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="20">ut quo iste vester expolitior dens est,</l>

lines.text: hoc te amplius bibisse praedicet loti.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:39" n="21">hoc te amplius bibisse praedicet loti.</l>

lines.text: Quaenam te mala mens, miselle Ravide,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:40" n="1">Quaenam te mala mens, miselle Ravide,</l>

lines.text: agit praecipitem in meos iambos?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:40" n="2">agit praecipitem in meos iambos?</l>

lines.text: quis deus tibi non bene advocatus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:40" n="3">quis deus tibi non bene advocatus</l>

lines.text: vecordem parat excitare rixam?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:40" n="4">vecordem parat excitare rixam?</l>

lines.text: an ut pervenias in ora vulgi?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:40" n="5">an ut pervenias in ora vulgi?</l>

lines.text: quid vis? qua libet esse notus optas?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:40" n="6">quid vis? qua libet esse notus optas?</l>

lines.text: eris, quandoquidem meos amores
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:40" n="7">eris, quandoquidem meos amores</l>

lines.text: cum longa voluisti amare poena.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:40" n="8">cum longa voluisti amare poena.</l>

lines.text: Ameana puella defututa
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:41" n="1">Ameana puella defututa</l>

lines.text: tota milia me decem poposcit,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:41" n="2">tota milia me decem poposcit,</l>

lines.text: ista turpiculo puella naso,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:41" n="3">ista turpiculo puella naso,</l>

lines.text: decoctoris amica Formiani.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:41" n="4">decoctoris amica Formiani.</l>

lines.text: propinqui, quibus est puella curae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:41" n="5">propinqui, quibus est puella curae,</l>

lines.text: amicos medicosque convocate:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:41" n="6">amicos medicosque convocate:</l>

lines.text: non est sana puella, nec rogare
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:41" n="7">non est sana puella, nec rogare</l>

lines.text: qualis sit solet aes imaginosum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:41" n="8">qualis sit solet aes imaginosum.</l>

lines.text: Adeste, hendecasyllabi, quot estis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="1">Adeste, hendecasyllabi, quot estis</l>

lines.text: omnes undique, quotquot estis omnes.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="2">omnes undique, quotquot estis omnes.</l>

lines.text: iocum me putat esse moecha turpis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="3">iocum me putat esse moecha turpis</l>

lines.text: et negat mihi vestra reddituram
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="4">et negat mihi vestra reddituram</l>

lines.text: pugillaria, si pati potestis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="5">pugillaria, si pati potestis.</l>

lines.text: persequamur eam, et reflagitemus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="6">persequamur eam, et reflagitemus.</l>

lines.text: quae sit quaeritis? illa quam videtis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="7">quae sit quaeritis? illa quam videtis</l>

lines.text: turpe incedere, mimice ac moleste
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="8">turpe incedere, mimice ac moleste</l>

lines.text: ridentem catuli ore Gallicani.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="9">ridentem catuli ore Gallicani.</l>

lines.text: circumsistite eam, et reflagitate:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="10">circumsistite eam, et reflagitate:</l>

lines.text: moecha putida, redde codicillos,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="11"><q rend="single">moecha putida, redde codicillos,</q></l>

lines.text: redde, putida moecha, codicillos.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="12"><q rend="single; merge">redde, putida moecha, codicillos.</q></l>

lines.text: non assis facis? o lutum, lupanar,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="13">non assis facis? o lutum, lupanar,</l>

lines.text: aut si perditius potes quid esse.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="14">aut si perditius potes quid esse.</l>

lines.text: sed non est tamen hoc satis putandum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="15">sed non est tamen hoc satis putandum.</l>

lines.text: quod si non aliud potest, ruborem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="16">quod si non aliud potest, ruborem</l>

lines.text: ferreo canis exprimamus ore.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="17">ferreo canis exprimamus ore.</l>

lines.text: conclamate iterum altiore voce
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="18">conclamate iterum altiore voce</l>

lines.text: moecha putida, redde codicillos,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="19"><q rend="single">moecha putida, redde codicillos,</q></l>

lines.text: redde, putida moecha, codicillos.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="20"><q rend="single; merge">redde, putida moecha, codicillos.</q></l>

lines.text: sed nil proficimus, nihil movetur.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="21">sed nil proficimus, nihil movetur.</l>

lines.text: mutanda est ratio modusque nobis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="22">mutanda est ratio modusque nobis,</l>

lines.text: si quid proficere amplius potestis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="23">si quid proficere amplius potestis,</l>

lines.text: pudica et proba, redde codicillos.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:42" n="24"><q rend="single">pudica et proba, redde codicillos.</q></l>

lines.text: Salve, nec minimo puella naso
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:43" n="1">Salve, nec minimo puella naso</l>

lines.text: nec bello pede nec nigris ocellis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:43" n="2">nec bello pede nec nigris ocellis</l>

lines.text: nec longis digitis nec ore sicco
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:43" n="3">nec longis digitis nec ore sicco</l>

lines.text: nec sane nimis elegante lingua,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:43" n="4">nec sane nimis elegante lingua,</l>

lines.text: decoctoris amica Formiani.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:43" n="5">decoctoris amica Formiani.</l>

lines.text: ten provincia narrat esse bellam?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:43" n="6">ten provincia narrat esse bellam?</l>

lines.text: tecum Lesbia nostra comparatur?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:43" n="7">tecum Lesbia nostra comparatur?</l>

lines.text: o saeclum insapiens et infacetum!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:43" n="8">o saeclum insapiens et infacetum!</l>

lines.text: O funde noster seu Sabine seu Tiburs
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="1">O funde noster seu Sabine seu Tiburs</l>

lines.text: (nam te esse Tiburtem autumant quibus non est
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="2">(nam te esse Tiburtem autumant quibus non est</l>

lines.text: cordi Catullum laedere: at quibus cordi est
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="3">cordi Catullum laedere: at quibus cordi est</l>

lines.text: quovis Sabinum pignore esse contendunt),
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="4">quovis Sabinum pignore esse contendunt),</l>

lines.text: sed seu Sabine sive verius Tiburs,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="5">sed seu Sabine sive verius Tiburs,</l>

lines.text: fui libenter in tua suburbana
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="6">fui libenter in tua suburbana</l>

lines.text: villa malamque pectore expuli tussim,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="7">villa malamque pectore expuli tussim,</l>

lines.text: non immerenti quam mihi meus venter,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="8">non immerenti quam mihi meus venter,</l>

lines.text: dum sumptuosas adpeto, dedit, cenas.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="9">dum sumptuosas adpeto, dedit, cenas.</l>

lines.text: nam, Sestianus dum volo esse conviva,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="10">nam, Sestianus dum volo esse conviva,</l>

lines.text: orationem in Antium petitorem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="11">orationem in Antium petitorem</l>

lines.text: plenam veneni et pestilentiae legi.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="12">plenam veneni et pestilentiae legi.</l>

lines.text: hic me gravido frigida et frequens tussis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="13">hic me gravido frigida et frequens tussis</l>

lines.text: quassavit usque dum in tuum sinum fugi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="14">quassavit usque dum in tuum sinum fugi</l>

lines.text: et me recuravi otioque et urtica.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="15">et me recuravi otioque et urtica.</l>

lines.text: quare refectus maximas tibi grates
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="16">quare refectus maximas tibi grates</l>

lines.text: ago, meum quod non es ulta peccatum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="17">ago, meum quod non es ulta peccatum.</l>

lines.text: nec deprecor iam, si nefaria scripta
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="18">nec deprecor iam, si nefaria scripta</l>

lines.text: Sesti recepso, quin gravedinem et tussim
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="19">Sesti recepso, quin gravedinem et tussim</l>

lines.text: non mi, sed ipsi Sestio ferat frigus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="20">non mi, sed ipsi Sestio ferat frigus,</l>

lines.text: qui tunc vocat me cum malum librum legi.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:44" n="21">qui tunc vocat me cum malum librum legi.</l>

lines.text: Acmen Septimius suos amores
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="1">Acmen Septimius suos amores</l>

lines.text: tenens in gremio mea, inquit, Acme,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="2">tenens in gremio <q rend="single">mea,</q> inquit, <q rend="single">Acme,</q></l>

lines.text: ni te perdite amo atque amare porro
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="3"><q rend="single; merge">ni te perdite amo atque amare porro</q></l>

lines.text: omnes sum adsidue paratus annos
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="4"><q rend="single; merge">omnes sum adsidue paratus annos</q></l>

lines.text: quantum qui pote plurimum perire,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="5"><q rend="single; merge">quantum qui pote plurimum perire,</q></l>

lines.text: solus in Libya Indiaque tosta
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="6"><q rend="single; merge">solus in Libya Indiaque tosta</q></l>

lines.text: caesio veniam obvius leoni.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="7"><q rend="single; merge">caesio veniam obvius leoni.</q></l>

lines.text: hoc ut dixit, Amor, sinistra ut ante,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="8">hoc ut dixit, Amor, sinistra ut ante,</l>

lines.text: dextra sternuit adprobationem.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="9">dextra sternuit adprobationem.</l>

lines.text: at Acme leviter caput reflectens
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="10">at Acme leviter caput reflectens</l>

lines.text: et dulcis pueri ebrios ocellos
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="11">et dulcis pueri ebrios ocellos</l>

lines.text: illo purpureo ore saviata
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="12">illo purpureo ore saviata</l>

lines.text: sic, inquit, mea vita, Septimille,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="13"><q rend="single">sic,</q> inquit, <q rend="single">mea vita, Septimille,</q></l>

lines.text: huic uni domino usque serviamus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="14"><q rend="single; merge">huic uni domino usque serviamus,</q></l>

lines.text: ut multo mihi maior acriorque
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="15"><q rend="single; merge">ut multo mihi maior acriorque</q></l>

lines.text: ignis mollibus ardet in medullis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="16"><q rend="single; merge">ignis mollibus ardet in medullis.</q></l>

lines.text: hoc ut dixit, Arnor, sinistra ut ante,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="17">hoc ut dixit, Arnor, sinistra ut ante,</l>

lines.text: dextra sternuit adprobationem.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="18">dextra sternuit adprobationem.</l>

lines.text: nunc ab auspicio bono profecti
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="19">nunc ab auspicio bono profecti</l>

lines.text: mutuis animis amant amantur.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="20">mutuis animis amant amantur.</l>

lines.text: unam Septimius misellus Acmen
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="21">unam Septimius misellus Acmen</l>

lines.text: mavult quam Syrias Britanniasque:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="22">mavult quam Syrias Britanniasque:</l>

lines.text: uno in Septimio fidelis Acme
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="23">uno in Septimio fidelis Acme</l>

lines.text: facit delicias libidinesque.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="24">facit delicias libidinesque.</l>

lines.text: quis ullos homines beatiores
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="25">quis ullos homines beatiores</l>

lines.text: vidit, quis Venerem auspicatiorem?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:45" n="26">vidit, quis Venerem auspicatiorem?</l>

lines.text: Iam ver egelidos refert tepores,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:46" n="1">Iam ver egelidos refert tepores,</l>

lines.text: iam caeli furor aequinoctialis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:46" n="2">iam caeli furor aequinoctialis</l>

lines.text: iucundis Zephyri silescit auris.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:46" n="3">iucundis Zephyri silescit auris.</l>

lines.text: linquantur Phrygii, Catulle, campi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:46" n="4">linquantur Phrygii, Catulle, campi</l>

lines.text: Nicaeaeque ager uber aestuosae:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:46" n="5">Nicaeaeque ager uber aestuosae:</l>

lines.text: ad claras Asiae volemus urbes.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:46" n="6">ad claras Asiae volemus urbes.</l>

lines.text: iam mens praetrepidans avet vagari,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:46" n="7">iam mens praetrepidans avet vagari,</l>

lines.text: iam laeti studio pedes vigescunt.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:46" n="8">iam laeti studio pedes vigescunt.</l>

lines.text: o dulces comitum valete coetus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:46" n="9">o dulces comitum valete coetus,</l>

lines.text: longe quos simul a domo profectos
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:46" n="10">longe quos simul a domo profectos</l>

lines.text: diversae variae viae reportant.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:46" n="11">diversae variae viae reportant.</l>

lines.text: Porci et Socration, duae sinistrae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:47" n="1">Porci et Socration, duae sinistrae</l>

lines.text: Pisonis, scabies famesque mundi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:47" n="2">Pisonis, scabies famesque mundi,</l>

lines.text: vos Veraniolo meo et Fabullo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:47" n="3">vos Veraniolo meo et Fabullo</l>

lines.text: verpus praeposuit Priapus ille?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:47" n="4">verpus praeposuit Priapus ille?</l>

lines.text: vos convivia lauta sumptuose
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:47" n="5">vos convivia lauta sumptuose</l>

lines.text: de die facitis? mei sodales
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:47" n="6">de die facitis? mei sodales</l>

lines.text: quaerunt in trivio vocationes?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:47" n="7">quaerunt in trivio vocationes?</l>

lines.text: Mellitos oculos tuos, Iuventi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:48" n="1">Mellitos oculos tuos, Iuventi,</l>

lines.text: siquis me sinat usque basiare,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:48" n="2">siquis me sinat usque basiare,</l>

lines.text: usque ad milia basiem trecenta,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:48" n="3">usque ad milia basiem trecenta,</l>

lines.text: nec unquam videar satur futurus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:48" n="4">nec unquam videar satur futurus,</l>

lines.text: non si densior aridis aristis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:48" n="5">non si densior aridis aristis</l>

lines.text: sit nostrae seges osculationis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:48" n="6">sit nostrae seges osculationis.</l>

lines.text: Disertissime Romuli nepotum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:49" n="1">Disertissime Romuli nepotum,</l>

lines.text: quot sunt quotque fuere, Marce Tulli,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:49" n="2">quot sunt quotque fuere, Marce Tulli,</l>

lines.text: quotque post aliis erunt in annis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:49" n="3">quotque post aliis erunt in annis,</l>

lines.text: gratias tibi maximas Catullus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:49" n="4">gratias tibi maximas Catullus</l>

lines.text: agit pessimus omnium poeta,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:49" n="5">agit pessimus omnium poeta,</l>

lines.text: tanto pessimus omnium poeta
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:49" n="6">tanto pessimus omnium poeta</l>

lines.text: quanto tu optimus omnium patronus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:49" n="7">quanto tu optimus omnium patronus.</l>

lines.text: Hesterno, Licini, die otiosi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="1">Hesterno, Licini, die otiosi</l>

lines.text: multum lusimus in meis tabellis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="2">multum lusimus in meis tabellis,</l>

lines.text: ut convenerat esse delicatos.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="3">ut convenerat esse delicatos.</l>

lines.text: scribens versiculos uterque nostrum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="4">scribens versiculos uterque nostrum</l>

lines.text: ludebat numero modo hoc modo illoc,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="5">ludebat numero modo hoc modo illoc,</l>

lines.text: reddens mutua per iocum atque vinum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="6">reddens mutua per iocum atque vinum.</l>

lines.text: atque illinc abii tuo lepore
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="7">atque illinc abii tuo lepore</l>

lines.text: incensus, Licini, facetiisque,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="8">incensus, Licini, facetiisque,</l>

lines.text: ut nec me miserum cibus iuvaret,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="9">ut nec me miserum cibus iuvaret,</l>

lines.text: nec somnus tegeret quiete ocellos,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="10">nec somnus tegeret quiete ocellos,</l>

lines.text: sed toto indomitus furore lecto
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="11">sed toto indomitus furore lecto</l>

lines.text: versarer cupiens videre lucem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="12">versarer cupiens videre lucem,</l>

lines.text: ut tecum loquerer simulque ut essem.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="13">ut tecum loquerer simulque ut essem.</l>

lines.text: at defessa labore membra postquam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="14">at defessa labore membra postquam</l>

lines.text: semimortua lectulo iacebant,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="15">semimortua lectulo iacebant,</l>

lines.text: hoc, iucunde, tibi poema feci,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="16">hoc, iucunde, tibi poema feci,</l>

lines.text: ex quo perspiceres meum dolorem.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="17">ex quo perspiceres meum dolorem.</l>

lines.text: nunc audax cave sis, precesque nostras,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="18">nunc audax cave sis, precesque nostras,</l>

lines.text: oramus, cave despuas, ocelle,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="19">oramus, cave despuas, ocelle,</l>

lines.text: ne poenas Nemesis reposcat a te.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="20">ne poenas Nemesis reposcat a te.</l>

lines.text: est vehemens dea: laedere hanc caveto.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:50" n="21">est vehemens dea: laedere hanc caveto.</l>

lines.text: Ille mi par esse deo videtur,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:51" n="1">Ille mi par esse deo videtur,</l>

lines.text: ille, si fas est, superare divos
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:51" n="2">ille, si fas est, superare divos</l>

lines.text: qui sedens adversus identidem te
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:51" n="3">qui sedens adversus identidem te</l>

lines.text: spectat et audit
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:51" n="4">spectat et audit</l>

lines.text: dulce ridentem, misero quod omnis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:51" n="5">dulce ridentem, misero quod omnis</l>

lines.text: eripit sensus mihi: nam simul te,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:51" n="6">eripit sensus mihi: nam simul te,</l>

lines.text: Lesbia, adspexi, nihil est super mi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:51" n="7">Lesbia, adspexi, nihil est super mi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:51" n="8"><gap reason="lost" rend=" . . . ."/></l>

lines.text: lingua sed torpet, tenuis sub artus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:51" n="9">lingua sed torpet, tenuis sub artus</l>

lines.text: flamma demanat, sonitu suopte
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:51" n="10">flamma demanat, sonitu suopte</l>

lines.text: tintinant aures, gemina teguntur
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:51" n="11">tintinant aures, gemina teguntur</l>

lines.text: lumina nocte.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:51" n="12">lumina nocte.</l>

lines.text: otium, Catulle, tibi molestum est:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:51" n="13">otium, Catulle, tibi molestum est:<note resp="perseus" xml:lang="eng">Lines 13-16 are  labeled as poem 51a or 51b in some editions. Merrill does not make that distinction.</note></l>

lines.text: otio exsultas nimiumque gestis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:51" n="14">otio exsultas nimiumque gestis.</l>

lines.text: otium et reges prius et beatas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:51" n="15">otium et reges prius et beatas</l>

lines.text: perdidit urbes.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:51" n="16">perdidit urbes.</l>

notes: Lines 13-16 are labeled as poem 51a or 51b in some editions. Merrill does not make that distinction.

lines.text: Quid est, Catulle? quid moraris emori?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:52" n="1">Quid est, Catulle? quid moraris emori?</l>

lines.text: sella in curuli struma Nonius sedet,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:52" n="2">sella in curuli struma Nonius sedet,</l>

lines.text: per consulatum perierat Vatinius:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:52" n="3">per consulatum perierat Vatinius:</l>

lines.text: quid est, Catulle? quid moraris emori?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:52" n="4">quid est, Catulle? quid moraris emori?</l>

lines.text: Risi nescio quem modo e corona,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:53" n="1">Risi nescio quem modo e corona,</l>

lines.text: qui, cum mirifice Vatiniana
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:53" n="2">qui, cum mirifice Vatiniana</l>

lines.text: meus crimina Calvus explicasset,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:53" n="3">meus crimina Calvus explicasset,</l>

lines.text: admirans ait haec manusque tollens
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:53" n="4">admirans ait haec manusque tollens</l>

lines.text: di magni, salaputium disertum!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:53" n="5"><q rend="single">di magni, salaputium disertum!</q></l>

lines.text: Othonis caput oppido est pusillum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:54" n="1">Othonis caput oppido est pusillum,</l>

<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:54" n="1a"><gap reason="lost" rend="*"/><note resp="perseus" xml:lang="mul">Lacunam proposuit Merrill; MSS have 50.16-17</note></l>

lines.text: et eri rustica semilauta crura,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:54" n="2">et eri rustica semilauta crura,</l>

lines.text: subtile et leve peditum Libonis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:54" n="3">subtile et leve peditum Libonis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:54" n="3a"><gap reason="lost" rend="*"/></l>

lines.text: si non omnia, displicere vellem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:54" n="4">si non omnia, displicere vellem</l>

lines.text: tibi et Fuficio, seni recocto
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:54" n="5">tibi et Fuficio, seni recocto</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:54" n="5a"><gap reason="lost" rend="*"/></l>

lines.text: irascere iterum meis iambis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:54" n="6">irascere iterum meis iambis<note resp="perseus" xml:lang="eng">Lines 6-7 (with or without a gap preceding) are labeled as 54a or 54b in some editions.</note></l>

lines.text: immerentibus, unice imperator.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:54" n="7">immerentibus, unice imperator.</l>

notes: Lacunam proposuit Merrill; MSS have 50.16-17
Lines 6-7 (with or without a gap preceding) are labeled as 54a or 54b in some editions.

lines.text: Oramus, si forte non molestum est,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="1">Oramus, si forte non molestum est,</l>

lines.text: demonstres ubi sint tuae tenebrae.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="2">demonstres ubi sint tuae tenebrae.</l>

lines.text: te campo quaesivimus minore,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="3">te campo quaesivimus minore,</l>

lines.text: te in circo, te in omnibus libellis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="4">te in circo, te in omnibus libellis,</l>

lines.text: te in templo summi Iovis sacrato.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="5">te in templo summi Iovis sacrato.</l>

lines.text: in Magni simul ambulatione
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="6">in Magni simul ambulatione</l>

lines.text: femellas omnes, amice, prendi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="7">femellas omnes, amice, prendi,</l>

lines.text: quas vultu vidi tamen serenas.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="8">quas vultu vidi tamen serenas.</l>

lines.text: † A velte sic ipse flagitabam:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="9">† A velte sic ipse flagitabam:</l>

lines.text: camerium mihi, pessimae puellae!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="10"><q rend="single">camerium mihi, pessimae puellae!</q></l>

lines.text: quaedam inquit nudum † reduc †
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="11">quaedam inquit nudum † reduc †</l>

lines.text: en hic in roseis latet papillis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="12"><q rend="single">en hic in roseis latet papillis.</q></l>

lines.text: sed te iam ferre Herculi labos est:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="13">sed te iam ferre Herculi labos est:</l>

lines.text: Non custos si fingar ille Cretum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="23"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="58b_1"/>Non custos si fingar ille Cretum,<note resp="perseus" xml:lang="eng">Lines 23-32 are labeled as 58b in the print edition but are presented as part of poem 55 here.</note></l>

lines.text: non si Pegaseo ferar volatu,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="24"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="58b_2"/>non si Pegaseo ferar volatu,</l>

lines.text: non Ladas ego pinnipesve Perseus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="25"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="58b_3"/>non Ladas ego pinnipesve Perseus,</l>

lines.text: non Rhesi niveae citaeque bigae:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="26"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="58b_4"/>non Rhesi niveae citaeque bigae:</l>

lines.text: adde huc plumipedes volatilesque,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="27"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="58b_5"/>adde huc plumipedes volatilesque,</l>

lines.text: ventorumque simul require cursum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="28"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="58b_6"/>ventorumque simul require cursum,</l>

lines.text: quos vinctos, Cameri, mihi dicares:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="29"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="58b_7"/>quos vinctos, Cameri, mihi dicares:</l>

lines.text: defessus tamen omnibus medullis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="30"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="58b_8"/>defessus tamen omnibus medullis</l>

lines.text: et multis langoribus peresus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="31"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="58b_9"/>et multis langoribus peresus</l>

lines.text: essem te mihi, amice, quaeritando.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="32"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="58b_10"/>essem te mihi, amice, quaeritando.</l>

lines.text: tanto ten fastu negas, amice?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="14">tanto ten fastu negas, amice?</l>

lines.text: dic nobis ubi sis futurus, ede
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="15">dic nobis ubi sis futurus, ede</l>

lines.text: audacter, committe, crede luci.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="16">audacter, committe, crede luci.</l>

lines.text: nunc te lacteolae tenent puellae?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="17">nunc te lacteolae tenent puellae?</l>

lines.text: si linguam clauso tenes in ore,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="18">si linguam clauso tenes in ore,</l>

lines.text: fructus proicies amoris omnes:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="19">fructus proicies amoris omnes:</l>

lines.text: verbosa gaudet Venus loquella.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="20">verbosa gaudet Venus loquella.</l>

lines.text: vel vi vis, licet obseres palatum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="21">vel vi vis, licet obseres palatum,</l>

lines.text: dum veri sis particeps amoris.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:55" n="22">dum veri sis particeps amoris.</l>

notes: Lines 23-32 are labeled as 58b in the print edition but are presented as part of poem 55 here.

lines.text: O rem ridiculam, Cato, et iocosam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:56" n="1">O rem ridiculam, Cato, et iocosam</l>

lines.text: dignamque auribus et tuo cachinno.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:56" n="2">dignamque auribus et tuo cachinno.</l>

lines.text: ride, quidquid amas, Cato, Catullum:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:56" n="3">ride, quidquid amas, Cato, Catullum:</l>

lines.text: res est ridicula et nimis iocosa.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:56" n="4">res est ridicula et nimis iocosa.</l>

lines.text: deprendi modo pupulum puellae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:56" n="5">deprendi modo pupulum puellae</l>

lines.text: trusantem: hunc ego, si placet Dionae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:56" n="6">trusantem: hunc ego, si placet Dionae,</l>

lines.text: pro telo rigida mea cecidi.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:56" n="7">pro telo rigida mea cecidi.</l>

lines.text: Pulchre convenit improbis cinaedis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:57" n="1">Pulchre convenit improbis cinaedis,</l>

lines.text: Mamurrae pathicoque Caesarique.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:57" n="2">Mamurrae pathicoque Caesarique.</l>

lines.text: nec mirum: maculae pares utrisque,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:57" n="3">nec mirum: maculae pares utrisque,</l>

lines.text: urbana altera et illa Formiana,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:57" n="4">urbana altera et illa Formiana,</l>

lines.text: impressae resident nec eluentur:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:57" n="5">impressae resident nec eluentur:</l>

lines.text: morbosi pariter gemelli utrique,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:57" n="6">morbosi pariter gemelli utrique,</l>

lines.text: uno in lecticulo erudituli ambo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:57" n="7">uno in lecticulo erudituli ambo,</l>

lines.text: non hic quam ille magis vorax adulter,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:57" n="8">non hic quam ille magis vorax adulter,</l>

lines.text: rivales socii puellularum:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:57" n="9">rivales socii puellularum:</l>

lines.text: pulchre convenit improbis cinaedis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:57" n="10">pulchre convenit improbis cinaedis.</l>

lines.text: Caeli, Lesbia nostra, Lesbia illa,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:58" n="1">Caeli, Lesbia nostra, Lesbia illa,</l>

lines.text: illa Lesbia, quam Catullus unam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:58" n="2">illa Lesbia, quam Catullus unam</l>

lines.text: plus quam se atque suos amavit omnes,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:58" n="3">plus quam se atque suos amavit omnes,</l>

lines.text: nunc in quadriviis et angiportis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:58" n="4">nunc in quadriviis et angiportis</l>

lines.text: glubit magnanimi Remi nepotes.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:58" n="5">glubit magnanimi Remi nepotes.</l>

lines.text: Bononiensis Rufa Rufulum fellat,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:59" n="1">Bononiensis Rufa Rufulum fellat,</l>

lines.text: uxor Meneni, saepe quam in sepulcretis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:59" n="2">uxor Meneni, saepe quam in sepulcretis</l>

lines.text: vidistis ipso rapere de rogo cenam,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:59" n="3">vidistis ipso rapere de rogo cenam,</l>

lines.text: cum devolutum ex igne prosequens panem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:59" n="4">cum devolutum ex igne prosequens panem</l>

lines.text: ab semiraso tunderetur ustore.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:59" n="5">ab semiraso tunderetur ustore.</l>

lines.text: Num te leaena montibus Libystinis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:60" n="1">Num te leaena montibus Libystinis</l>

lines.text: aut Scylla latrans infima inguinum parte
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:60" n="2">aut Scylla latrans infima inguinum parte</l>

lines.text: tam mente dura procreavit ac taetra,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:60" n="3">tam mente dura procreavit ac taetra,</l>

lines.text: ut supplicis vocem in novissimo casu
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:60" n="4">ut supplicis vocem in novissimo casu</l>

lines.text: contemptam haberes, ah nimis fero corde?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:60" n="5">contemptam haberes, ah nimis fero corde?</l>

metre_milestone: Four second Glyconics catalectic and one second Pherecratic acatalectic

lines.text: Collis o Heliconii
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="1">Collis o Heliconii</l>

lines.text: cultor, Uraniae genus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="2">cultor, Uraniae genus,</l>

lines.text: qui rapis teneram ad virum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="3">qui rapis teneram ad virum</l>

lines.text: virginem, o Hymenaee Hymen,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="4">virginem, o Hymenaee Hymen,</l>

lines.text: o Hymen Hymenaee,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="5">o Hymen Hymenaee,</l>

lines.text: cinge tempora floribus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="6">cinge tempora floribus</l>

lines.text: suave olentis amaraci,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="7">suave olentis amaraci,</l>

lines.text: flammeum cape, laetus huc,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="8">flammeum cape, laetus huc,</l>

lines.text: huc veni niveo gerens
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="9">huc veni niveo gerens</l>

lines.text: luteum pede soccum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="10">luteum pede soccum,</l>

lines.text: excitusque hilari die
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="11">excitusque hilari die</l>

lines.text: nuptialia concinens
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="12">nuptialia concinens</l>

lines.text: voce carmina tinnula
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="13">voce carmina tinnula</l>

lines.text: pelle humum pedibus, manu
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="14">pelle humum pedibus, manu</l>

lines.text: pineam quate taedam.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="15">pineam quate taedam.</l>

lines.text: namque Vinia Manilo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="16">namque Vinia Manilo,</l>

lines.text: qualis Idalium colens
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="17">qualis Idalium colens</l>

lines.text: venit ad Phrygium Venus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="18">venit ad Phrygium Venus</l>

lines.text: iudicem, bona cum bona
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="19">iudicem, bona cum bona</l>

lines.text: nubet alite virgo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="20">nubet alite virgo,</l>

lines.text: floridis velut enitens
