lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="214">nomen esse, sed indidem</l>

lines.text: semper ingenerari.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="215">semper ingenerari.</l>

lines.text: Torquatus volo parvulus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="216">Torquatus volo parvulus</l>

lines.text: matris e gremio suae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="217">matris e gremio suae</l>

lines.text: porrigens teneras manus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="218">porrigens teneras manus</l>

lines.text: dulce rideat ad patrem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="219">dulce rideat ad patrem</l>

lines.text: semihiante labello.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="220">semihiante labello.</l>

lines.text: sit suo similis patri
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="221">sit suo similis patri</l>

lines.text: Manlio et facile insciis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="222">Manlio et facile insciis</l>

lines.text: noscitetur ab omnibus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="223">noscitetur ab omnibus</l>

lines.text: et pudicitiam suae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="224">et pudicitiam suae</l>

lines.text: matris indicet ore.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="225">matris indicet ore.</l>

lines.text: talis illius a bona
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="226">talis illius a bona</l>

lines.text: matre laus genus adprobet
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="227">matre laus genus adprobet</l>

lines.text: qualis unica ab optima
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="228">qualis unica ab optima</l>

lines.text: matre Telemacho manet
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="229">matre Telemacho manet</l>

lines.text: fama Penelopeo.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="230">fama Penelopeo.</l>

lines.text: claudite ostia, virgines:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="231">claudite ostia, virgines:</l>

lines.text: lusimus satis. at, boni
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="232">lusimus satis. at, boni</l>

lines.text: coniuges, bene vivite et
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="233">coniuges, bene vivite et</l>

lines.text: munere adsiduo valentem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="234">munere adsiduo valentem</l>

lines.text: exercete iuventam.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:61" n="235">exercete iuventam.</l>

lines.text: Vesper adest: iuvenes, consurgite: vesper Olympo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="1">Vesper adest: iuvenes, consurgite: vesper Olympo</l>

lines.text: exspectata diu vix tandem lumina tollit.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="2">exspectata diu vix tandem lumina tollit.</l>

lines.text: surgere iam tempus, iam pinguis linquere mensas;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="3">surgere iam tempus, iam pinguis linquere mensas;</l>

lines.text: iam veniet virgo, iam dicetur hymenaeus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="4">iam veniet virgo, iam dicetur hymenaeus.</l>

lines.text: Hymen O Hymenaee, Hymen ades O Hymenaee.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="5">Hymen O Hymenaee, Hymen ades O Hymenaee.</l>

lines.text: cernitis, innuptae, iuvenes? consurgite contra:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="6">cernitis, innuptae, iuvenes? consurgite contra:</l>

lines.text: nimirum Oetaeos ostendit Noctifer ignes.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="7">nimirum Oetaeos ostendit Noctifer ignes.</l>

lines.text: sic certe est: viden ut perniciter exsiluere?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="8">sic certe est: viden ut perniciter exsiluere?</l>

lines.text: non temere exsiluere; canent quod vincere par est.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="9">non temere exsiluere; canent quod vincere par est.</l>

lines.text: Hymen O Hymenaee, Hymen ades O Hymenaee.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="10">Hymen O Hymenaee, Hymen ades O Hymenaee.</l>

lines.text: non facilis nobis, aequales, palma parata est:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="11">non facilis nobis, aequales, palma parata est:</l>

lines.text: adspicite, innuptae secum ut meditata requirunt.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="12">adspicite, innuptae secum ut meditata requirunt.</l>

lines.text: non frustra meditantur; habent memorabile quod sit.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="13">non frustra meditantur; habent memorabile quod sit.</l>

lines.text: nec mirum, penitus quae tota mente laborant.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="14">nec mirum, penitus quae tota mente laborant.</l>

lines.text: nos alio mentes, alio divisimus aures:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="15">nos alio mentes, alio divisimus aures:</l>

lines.text: iure igitur vincemur; amat victoria curam.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="16">iure igitur vincemur; amat victoria curam.</l>

lines.text: quare nunc animos saltem convertite vestros:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="17">quare nunc animos saltem convertite vestros:</l>

lines.text: dicere iam incipient, iam respondere decebit.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="18">dicere iam incipient, iam respondere decebit.</l>

lines.text: Hymen o Hymenaee, Hymen ades o Hymenaee.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="19">Hymen o Hymenaee, Hymen ades o Hymenaee.</l>

lines.text: Hespere, qui caelo fertur crudelior ignis?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="20">Hespere, qui caelo fertur crudelior ignis?</l>

lines.text: qui natam possis complexu avellere matris,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="21">qui natam possis complexu avellere matris,</l>

lines.text: complexu matris retinentem avellere natam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="22">complexu matris retinentem avellere natam</l>

lines.text: et iuveni ardenti castam donare puellam.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="23">et iuveni ardenti castam donare puellam.</l>

lines.text: quid faciunt hostes capta crudelius urbe?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="24">quid faciunt hostes capta crudelius urbe?</l>

lines.text: Hymen o Hymenaee, Hymen ades o Hymenaee.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="25">Hymen o Hymenaee, Hymen ades o Hymenaee.</l>

lines.text: Hespere, qui caelo lucet iucundior ignis?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="26">Hespere, qui caelo lucet iucundior ignis?</l>

lines.text: qui desponsa tua firmes conubia flammma,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="27">qui desponsa tua firmes conubia flammma,</l>

lines.text: quae pepigere viri, pepigerunt ante parentes,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="28">quae pepigere viri, pepigerunt ante parentes,</l>

lines.text: nec iunxere prius quam se tuus extulit ardor.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="29">nec iunxere prius quam se tuus extulit ardor.</l>

lines.text: quid datur a divis felici optatius hora?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="30">quid datur a divis felici optatius hora?</l>

lines.text: Hymen o Hymenaee, Hymen ades o Hymenaee.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="31">Hymen o Hymenaee, Hymen ades o Hymenaee.</l>

lines.text: Hesperus e nobis, aequales, abstulit unam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="32">Hesperus e nobis, aequales, abstulit unam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="32a"><gap reason="lost" rend="*"/></l>

lines.text: namque tuo adventu vigilat custodia semper.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="33">namque tuo adventu vigilat custodia semper.</l>

lines.text: nocte latent fures, quos idem saepe revertens,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="34">nocte latent fures, quos idem saepe revertens,</l>

lines.text: Hespere, mutato comprendis nomine eosdem.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="35">Hespere, mutato comprendis nomine eosdem.</l>

lines.text: at libet innuptis ficto te carpere questu.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="36">at libet innuptis ficto te carpere questu.</l>

lines.text: quid tum, si carpunt tacita quem mente requirunt?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="37">quid tum, si carpunt tacita quem mente requirunt?</l>

lines.text: Hymen o Hymenaee, Hymen ades o Hymenaee.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="38">Hymen o Hymenaee, Hymen ades o Hymenaee.</l>

lines.text: ut flos in saeptis secretus nascitur hortis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="39">ut flos in saeptis secretus nascitur hortis,</l>

lines.text: ignotus pecori, nullo convulsus aratro,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="40">ignotus pecori, nullo convulsus aratro,</l>

lines.text: quem mulcent aurae, firmat sol, educat imber,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="41">quem mulcent aurae, firmat sol, educat imber,</l>

lines.text: multi illum pueri, multae optavere puellae;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="42">multi illum pueri, multae optavere puellae;</l>

lines.text: idem cum tenui carptus defloruit ungui,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="43">idem cum tenui carptus defloruit ungui,</l>

lines.text: nulli illum pueri, nullae optavere puellae:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="44">nulli illum pueri, nullae optavere puellae:</l>

lines.text: sic virgo, dum intacta manet, dum cara suis est;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="45">sic virgo, dum intacta manet, dum cara suis est;</l>

lines.text: cum castum amisit polluto corpore florem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="46">cum castum amisit polluto corpore florem,</l>

lines.text: nec pueris iucunda manet nec cara puellis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="47">nec pueris iucunda manet nec cara puellis.</l>

lines.text: Hymen o Hymenaee, Hymen ades o Hymenaee.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="48">Hymen o Hymenaee, Hymen ades o Hymenaee.</l>

lines.text: ut vidua in nudo vitis quae nascitur arvo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="49">ut vidua in nudo vitis quae nascitur arvo</l>

lines.text: nunquam se extollit, nunquam mitem educat uvam,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="50">nunquam se extollit, nunquam mitem educat uvam,</l>

lines.text: sed tenerum prono deflectens pondere corpus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="51">sed tenerum prono deflectens pondere corpus</l>

lines.text: iam iam contingit summum radice flagellum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="52">iam iam contingit summum radice flagellum,</l>

lines.text: hanc nulli agricolae, nulli accoluere iuvenci;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="53">hanc nulli agricolae, nulli accoluere iuvenci;</l>

lines.text: at si forte eadem est ulmo coniuncta marito,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="54">at si forte eadem est ulmo coniuncta marito,</l>

lines.text: multi illam agricolae, multi accoluere iuvenci:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="55">multi illam agricolae, multi accoluere iuvenci:</l>

lines.text: sic virgo, dum intacta manet, dum inculta senescit;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="56">sic virgo, dum intacta manet, dum inculta senescit;</l>

lines.text: cum par conubium maturo tempore adepta est,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="57">cum par conubium maturo tempore adepta est,</l>

lines.text: cara viro magis et minus est invisa parenti.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="58">cara viro magis et minus est invisa parenti.</l>

lines.text: et tu ne pugna cum tali coniuge, virgo.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="59">et tu ne pugna cum tali coniuge, virgo.</l>

lines.text: non aequum est pugnare, pater cui tradidit ipse,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="60">non aequum est pugnare, pater cui tradidit ipse,</l>

lines.text: ipse pater cum matre, quibus parere necesse est.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="61">ipse pater cum matre, quibus parere necesse est.</l>

lines.text: virginitas non tota tua est, ex parte parentum est:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:62" n="62">virginitas non tota tua est, ex parte parentum est:</l>

lines.text: tertia pars patri, pars est data tertia matri,

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:63" n="4">stimulatus ibi furenti rabie, vagus animis</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:63" n="7">etiam recente terrae sola sanguine maculans</l>

lines.text: ubi capita maenades vi iaciunt hederigerae,

lines.text: quo nos decet citatis celerare tripudiis.

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:63" n="38">abit in quiete molli rabidus furor animi.</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:63" n="45">simul ipsa pectore Attis sua facta recoluit,</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:63" n="51"><q rend="single; merge">ego quam miser relinquens, dominos ut erifugae</q></l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:63" n="53"><q rend="single; merge">ut apud nivem et ferarum gelida stabula forem</q></l>

lines.text: et earum omnia adirem furibunda latibula,

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:63" n="60"><q rend="single; merge">abero foro, palaestra, stadio, et gymnasiis?</q></l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:63" n="61"><q rend="single; merge">miser ah miser, querendum est etiam atque etiam, anime.</q></l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="377"><q rend="single; merge">hesterno collum poterit circumdare filo</q></l>

lines.text: (currite ducentes subtegmina, currite, fusi),
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="378"><q rend="single; merge">(currite ducentes subtegmina, currite, fusi),</q></l>

lines.text: anxia nec mater discordis maesta puellae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="379"><q rend="single; merge">anxia nec mater discordis maesta puellae</q></l>

lines.text: secubitu caros mittet sperare nepotes.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="380"><q rend="single; merge">secubitu caros mittet sperare nepotes.</q></l>

lines.text: currite ducentes subtegmina, currite, fusi.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="381"><q rend="single; merge">currite ducentes subtegmina, currite, fusi.</q></l>

lines.text: talia praefantes quondam felicia Pelei
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="382" rend="align(indent)">talia praefantes quondam felicia Pelei</l>

lines.text: carmina divino cecinerunt pectore Parcae.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="383">carmina divino cecinerunt pectore Parcae.</l>

lines.text: praesentes namque ante domos invisere castas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="384">praesentes namque ante domos invisere castas</l>

lines.text: heroum et sese mortali ostendere coetu
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="385">heroum et sese mortali ostendere coetu</l>

lines.text: caelicolae nondum spreta pietate solebant.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="386">caelicolae nondum spreta pietate solebant.</l>

lines.text: saepe pater divum templo in fulgente, revisens
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="387">saepe pater divum templo in fulgente, revisens</l>

lines.text: annua cum festis venissent sacra diebus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="388">annua cum festis venissent sacra diebus,</l>

lines.text: conspexit terra centum procumbere tauros.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="389">conspexit terra centum procumbere tauros.</l>

lines.text: saepe vagus Liber Parnasi vertice summo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="390">saepe vagus Liber Parnasi vertice summo</l>

lines.text: Thyiadas effusis euantis crinibus egit,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="391">Thyiadas effusis euantis crinibus egit,</l>

lines.text: cum Delphi tota certatim ex urbe ruentes
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="392">cum Delphi tota certatim ex urbe ruentes</l>

lines.text: acciperent laeti divum fumantibus aris.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="393">acciperent laeti divum fumantibus aris.</l>

lines.text: saepe in letifero belli certamine Mavors
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="394">saepe in letifero belli certamine Mavors</l>

lines.text: aut rapidi Tritonis era aut Rhamnusia virgo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="395">aut rapidi Tritonis era aut Rhamnusia virgo</l>

lines.text: armatas hominum est praesens hortata catervas.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="396">armatas hominum est praesens hortata catervas.</l>

lines.text: sed postquam tellus scelere est imbuta nefando,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="397">sed postquam tellus scelere est imbuta nefando,</l>

lines.text: iustitiamque omnes cupida de mente fugarunt,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="398">iustitiamque omnes cupida de mente fugarunt,</l>

lines.text: perfudere manus fraterno sanguine fratres,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="399">perfudere manus fraterno sanguine fratres,</l>

lines.text: destitit exstinctos natus lugere parentes,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="400">destitit exstinctos natus lugere parentes,</l>

lines.text: optavit genitor primaevi funera nati
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="401">optavit genitor primaevi funera nati</l>

lines.text: Liber ut innuptae poteretur flore novercae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="402">Liber ut innuptae poteretur flore novercae,</l>

lines.text: ignaro mater substernens se impia nato
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="403">ignaro mater substernens se impia nato</l>

lines.text: impia non verita est divos scelerare parentes,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="404">impia non verita est divos scelerare parentes,</l>

lines.text: omnia fanda nefanda malo permixta furore
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="405">omnia fanda nefanda malo permixta furore</l>

lines.text: iustificam nobis mentem avertere deorum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="406">iustificam nobis mentem avertere deorum.</l>

lines.text: quare nec talis dignantur visere coetus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="407">quare nec talis dignantur visere coetus</l>

lines.text: nec se contingi patiuntur lumine claro.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:64" n="408">nec se contingi patiuntur lumine claro.</l>

lines.text: Etsi me adsiduo defectum cura dolore
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="1">Etsi me adsiduo defectum cura dolore</l>

lines.text: sevocat a doctis, Ortale, virginibus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="2">sevocat a doctis, Ortale, virginibus,</l>

lines.text: nec potis est dulcis Musarum expromere fetus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="3">nec potis est dulcis Musarum expromere fetus</l>

lines.text: mens animi: tantis fluctuat ipsa malis,—
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="4">mens animi: tantis fluctuat ipsa malis,—</l>

lines.text: namque mei nuper Lethaeo gurgite fratris
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="5">namque mei nuper Lethaeo gurgite fratris</l>

lines.text: pallidulum manans adluit unda pedem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="6">pallidulum manans adluit unda pedem,</l>

lines.text: Troia Rhoeteo quem subter litore tellus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="7">Troia Rhoeteo quem subter litore tellus</l>

lines.text: Ereptum nostris obterit ex oculis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="8">Ereptum nostris obterit ex oculis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="9"><gap reason="lost" rend=" . . . . . . . "/></l>

lines.text: nunquam ego te vita frater amabilior
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="10">nunquam ego te vita frater amabilior</l>

lines.text: adspiciam posthac: at certe semper amabo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="11">adspiciam posthac: at certe semper amabo,</l>

lines.text: semper maesta tua carmina morte canam,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="12">semper maesta tua carmina morte canam,</l>

lines.text: qualia sub densis ramorum concinit umbris
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="13">qualia sub densis ramorum concinit umbris</l>

lines.text: Daulias absumpti fata gemens Ityli,—
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="14">Daulias absumpti fata gemens Ityli,—</l>

lines.text: sed tamen in tantis maeroribus, Ortale, mitto
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="15">sed tamen in tantis maeroribus, Ortale, mitto</l>

lines.text: haec expressa tibi carmina Battiadae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="16">haec expressa tibi carmina Battiadae,</l>

lines.text: ne tua dicta vagis nequiquam credita ventis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="17">ne tua dicta vagis nequiquam credita ventis</l>

lines.text: effluxisse meo forte putes animo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="18">effluxisse meo forte putes animo,</l>

lines.text: ut missum sponsi furtivo munere malum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="19">ut missum sponsi furtivo munere malum</l>

lines.text: procurrit casto virginis e gremio,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="20">procurrit casto virginis e gremio,</l>

lines.text: quod miserae oblitae molli sub veste locatum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="21">quod miserae oblitae molli sub veste locatum,</l>

lines.text: dum adventu matris prosilit, excutitur;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="22">dum adventu matris prosilit, excutitur;</l>

lines.text: atque illud prono praeceps agitur decursu,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="23">atque illud prono praeceps agitur decursu,</l>

lines.text: huic manat tristi conscius ore rubor.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:65" n="24">huic manat tristi conscius ore rubor.</l>

lines.text: Omnia qui magni dispexit lumina mundi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="1">Omnia qui magni dispexit lumina mundi,</l>

lines.text: qui stellarum ortus comperit atque obitus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="2">qui stellarum ortus comperit atque obitus,</l>

lines.text: flammeus ut rapidi solis nitor obscuretur,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="3">flammeus ut rapidi solis nitor obscuretur,</l>

lines.text: ut cedant certis sidera temporibus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="4">ut cedant certis sidera temporibus,</l>

lines.text: ut Triviam furtim sub Latmia saxa relegans
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="5">ut Triviam furtim sub Latmia saxa relegans</l>

lines.text: dulcis amor gyro devocet aerio,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="6">dulcis amor gyro devocet aerio,</l>

lines.text: idem me ille Conon caelesti in lumine vidit
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="7">idem me ille Conon caelesti in lumine vidit</l>

lines.text: e Bereniceo vertice caesariem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="8">e Bereniceo vertice caesariem</l>

lines.text: fulgentem clare, quam cunctis illa deorum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="9">fulgentem clare, quam cunctis illa deorum</l>

lines.text: levia protendens bracchia pollicita est,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="10">levia protendens bracchia pollicita est,</l>

lines.text: qua rex tempestate novo auctus hymenaeo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="11">qua rex tempestate novo auctus hymenaeo</l>

lines.text: vastatum finis iuerat Assyrios,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="12">vastatum finis iuerat Assyrios,</l>

lines.text: dulcia nocturnae portans vestigia rixae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="13">dulcia nocturnae portans vestigia rixae</l>

lines.text: quam de virgineis gesserat exuviis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="14">quam de virgineis gesserat exuviis.</l>

lines.text: estne novis nuptis odio Venus, atque parentum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="15">estne novis nuptis odio Venus, atque parentum</l>

lines.text: frustrantur falsis gaudia lacrimulis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="16">frustrantur falsis gaudia lacrimulis</l>

lines.text: ubertim thalami quas intra limina fundunt?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="17">ubertim thalami quas intra limina fundunt?</l>

lines.text: non, ita me divi vera gemunt, iuerint.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="18">non, ita me divi vera gemunt, iuerint.</l>

lines.text: id mea me multis docuit regina querelis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="19">id mea me multis docuit regina querelis</l>

lines.text: invisente novo proelia torva viro.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="20">invisente novo proelia torva viro.</l>

lines.text: at tu non orbum luxti deserta cubile,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="21">at tu non orbum luxti deserta cubile,</l>

lines.text: sed fratris cari flebile discidium?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="22">sed fratris cari flebile discidium?</l>

lines.text: quam penitus maestas exedit cura medullas!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="23">quam penitus maestas exedit cura medullas!</l>

lines.text: ut tibi tunc toto pectore sollicitae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="24">ut tibi tunc toto pectore sollicitae</l>

lines.text: sensibus ereptis mens excidit! at te ego certe
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="25">sensibus ereptis mens excidit! at te ego certe</l>

lines.text: cognoram a parva virgine magnanimam.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="26">cognoram a parva virgine magnanimam.</l>

lines.text: anne bonum oblita es facinus, quo regium adepta es
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="27">anne bonum oblita es facinus, quo regium adepta es</l>

lines.text: coniugium, quod non fortior ausit alis?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="28">coniugium, quod non fortior ausit alis?</l>

lines.text: sed tum maesta virum mittens quae verba locuta es!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="29">sed tum maesta virum mittens quae verba locuta es!</l>

lines.text: Iuppiter, ut tristi lumina saepe manu!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="30">Iuppiter, ut tristi lumina saepe manu!</l>

lines.text: quis te mutavit tantus deus? an quod amantes
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="31">quis te mutavit tantus deus? an quod amantes</l>

lines.text: non longe a caro corpore abesse volunt?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="32">non longe a caro corpore abesse volunt?</l>

lines.text: atque ibi me cunctis pro dulci coniuge divis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="33">atque ibi me cunctis pro dulci coniuge divis</l>

lines.text: non sine taurino sanguine pollicita es,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="34">non sine taurino sanguine pollicita es,</l>

lines.text: si reditum tetulisset. is haud in tempore longo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="35">si reditum tetulisset. is haud in tempore longo</l>

lines.text: captam Asiam Aegypti finibus addiderat.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="36">captam Asiam Aegypti finibus addiderat.</l>

lines.text: quis ego pro factis caelesti reddita coetu
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="37">quis ego pro factis caelesti reddita coetu</l>

lines.text: pristina vota novo munere dissolvo.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="38">pristina vota novo munere dissolvo.</l>

lines.text: invita, o regina, tuo de vertice cessi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="39">invita, o regina, tuo de vertice cessi,</l>

lines.text: invita: adiuro teque tuumque caput:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="40">invita: adiuro teque tuumque caput:</l>

lines.text: digna ferat quod si quis inaniter adiurarit:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="41">digna ferat quod si quis inaniter adiurarit:</l>

lines.text: sed qui se ferro postulet esse parem?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="42">sed qui se ferro postulet esse parem?</l>

lines.text: ille quoque eversus mons est quem maximum in oris
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="43">ille quoque eversus mons est quem maximum in oris</l>

lines.text: progenies Thiae clara supervehitur,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="44">progenies Thiae clara supervehitur,</l>

lines.text: cum Medi peperere novum mare, cumque inventus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="45">cum Medi peperere novum mare, cumque inventus</l>

lines.text: per medium classi barbara navit Athon.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="46">per medium classi barbara navit Athon.</l>

lines.text: quid facient crines, cum ferro talia cedant?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="47">quid facient crines, cum ferro talia cedant?</l>

lines.text: Iuppiter, ut Chalybon omne genus pereat,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="48">Iuppiter, ut Chalybon omne genus pereat,</l>

lines.text: et qui principio sub terra quaerere venas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="49">et qui principio sub terra quaerere venas</l>

lines.text: institit ac ferri fingere duritiem!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="50">institit ac ferri fingere duritiem!</l>

lines.text: abiunctae paulo ante comae mea fata sorores
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="51">abiunctae paulo ante comae mea fata sorores</l>

lines.text: lugebant, cum se Memnonis Aethiopis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="52">lugebant, cum se Memnonis Aethiopis</l>

lines.text: unigena impellens nutantibus aera pennis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="53">unigena impellens nutantibus aera pennis</l>

lines.text: obtulit Arsinoes † elocridicos ales equus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="54">obtulit Arsinoes † elocridicos ales equus,</l>

lines.text: isque per aetherias me tollens avolat umbras
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="55">isque per aetherias me tollens avolat umbras</l>

lines.text: et Veneris casto conlocat in gremio.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="56">et Veneris casto conlocat in gremio.</l>

lines.text: ipsa suum Zephyritis eo famulum legarat,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="57">ipsa suum Zephyritis eo famulum legarat,</l>

lines.text: Graia Canopiis incola litoribus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="58">Graia Canopiis incola litoribus,</l>

lines.text: †hi dii ven ibi vario ne solum in lumine caeli
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="59">†hi dii ven ibi vario ne solum in lumine caeli</l>

lines.text: ex Ariadneis aurea temporibus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="60">ex Ariadneis aurea temporibus</l>

lines.text: fixa corona foret, sed nos quoque fulgeremus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="61">fixa corona foret, sed nos quoque fulgeremus</l>

lines.text: devotae flavi verticis exuviae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="62">devotae flavi verticis exuviae,</l>

lines.text: uvidulam a fletu cedentem ad temple deum me
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="63">uvidulam a fletu cedentem ad temple deum me</l>

lines.text: sidus in antiquis diva novum posuit:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="64">sidus in antiquis diva novum posuit:</l>

lines.text: Virginis et saevi contingens namque Leonis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="65">Virginis et saevi contingens namque Leonis</l>

lines.text: lumina, Callisto iuncta Lycaoniae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="66">lumina, Callisto iuncta Lycaoniae,</l>

lines.text: vertor in occasum, tardum dux ante Booten,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="67">vertor in occasum, tardum dux ante Booten,</l>

lines.text: qui vix sero alto mergitur Oceano.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="68">qui vix sero alto mergitur Oceano.</l>

lines.text: sed quamquam me nocte premunt vestigia divum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="69">sed quamquam me nocte premunt vestigia divum,</l>

lines.text: lux autem canae Tethyi restituit,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="70">lux autem canae Tethyi restituit,</l>

lines.text: (pace tua fari hic liceat, Rhamnusia virgo:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="71">(pace tua fari hic liceat, Rhamnusia virgo:</l>

lines.text: namque ego non ullo vera timore tegam,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="72">namque ego non ullo vera timore tegam,</l>

lines.text: nec si me infestis discerpent sidera dictis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="73">nec si me infestis discerpent sidera dictis,</l>

lines.text: condita quin veri pectoris evoluam)
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="74">condita quin veri pectoris evoluam)</l>

lines.text: non his tam laetor rebus quam me afore semper
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="75">non his tam laetor rebus quam me afore semper</l>

lines.text: afore me a dominae vertice discrucior,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="76">afore me a dominae vertice discrucior,</l>

lines.text: quicum ego, dum virgo quondam fuit, omnibus expers
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="77">quicum ego, dum virgo quondam fuit, omnibus expers</l>

lines.text: unguentis, una milia multa bibi.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="78">unguentis, una milia multa bibi.</l>

lines.text: nunc vos optato quom iunxit lumine taeda,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="79">nunc vos optato quom iunxit lumine taeda,</l>

lines.text: non prius unanimis corpora coniugibus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="80">non prius unanimis corpora coniugibus</l>

lines.text: tradite nudantes reiecta veste papillas,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="81">tradite nudantes reiecta veste papillas,</l>

lines.text: quam iucunda mihi munera libet onyx,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="82">quam iucunda mihi munera libet onyx,</l>

lines.text: vester onyx, casto colitis quae iura cubili.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="83">vester onyx, casto colitis quae iura cubili.</l>

lines.text: sed quae se impuro dedit adulterio,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="84">sed quae se impuro dedit adulterio,</l>

lines.text: illius ah mala dona levis bibat irrita pulvis:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="85">illius ah mala dona levis bibat irrita pulvis:</l>

lines.text: namque ego ab indignis praemia nulla peto.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="86">namque ego ab indignis praemia nulla peto.</l>

lines.text: sed magis, o nuptae, semper concordia vestras,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="87">sed magis, o nuptae, semper concordia vestras,</l>

lines.text: semper amor sedes incolat adsiduus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="88">semper amor sedes incolat adsiduus.</l>

lines.text: tu vero, regina, tuens cum sidera divam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="89">tu vero, regina, tuens cum sidera divam</l>

lines.text: placabis festis luminibus Venerem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="90">placabis festis luminibus Venerem,</l>

lines.text: unguinis expertem non siris esse tuam me,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="91">unguinis expertem non siris esse tuam me,</l>

lines.text: sed potius largis adfice muneribus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="92">sed potius largis adfice muneribus.</l>

lines.text: sidera cur retinent? utinam coma regia fiam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="93">sidera cur retinent? utinam coma regia fiam</l>

lines.text: proximus Hydrochoi fulgeret Oarion.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:66" n="94">proximus Hydrochoi fulgeret Oarion.</l>

lines.text: O dulci iucunda viro, iucunda parenti,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="1">O dulci iucunda viro, iucunda parenti,</l>

lines.text: salve, teque bona Iuppiter auctet ope,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="2">salve, teque bona Iuppiter auctet ope,</l>

lines.text: Ianua, quam Balbo dicunt servisse benigne
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="3">Ianua, quam Balbo dicunt servisse benigne</l>

lines.text: olim, cum sedes ipse senex tenuit,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="4">olim, cum sedes ipse senex tenuit,</l>

lines.text: quamque ferunt rursus voto servisse maligne,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="5">quamque ferunt rursus voto servisse maligne,</l>

lines.text: postquam es porrecto facta marita sene,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="6">postquam es porrecto facta marita sene,</l>

lines.text: dic agedum nobis quare mutata feraris
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="7">dic agedum nobis quare mutata feraris</l>

lines.text: in dominum veterem deseruisse fidem.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="8">in dominum veterem deseruisse fidem.</l>

lines.text: non (ita Caecilio placeam, cui tradita nunc sum)
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="9"><q rend="single">non (ita Caecilio placeam, cui tradita nunc sum)</q></l>

lines.text: culpa mea est, quamquam dicitur esse mea,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="10"><q rend="single; merge">culpa mea est, quamquam dicitur esse mea,</q></l>

lines.text: nec peccatum a me quisquam pote dicere quicquam:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="11"><q rend="single; merge">nec peccatum a me quisquam pote dicere quicquam:</q></l>

lines.text: †verum istius populi ianua qui te facit!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="12"><q rend="single; merge">†verum istius populi ianua qui te facit!</q></l>

lines.text: qui, quacumque aliquid reperitur non bene factum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="13"><q rend="single; merge">qui, quacumque aliquid reperitur non bene factum,</q></l>

lines.text: ad me omnes clamant, Ianua, culpa tua est.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="14"><q rend="single; merge">ad me omnes clamant, <q rend="double">Ianua, culpa tua est.</q></q></l>

lines.text: non istuc satis est uno te dicere verbo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="15">non istuc satis est uno te dicere verbo,</l>

lines.text: sed facere ut quivis sentiat et videat.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="16">sed facere ut quivis sentiat et videat.</l>

lines.text: qui possum? nemo quaerit nec scire laborat.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="17"><q rend="single">qui possum? nemo quaerit nec scire laborat.</q></l>

lines.text: nos volumus; nobis dicere ne dubita.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="18">nos volumus; nobis dicere ne dubita.</l>

lines.text: primum igitur, virgo quod fertur tradita nobis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="19"><q rend="single">primum igitur, virgo quod fertur tradita nobis,</q></l>

lines.text: falsum est. non illam vir prior attigerit,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="20"><q rend="single; merge">falsum est. non illam vir prior attigerit,</q></l>

lines.text: languidior tenera cui pendens sicula beta
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="21"><q rend="single; merge">languidior tenera cui pendens sicula beta</q></l>

lines.text: nunquam se mediam sustulit ad tunicam:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="22"><q rend="single; merge">nunquam se mediam sustulit ad tunicam:</q></l>

lines.text: sed pater illius gnati violasse cubile
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="23"><q rend="single; merge">sed pater illius gnati violasse cubile</q></l>

lines.text: dicitur et miseram conscelerasse domum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="24"><q rend="single; merge">dicitur et miseram conscelerasse domum,</q></l>

lines.text: sive quod impia mens caeco flagrabat amore,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="25"><q rend="single; merge">sive quod impia mens caeco flagrabat amore,</q></l>

lines.text: seu quod iners sterili semine natus erat
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="26"><q rend="single; merge">seu quod iners sterili semine natus erat</q></l>

lines.text: et quaerendus is unde foret nervosius illud
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="27"><q rend="single; merge">et quaerendus is unde foret nervosius illud</q></l>

lines.text: quod posset zonam solvere virgineam.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="28"><q rend="single; merge">quod posset zonam solvere virgineam.</q></l>

lines.text: egregium narras mira pietate parentem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="29">egregium narras mira pietate parentem,</l>

lines.text: qui ipse sui gnati minxerit in gremium.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="30">qui ipse sui gnati minxerit in gremium.</l>

lines.text: atqui non solum hoc se dicit cognitum habere
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="31"><q rend="single">atqui non solum hoc se dicit cognitum habere</q></l>

lines.text: Brixia † chinea suppositum specula,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="32"><q rend="single; merge">Brixia † chinea suppositum specula,</q></l>

lines.text: flavus quam molli praecurrit flumine Mella,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="33"><q rend="single; merge">flavus quam molli praecurrit flumine Mella,</q></l>

lines.text: Brixia, Veronae mater amata meae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="34"><q rend="single; merge">Brixia, Veronae mater amata meae,</q></l>

lines.text: sed de Postumio et Corneli narrat amore,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="35"><q rend="single; merge">sed de Postumio et Corneli narrat amore,</q></l>

lines.text: cum quibus illa malum fecit adulterium.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="36"><q rend="single; merge">cum quibus illa malum fecit adulterium.</q></l>

lines.text: dixerit hic aliquis, quid? tu istaec, Ianua, nosti,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="37"><q rend="single; merge">dixerit hic aliquis, <q rend="double">quid? tu istaec, Ianua, nosti,</q></q></l>

lines.text: cui nunquam domini limine abesse licet,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="38"><q rend="single; merge"><q rend="double; merge">cui nunquam domini limine abesse licet,</q></q></l>

lines.text: nec populum auscultare, sed hic suffixa tigillo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="39"><q rend="single; merge"><q rend="double; merge">nec populum auscultare, sed hic suffixa tigillo</q></q></l>

lines.text: tantum operire soles aut aperire domum?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="40"><q rend="single; merge"><q rend="double; merge">tantum operire soles aut aperire domum?</q></q></l>

lines.text: saepe illam audivi furtiva voce loquentem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="41"><q rend="single; merge">saepe illam audivi furtiva voce loquentem</q></l>

lines.text: solam cum ancillis haec sua flagitia,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="42"><q rend="single; merge">solam cum ancillis haec sua flagitia,</q></l>

lines.text: nomine dicentem quos diximus, ut pote quae mi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="43"><q rend="single; merge">nomine dicentem quos diximus, ut pote quae mi</q></l>

lines.text: speraret nec linguam esse nec auriculam.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="44"><q rend="single; merge">speraret nec linguam esse nec auriculam.</q></l>

lines.text: praeterea addebat quendam, quem dicere nolo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="45"><q rend="single; merge">praeterea addebat quendam, quem dicere nolo</q></l>

lines.text: nomine ne tollat rubra supercilia.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="46"><q rend="single; merge">nomine ne tollat rubra supercilia.</q></l>

lines.text: longus homo est, magnas cui lites intulit olim
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="47"><q rend="single; merge">longus homo est, magnas cui lites intulit olim</q></l>

lines.text: falsum mendaci ventre puerperium.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:67" n="48"><q rend="single; merge">falsum mendaci ventre puerperium.</q></l>

lines.text: Quod mihi fortuna casuque oppressus acerbo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="1">Quod mihi fortuna casuque oppressus acerbo</l>

lines.text: conscriptum hoc lacrimis mittis epistolium,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="2">conscriptum hoc lacrimis mittis epistolium,</l>

lines.text: naufragum ut eiectum spumantibus aequoris undis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="3">naufragum ut eiectum spumantibus aequoris undis</l>

lines.text: sublevem et a mortis limine restituam,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="4">sublevem et a mortis limine restituam,</l>

lines.text: quem neque sancta Venus molli requiescere somno
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="5">quem neque sancta Venus molli requiescere somno</l>

lines.text: desertum in lecto caelibe perpetitur,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="6">desertum in lecto caelibe perpetitur,</l>

lines.text: nec veterum dulci scriptorum carmine musae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="7">nec veterum dulci scriptorum carmine musae</l>

lines.text: oblectant, cum mens anxia pervigilat,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="8">oblectant, cum mens anxia pervigilat,</l>

lines.text: id gratum est mihi, me quoniam tibi dicis amicum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="9">id gratum est mihi, me quoniam tibi dicis amicum</l>

lines.text: muneraque et Musarum hinc petis et Veneris.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="10">muneraque et Musarum hinc petis et Veneris.</l>

lines.text: sed tibi ne mea sint ignota incommoda, Manli,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="11">sed tibi ne mea sint ignota incommoda, Manli,</l>

lines.text: neu me odisse putes hospitis officium,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="12">neu me odisse putes hospitis officium,</l>

lines.text: accipe quis merser fortunae fluctibus ipse,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="13">accipe quis merser fortunae fluctibus ipse,</l>

lines.text: ne amplius a misero dona beata petas.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="14">ne amplius a misero dona beata petas.</l>

lines.text: tempore quo primum vestis mihi tradita pura est,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="15">tempore quo primum vestis mihi tradita pura est,</l>

lines.text: iucundum cum aetas florida ver ageret,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="16">iucundum cum aetas florida ver ageret,</l>

lines.text: multa satis lusi; non est dea nescia nostri
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="17">multa satis lusi; non est dea nescia nostri</l>

lines.text: quae dulcem curis miscet amaritiem:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="18">quae dulcem curis miscet amaritiem:</l>

lines.text: sed totum hoc studium luctu fraterna mihi mors
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="19">sed totum hoc studium luctu fraterna mihi mors</l>

lines.text: abstulit. o misero frater adempte mihi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="20">abstulit. o misero frater adempte mihi,</l>

lines.text: tu mea tu moriens fregisti commoda, frater,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="21">tu mea tu moriens fregisti commoda, frater,</l>

lines.text: tecum una tota est nostra sepulta domus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="22">tecum una tota est nostra sepulta domus,</l>

lines.text: omnia tecum una perierunt gaudia nostra,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="23">omnia tecum una perierunt gaudia nostra,</l>

lines.text: quae tuus in vita dulcis alebat amor.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="24">quae tuus in vita dulcis alebat amor.</l>

lines.text: cuius ego interitu tota de mente fugavi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="25">cuius ego interitu tota de mente fugavi</l>

lines.text: haec studia atque omnes delicias animi.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="26">haec studia atque omnes delicias animi.</l>

lines.text: quare, quod scribis Veronae turpe Catullo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="27">quare, quod scribis Veronae turpe Catullo</l>

lines.text: esse quod hic quisquis de meliore nota
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="28">esse quod hic quisquis de meliore nota</l>

lines.text: frigida deserto tepefactet membra cubili,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="29">frigida deserto tepefactet membra cubili,</l>

lines.text: id, Manli, non est turpe, magis miserum est.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="30">id, Manli, non est turpe, magis miserum est.</l>

lines.text: ignosces igitur, si, quae mihi luctus ademit,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="31">ignosces igitur, si, quae mihi luctus ademit,</l>

lines.text: haec tibi non tribuo munera, cum nequeo.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="32">haec tibi non tribuo munera, cum nequeo.</l>

lines.text: nam quod scriptorum non magna est copia apud me,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="33">nam quod scriptorum non magna est copia apud me,</l>

lines.text: hoc fit quod Romae vivimus: illa domus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="34">hoc fit quod Romae vivimus: illa domus,</l>

lines.text: illa mihi sedes, illic mea carpitur aetas;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="35">illa mihi sedes, illic mea carpitur aetas;</l>

lines.text: huc una ex multis capsula me sequitur.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="36">huc una ex multis capsula me sequitur.</l>

lines.text: quod cum ita sit, nolim statuas nos mente maligna
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="37">quod cum ita sit, nolim statuas nos mente maligna</l>

lines.text: id facere aut animo non satis ingenuo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="38">id facere aut animo non satis ingenuo</l>

lines.text: quod tibi non utriusque petenti copia parta est:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="39">quod tibi non utriusque petenti copia parta est:</l>

lines.text: ultro ego deferrem, copia si qua foret.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68" n="40">ultro ego deferrem, copia si qua foret.</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="1">non possum reticere, deae, qua me Allius in re</l>

lines.text: iuverit aut quantis iuverit officiis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="2">iuverit aut quantis iuverit officiis,</l>

lines.text: ne fugiens saeclis obliviscentibus aetas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="3">ne fugiens saeclis obliviscentibus aetas</l>

lines.text: illius hoc caeca nocte tegat studium:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="4">illius hoc caeca nocte tegat studium:</l>

lines.text: sed dicam vobis, vos porro dicite multis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="5">sed dicam vobis, vos porro dicite multis</l>

lines.text: milibus et facite haec charta loquatur anus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="6">milibus et facite haec charta loquatur anus</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="8">notescatque magis mortuus atque magis,</l>

lines.text: nec tenuem texens sublimis aranea telam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="9">nec tenuem texens sublimis aranea telam</l>

lines.text: in deserto Alli nomine opus faciat.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="10">in deserto Alli nomine opus faciat.</l>

lines.text: nam mihi quam dederit duplex Amathusia curam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="11">nam mihi quam dederit duplex Amathusia curam</l>

lines.text: scitis, et in quo me corruerit genere,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="12">scitis, et in quo me corruerit genere,</l>

lines.text: cum tantum arderem quantum Trinacria rupes
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="13">cum tantum arderem quantum Trinacria rupes</l>

lines.text: lymphaque in Oetaeis Malia Thermopylis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="14">lymphaque in Oetaeis Malia Thermopylis,</l>

lines.text: maesta neque adsiduo tabescere lumina fletu
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="15">maesta neque adsiduo tabescere lumina fletu</l>

lines.text: cessarent tristique imbre madere genae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="16">cessarent tristique imbre madere genae,</l>

lines.text: qualis in aerii perlucens vertice montis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="17">qualis in aerii perlucens vertice montis</l>

lines.text: rivus muscoso prosilit e lapide,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="18">rivus muscoso prosilit e lapide,</l>

lines.text: qui, cum de prone praeceps est valle volutus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="19">qui, cum de prone praeceps est valle volutus,</l>

lines.text: per medium densi transit iter populi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="20">per medium densi transit iter populi,</l>

lines.text: dulce viatori lasso in sudore levamen
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="21">dulce viatori lasso in sudore levamen</l>

lines.text: cum gravis exustos aestus hiulcat agros.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="22">cum gravis exustos aestus hiulcat agros.</l>

lines.text: hic, velut in nigro iactatis turbine nautis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="23">hic, velut in nigro iactatis turbine nautis</l>

lines.text: lenius adspirans aura secunda venit
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="24">lenius adspirans aura secunda venit</l>

lines.text: iam prece Pollucis, iam Castoris implorata,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="25">iam prece Pollucis, iam Castoris implorata,</l>

lines.text: tale fuit nobis Allius auxilium.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="26">tale fuit nobis Allius auxilium.</l>

lines.text: is clausum lato patefecit limite campum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="27">is clausum lato patefecit limite campum,</l>

lines.text: isque domum nobis isque dedit dominae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="28">isque domum nobis isque dedit dominae,</l>

lines.text: ad quam communes exerceremus amores.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="29">ad quam communes exerceremus amores.</l>

lines.text: quo mea se molli candida diva pede
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="30">quo mea se molli candida diva pede</l>

lines.text: intulit et trito fulgentem in limine plantam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="31">intulit et trito fulgentem in limine plantam</l>

lines.text: innixa arguta constituit solea,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="32">innixa arguta constituit solea,</l>

lines.text: coniugis ut quondam flagrans advenit amore
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="33">coniugis ut quondam flagrans advenit amore</l>

lines.text: Protesilaeam Laodamia domum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="34">Protesilaeam Laodamia domum</l>

lines.text: inceptam frustra, nondum cum sanguine sacro
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="35">inceptam frustra, nondum cum sanguine sacro</l>

lines.text: hostia caelestis pacificasset eros.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="36">hostia caelestis pacificasset eros.</l>

lines.text: nil mihi tam valde placeat, Rhamnusia virgo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="37">nil mihi tam valde placeat, Rhamnusia virgo,</l>

lines.text: quod temere invitis suscipiatur eris.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="38">quod temere invitis suscipiatur eris.</l>

lines.text: quam ieiuna pium desideret ara cruorem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="39">quam ieiuna pium desideret ara cruorem</l>

lines.text: docta est amisso Laodamia viro,
