lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="40">docta est amisso Laodamia viro,</l>

lines.text: coniugis ante coacta novi dimittere collum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="41">coniugis ante coacta novi dimittere collum</l>

lines.text: quam veniens una atque altera rursus hiems
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="42">quam veniens una atque altera rursus hiems</l>

lines.text: noctibus in longis avidum saturasset amorem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="43">noctibus in longis avidum saturasset amorem,</l>

lines.text: posset ut abrupto vivere coniugio:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="44">posset ut abrupto vivere coniugio:</l>

lines.text: quod scibant Parcae non longo tempore abesse,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="45">quod scibant Parcae non longo tempore abesse,</l>

lines.text: si miles muros isset ad Iliacos:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="46">si miles muros isset ad Iliacos:</l>

lines.text: nam tum Helenae raptu primores Argivorum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="47">nam tum Helenae raptu primores Argivorum</l>

lines.text: coeperat ad sese Troia ciere viros,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="48">coeperat ad sese Troia ciere viros,</l>

lines.text: Troia (nefas) commune sepulcrum Asiae Europaeque,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="49">Troia (nefas) commune sepulcrum Asiae Europaeque,</l>

lines.text: Troia virum et virtutum omnium acerba cinis:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="50">Troia virum et virtutum omnium acerba cinis:</l>

lines.text: quaene etiam nostro letum miserabile fratri
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="51">quaene etiam nostro letum miserabile fratri</l>

lines.text: attulit. Hei misero frater adempte mihi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="52">attulit. Hei misero frater adempte mihi,</l>

lines.text: hei misero fratri iucundum lumen ademptum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="53">hei misero fratri iucundum lumen ademptum,</l>

lines.text: tecum una tota est nostra sepulta domus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="54">tecum una tota est nostra sepulta domus,</l>

lines.text: omnia tecum una perierunt gaudia nostra,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="55">omnia tecum una perierunt gaudia nostra,</l>

lines.text: quae tuus in vita dulcis alebat amor.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="56">quae tuus in vita dulcis alebat amor.</l>

lines.text: quem nunc tam longe non inter nota sepulcra
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="57">quem nunc tam longe non inter nota sepulcra</l>

lines.text: nec prope cognatos compositum cineres,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="58">nec prope cognatos compositum cineres,</l>

lines.text: sed Troia obscena, Troia infelice sepultum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="59">sed Troia obscena, Troia infelice sepultum</l>

lines.text: detinet extremo terra aliena solo.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="60">detinet extremo terra aliena solo.</l>

lines.text: ad quam tum properans fertur simul undique pubes
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="61">ad quam tum properans fertur simul undique pubes</l>

lines.text: Graeca penetralis deseruisse focos,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="62">Graeca penetralis deseruisse focos,</l>

lines.text: ne Paris abducta gavisus libera moecha
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="63">ne Paris abducta gavisus libera moecha</l>

lines.text: otia pacato degeret in thalamo.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="64">otia pacato degeret in thalamo.</l>

lines.text: quo tibi tum casu, pulcherrima Laodamia,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="65">quo tibi tum casu, pulcherrima Laodamia,</l>

lines.text: ereptum est vita dulcius atque anima
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="66">ereptum est vita dulcius atque anima</l>

lines.text: coniugium: tanto te absorbens vertice amoris
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="67">coniugium: tanto te absorbens vertice amoris</l>

lines.text: aestus in abruptum detulerat barathrum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="68">aestus in abruptum detulerat barathrum,</l>

lines.text: quale ferunt Grai Pheneum prope Cylleneum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="69">quale ferunt Grai Pheneum prope Cylleneum</l>

lines.text: siccare emulsa pingue palude solum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="70">siccare emulsa pingue palude solum,</l>

lines.text: quod quondam caesis montis fodisse medullis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="71">quod quondam caesis montis fodisse medullis</l>

lines.text: audit falsiparens Amphitryoniades,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="72">audit falsiparens Amphitryoniades,</l>

lines.text: tempore quo certa Stymphalia monstra sagitta
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="73">tempore quo certa Stymphalia monstra sagitta</l>

lines.text: perculit imperio deterioris eri,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="74">perculit imperio deterioris eri,</l>

lines.text: pluribus ut caeli tereretur ianua divis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="75">pluribus ut caeli tereretur ianua divis,</l>

lines.text: Hebe nec longa virginitate foret.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="76">Hebe nec longa virginitate foret.</l>

lines.text: sed tuus altus amor barathro fuit altior illo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="77">sed tuus altus amor barathro fuit altior illo,</l>

lines.text: qui tunc indomitam ferre iugum docuit.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="78">qui tunc indomitam ferre iugum docuit.</l>

lines.text: nam nec tam carum confecto aetate parenti
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="79">nam nec tam carum confecto aetate parenti</l>

lines.text: una caput seri nata nepotis alit,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="80">una caput seri nata nepotis alit,</l>

lines.text: qui, cum divitiis vix tandem inventus avitis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="81">qui, cum divitiis vix tandem inventus avitis</l>

lines.text: nomen testatas intulit in tabulas,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="82">nomen testatas intulit in tabulas,</l>

lines.text: impia derisi gentilis gaudia tollens
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="83">impia derisi gentilis gaudia tollens</l>

lines.text: suscitat a cano vulturium capiti:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="84">suscitat a cano vulturium capiti:</l>

lines.text: nec tantum niveo gavisa est ulla columbo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="85">nec tantum niveo gavisa est ulla columbo</l>

lines.text: compar, quae multo dicitur improbius
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="86">compar, quae multo dicitur improbius</l>

lines.text: oscula mordenti semper decerpere rostro
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="87">oscula mordenti semper decerpere rostro</l>

lines.text: quam quae praecipue multivola est mulier:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="88">quam quae praecipue multivola est mulier:</l>

lines.text: sed tu horum magnos vicisti sola furores,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="89">sed tu horum magnos vicisti sola furores,</l>

lines.text: ut semel es flavo conciliata viro.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="90">ut semel es flavo conciliata viro.</l>

lines.text: aut nihil aut paulo cui tum concedere digna
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="91">aut nihil aut paulo cui tum concedere digna</l>

lines.text: lux mea se nostrum contulit in gremium,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="92">lux mea se nostrum contulit in gremium,</l>

lines.text: quam circumcursans hinc illinc saepe Cupido
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="93">quam circumcursans hinc illinc saepe Cupido</l>

lines.text: fulgebat crocina candidus in tunica.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="94">fulgebat crocina candidus in tunica.</l>

lines.text: quae tamenetsi uno non est contenta Catullo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="95">quae tamenetsi uno non est contenta Catullo,</l>

lines.text: rara verecundae furta feremus erae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="96">rara verecundae furta feremus erae,</l>

lines.text: ne nimium simus stultorum more molesti:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="97">ne nimium simus stultorum more molesti:</l>

lines.text: saepe etiam Iuno, maxima caelicolum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="98">saepe etiam Iuno, maxima caelicolum,</l>

lines.text: coniugis in culpa flagrantem concoquit iram
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="99">coniugis in culpa flagrantem concoquit iram</l>

lines.text: noscens omnivoli plurima furta Iovis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="100">noscens omnivoli plurima furta Iovis.</l>

lines.text: atqui nec divis homines componier aequum est
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="101">atqui nec divis homines componier aequum est</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="101a"><gap reason="lost" rend=" . . . . . . . . . "/></l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="101aa"><gap reason="lost" rend=" . . . . . . . . . "/></l>

lines.text: ingratum tremuli tolle parentis onus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="102">ingratum tremuli tolle parentis onus.</l>

lines.text: nec tamen illa mihi dextra deducta paterna
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="103">nec tamen illa mihi dextra deducta paterna</l>

lines.text: fragrantem Assyrio venit odore domum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="104">fragrantem Assyrio venit odore domum,</l>

lines.text: sed furtiva dedit mira munuscula nocte
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="105">sed furtiva dedit mira munuscula nocte</l>

lines.text: ipsius ex ipso dempta viri gremio.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="106">ipsius ex ipso dempta viri gremio.</l>

lines.text: quare illud satis est, si nobis is datur unis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="107">quare illud satis est, si nobis is datur unis</l>

lines.text: quem lapide illa diem candidiore notat.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="108">quem lapide illa diem candidiore notat.</l>

lines.text: hoc tibi quod potui confectum carmine munus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="109" rend="align(indent)">hoc tibi quod potui confectum carmine munus</l>

lines.text: pro multis, Alli, redditur officiis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="110">pro multis, Alli, redditur officiis,</l>

lines.text: ne vestrum scabra tangat robigine nomen
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="111">ne vestrum scabra tangat robigine nomen</l>

lines.text: haec atque illa dies atque alia atque alia.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="112">haec atque illa dies atque alia atque alia.</l>

lines.text: huc addent divi quam plurima, quae Themis olim
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="113">huc addent divi quam plurima, quae Themis olim</l>

lines.text: antiquis solita est munera ferre piis:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="114">antiquis solita est munera ferre piis:</l>

lines.text: sitis felices et tu simul et tua vita
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="115">sitis felices et tu simul et tua vita</l>

lines.text: et domus, in qua nos lusimus et domina,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="116">et domus, in qua nos lusimus et domina,</l>

lines.text: et qui principio nobis † terram dedit aufert,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="117">et qui principio nobis † terram dedit aufert,</l>

lines.text: a quo sunt primo omnia nata bona,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="118">a quo sunt primo omnia nata bona,</l>

lines.text: et longe ante omnes mihi quae me carior ipso est,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="119">et longe ante omnes mihi quae me carior ipso est,</l>

lines.text: lux mea, qua viva vivere dulce mihi est.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:68a" n="120">lux mea, qua viva vivere dulce mihi est.</l>

notes: 68b in print edition. Renamed 68a here.

lines.text: Noli admirari quare tibi femina nulla,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:69" n="1">Noli admirari quare tibi femina nulla,</l>

lines.text: Rufe, velit tenerum supposuisse femur,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:69" n="2">Rufe, velit tenerum supposuisse femur,</l>

lines.text: non si illam rarae labefactes munere vestis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:69" n="3">non si illam rarae labefactes munere vestis</l>

lines.text: aut perluciduli deliciis lapidis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:69" n="4">aut perluciduli deliciis lapidis.</l>

lines.text: laedit te quaedam mala fabula, qua tibi fertur
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:69" n="5">laedit te quaedam mala fabula, qua tibi fertur</l>

lines.text: valle sub alarum trux habitare caper.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:69" n="6">valle sub alarum trux habitare caper.</l>

lines.text: hunc metuunt omnes. neque mirum: nam mala valde est
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:69" n="7">hunc metuunt omnes. neque mirum: nam mala valde est</l>

lines.text: bestia, nec quicum bella puella cubet.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:69" n="8">bestia, nec quicum bella puella cubet.</l>

lines.text: quare aut crudelem nasorum interfice pestem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:69" n="9">quare aut crudelem nasorum interfice pestem,</l>

lines.text: aut admirari desine cur fugiunt.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:69" n="10">aut admirari desine cur fugiunt.</l>

lines.text: Nulli se dicit mulier mea nubere malle
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:70" n="1">Nulli se dicit mulier mea nubere malle</l>

lines.text: quam mihi, non si se Iuppiter ipse petat.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:70" n="2">quam mihi, non si se Iuppiter ipse petat.</l>

lines.text: dicit: sed mulier cupido quod dicit amanti
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:70" n="3">dicit: sed mulier cupido quod dicit amanti</l>

lines.text: in vento et rapida scribere oportet aqua.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:70" n="4">in vento et rapida scribere oportet aqua.</l>

lines.text: Si cui iure bono sacer alarum obstitit hircus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:71" n="1">Si cui iure bono sacer alarum obstitit hircus,</l>

lines.text: aut si quem merito tarda podagra secat,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:71" n="2">aut si quem merito tarda podagra secat,</l>

lines.text: Aemulus iste tuus, qui vestrum exercet amorem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:71" n="3">Aemulus iste tuus, qui vestrum exercet amorem,</l>

lines.text: mirifice est a te nactus utrumque malum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:71" n="4">mirifice est a te nactus utrumque malum.</l>

lines.text: nam quotiens futuit totiens ulciscitur ambos:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:71" n="5">nam quotiens futuit totiens ulciscitur ambos:</l>

lines.text: illam adfligit odore, ipse perit podagra.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:71" n="6">illam adfligit odore, ipse perit podagra.</l>

lines.text: Dicebas quondam solum te nosse Catullum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:72" n="1">Dicebas quondam solum te nosse Catullum,</l>

lines.text: Lesbia, nec prae me velle tenere Iovem.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:72" n="2">Lesbia, nec prae me velle tenere Iovem.</l>

lines.text: dilexi tum te non tantum ut vulgus amicam,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:72" n="3">dilexi tum te non tantum ut vulgus amicam,</l>

lines.text: sed pater ut gnatos diligit et generos.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:72" n="4">sed pater ut gnatos diligit et generos.</l>

lines.text: nunc te cognovi: quare etsi impensius uror,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:72" n="5">nunc te cognovi: quare etsi impensius uror,</l>

lines.text: multo mi tamen es vilior et levior.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:72" n="6">multo mi tamen es vilior et levior.</l>

lines.text: qui potis est? inquis. quod amantem iniuria talis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:72" n="7">qui potis est? inquis. quod amantem iniuria talis</l>

lines.text: cogit amare magis, sed bene velle minus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:72" n="8">cogit amare magis, sed bene velle minus.</l>

lines.text: Desine de quoquam quicquam bene velle mereri
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:73" n="1">Desine de quoquam quicquam bene velle mereri</l>

lines.text: aut aliquem fieri posse putare pium.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:73" n="2">aut aliquem fieri posse putare pium.</l>

lines.text: omnia sunt ingrata, nihil fecisse benigne:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:73" n="3">omnia sunt ingrata, nihil fecisse benigne:</l>

lines.text: immo etiam taedet, taedet obestque magis:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:73" n="4">immo etiam taedet, taedet obestque magis:</l>

lines.text: ut mihi, quem nemo gravius nec acerbius urget
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:73" n="5">ut mihi, quem nemo gravius nec acerbius urget</l>

lines.text: Quam modo qui me unum atque unicum amicum habuit.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:73" n="6">Quam modo qui me unum atque unicum amicum habuit.</l>

lines.text: Gellius audierat patruum obiurgare solere,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:74" n="1">Gellius audierat patruum obiurgare solere,</l>

lines.text: si quis delicias diceret aut faceret.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:74" n="2">si quis delicias diceret aut faceret.</l>

lines.text: hoc ne ipsi accideret, patrui perdepsuit ipsam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:74" n="3">hoc ne ipsi accideret, patrui perdepsuit ipsam</l>

lines.text: uxorem et patruum reddidit Harpocratem.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:74" n="4">uxorem et patruum reddidit Harpocratem.</l>

lines.text: quod voluit fecit: nam, quamvis irrumet ipsum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:74" n="5">quod voluit fecit: nam, quamvis irrumet ipsum</l>

lines.text: nunc patruum, verbum non faciet patruus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:74" n="6">nunc patruum, verbum non faciet patruus.</l>

lines.text: Huc est mens deducta tua, mea Lesbia, culpa,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:75" n="1">Huc est mens deducta tua, mea Lesbia, culpa,</l>

lines.text: atque ita se officio perdidit ipsa suo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:75" n="2">atque ita se officio perdidit ipsa suo,</l>

lines.text: ut iam nec bene velle queat tibi, si optuma fias,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:75" n="3">ut iam nec bene velle queat tibi, si optuma fias,</l>

lines.text: nec desistere amare, omnia si facias.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:75" n="4">nec desistere amare, omnia si facias.</l>

lines.text: Si qua recordanti benefacta priora voluptas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="1">Si qua recordanti benefacta priora voluptas</l>

lines.text: est homini, cum se cogitat esse pium,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="2">est homini, cum se cogitat esse pium,</l>

lines.text: nec sanctam violasse fidem, nec foedere in ullo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="3">nec sanctam violasse fidem, nec foedere in ullo</l>

lines.text: divum ad fallendos numine abusum homines,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="4">divum ad fallendos numine abusum homines,</l>

lines.text: multa parata manent in longa aetate, Catulle,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="5">multa parata manent in longa aetate, Catulle,</l>

lines.text: ex hoc ingrato gaudia amore tibi.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="6">ex hoc ingrato gaudia amore tibi.</l>

lines.text: nam quaecumque homines bene cuiquam aut dicere possunt
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="7">nam quaecumque homines bene cuiquam aut dicere possunt</l>

lines.text: aut facere, haec a te dictaque factaque sunt:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="8">aut facere, haec a te dictaque factaque sunt:</l>

lines.text: omnia quae ingratae perierunt credita menti.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="9">omnia quae ingratae perierunt credita menti.</l>

lines.text: quare cur tu te iam amplius excrucies?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="10">quare cur tu te iam amplius excrucies?</l>

lines.text: quin tu animo offirmas atque istinc teque reducis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="11">quin tu animo offirmas atque istinc teque reducis</l>

lines.text: et dis invitis desinis esse miser?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="12">et dis invitis desinis esse miser?</l>

lines.text: difficile est longum subito deponere amorem;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="13">difficile est longum subito deponere amorem;</l>

lines.text: difficile est, verum hoc qua libet efficias.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="14">difficile est, verum hoc qua libet efficias.</l>

lines.text: una salus haec est, hoc est tibi pervincendum;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="15">una salus haec est, hoc est tibi pervincendum;</l>

lines.text: hoc facias, sive id non pote sive pote.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="16">hoc facias, sive id non pote sive pote.</l>

lines.text: o di, si vestrum est misereri, aut si quibus unquam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="17">o di, si vestrum est misereri, aut si quibus unquam</l>

lines.text: extremam iam ipsa in morte tulistis opem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="18">extremam iam ipsa in morte tulistis opem,</l>

lines.text: me miserum adspicite et, si vitam puriter egi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="19">me miserum adspicite et, si vitam puriter egi,</l>

lines.text: eripite hanc pestem perniciemque mihi!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="20">eripite hanc pestem perniciemque mihi!</l>

lines.text: hei mihi subrepens imos ut torpor in artus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="21">hei mihi subrepens imos ut torpor in artus</l>

lines.text: expulit ex omni pectore laetitias.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="22">expulit ex omni pectore laetitias.</l>

lines.text: non iam illud quaero, contra ut me diligat illa,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="23">non iam illud quaero, contra ut me diligat illa,</l>

lines.text: aut, quod non potis est, esse pudica velit:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="24">aut, quod non potis est, esse pudica velit:</l>

lines.text: ipse valere opto et taetrum hunc deponere morbum.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="25">ipse valere opto et taetrum hunc deponere morbum.</l>

lines.text: o di, reddite mi hoc pro pietate mea.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:76" n="26">o di, reddite mi hoc pro pietate mea.</l>

lines.text: Rufe mihi frustra ac nequiquam credite amice
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:77" n="1">Rufe mihi frustra ac nequiquam credite amice</l>

lines.text: (frustra? immo magno cum pretio atque malo),
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:77" n="2">(frustra? immo magno cum pretio atque malo),</l>

lines.text: sicine subrepsti mi atque intestina perurens
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:77" n="3">sicine subrepsti mi atque intestina perurens</l>

lines.text: hei misero eripuisti omnia nostra bona?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:77" n="4">hei misero eripuisti omnia nostra bona?</l>

lines.text: eripuisti, eheu nostrae crudele venenum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:77" n="5">eripuisti, eheu nostrae crudele venenum</l>

lines.text: vitae, eheu nostrae pestis amicitiae.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:77" n="6">vitae, eheu nostrae pestis amicitiae.<note resp="perseus" xml:lang="eng">Lines 7 ff are presented as part of poem 77 in the print edition. They are appended to poem 78 here.</note></l>

notes: Lines 7 ff are presented as part of poem 77 in the print edition. They are appended to poem 78 here.

lines.text: Gallus habet fratres, quorum est lepidissima coniunx
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:78" n="1">Gallus habet fratres, quorum est lepidissima coniunx</l>

lines.text: alterius, lepidus filius alterius.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:78" n="2">alterius, lepidus filius alterius.</l>

lines.text: Gallus homo est bellus: nam dulces iungit amores,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:78" n="3">Gallus homo est bellus: nam dulces iungit amores,</l>

lines.text: cum puero ut bello bella puella cubet.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:78" n="4">cum puero ut bello bella puella cubet.</l>

lines.text: Gallus homo est stultus nec se videt esse maritum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:78" n="5">Gallus homo est stultus nec se videt esse maritum,</l>

lines.text: qui patruus patrui monstret adulterium.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:78" n="6">qui patruus patrui monstret adulterium.</l>

<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:78" n="7a"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="78b_1"/><gap reason="lost" rend=" . . . . . . . . . "/><note resp="perseus" xml:lang="eng">Lines 7a ff are presented as part of poem 78b in the print edition. They are appended to poem 78 here.</note></l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:78" n="7aa"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="78b_2"/><gap reason="lost" rend=" . . . . . . . . "/></l>

lines.text: Sed nunc id doleo quod purae pura puellae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:78" n="7"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="78b_3"/>Sed nunc id doleo quod purae pura puellae</l>

lines.text: savia comminxit spurca saliva tua.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:78" n="8"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="78b_4"/>savia comminxit spurca saliva tua.</l>

lines.text: verum id non impune feres: nam te omnia saecla
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:78" n="9"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="78b_5"/>verum id non impune feres: nam te omnia saecla</l>

lines.text: noscent et qui sis fama loquetur anus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:78" n="10"><milestone unit="alt_poem_line" n="78b_6"/>noscent et qui sis fama loquetur anus.</l>

notes: Lines 7a ff are presented as part of poem 78b in the print edition. They are appended to poem 78 here.

lines.text: Lesbius est pulcher: quid ni? quem Lesbia malit
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:79" n="1">Lesbius est pulcher: quid ni? quem Lesbia malit</l>

lines.text: quam te cum tota gente, Catulle, tua.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:79" n="2">quam te cum tota gente, Catulle, tua.</l>

lines.text: sed tamen hic pulcher vendat cum gente Catullum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:79" n="3">sed tamen hic pulcher vendat cum gente Catullum,</l>

lines.text: si tria notorum savia reppererit.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:79" n="4">si tria notorum savia reppererit.</l>

lines.text: Quid dicam, Gelli, quare rosea ista labella
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:80" n="1">Quid dicam, Gelli, quare rosea ista labella</l>

lines.text: Hiberna fiant candidiora nive,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:80" n="2">Hiberna fiant candidiora nive,</l>

lines.text: mane domo cum exis et cum te octava quiete
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:80" n="3">mane domo cum exis et cum te octava quiete</l>

lines.text: e molli longo suscitat hora die?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:80" n="4">e molli longo suscitat hora die?</l>

lines.text: nescio quid certe est: an vere fama susurrat
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:80" n="5">nescio quid certe est: an vere fama susurrat</l>

lines.text: grandia te medii tenta vorare viri?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:80" n="6">grandia te medii tenta vorare viri?</l>

lines.text: sic certe est: clamant Victoris rupta miselli
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:80" n="7">sic certe est: clamant Victoris rupta miselli</l>

lines.text: ilia, et emulso labra notata sero.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:80" n="8">ilia, et emulso labra notata sero.</l>

lines.text: Nemone in tanto potuit populo esse, Iuventi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:81" n="1">Nemone in tanto potuit populo esse, Iuventi,</l>

lines.text: bellus homo quem tu diligere inciperes
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:81" n="2">bellus homo quem tu diligere inciperes</l>

lines.text: praeterquam iste tuus moribunda ab sede Pisauri
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:81" n="3">praeterquam iste tuus moribunda ab sede Pisauri</l>

lines.text: hospes inaurata pallidior statua?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:81" n="4">hospes inaurata pallidior statua?</l>

lines.text: qui tibi nunc cordi est, quem tu praeponere nobis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:81" n="5">qui tibi nunc cordi est, quem tu praeponere nobis</l>

lines.text: audes et nescis quod facinus facias.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:81" n="6">audes et nescis quod facinus facias.</l>

lines.text: Quinti, si tibi vis oculos debere Catullum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:82" n="1">Quinti, si tibi vis oculos debere Catullum</l>

lines.text: aut aliud si quid carius est oculis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:82" n="2">aut aliud si quid carius est oculis,</l>

lines.text: eripere ei noli multo quod carius illi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:82" n="3">eripere ei noli multo quod carius illi</l>

lines.text: est oculis seu quid carius est oculis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:82" n="4">est oculis seu quid carius est oculis.</l>

lines.text: Lesbia mi praesente viro mala plurima dicit:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:83" n="1">Lesbia mi praesente viro mala plurima dicit:</l>

lines.text: haec illi fatuo maxima laetitia est.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:83" n="2">haec illi fatuo maxima laetitia est.</l>

lines.text: mule, nihil sentis. si nostri oblita taceret,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:83" n="3">mule, nihil sentis. si nostri oblita taceret,</l>

lines.text: sana esset: nunc quod gannit et obloquitur,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:83" n="4">sana esset: nunc quod gannit et obloquitur,</l>

lines.text: non solum meminit, sed, quae multo acrior est res,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:83" n="5">non solum meminit, sed, quae multo acrior est res,</l>

lines.text: irata est: hoc est, uritur et loquitur.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:83" n="6">irata est: hoc est, uritur et loquitur.</l>

lines.text: Chommoda dicebat, si quando commode vellet
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:84" n="1">Chommoda dicebat, si quando commode vellet</l>

lines.text: dicere, et insidias Arrius hinsidias,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:84" n="2">dicere, et insidias Arrius hinsidias,</l>

lines.text: et tum mirifice sperabat se esse locutum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:84" n="3">et tum mirifice sperabat se esse locutum</l>

lines.text: cum quantum poterat dixerat hinsidias.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:84" n="4">cum quantum poterat dixerat hinsidias.</l>

lines.text: credo, sic mater, sic liber avunculus eius,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:84" n="5">credo, sic mater, sic liber avunculus eius,</l>

lines.text: sic maternus avus dixerat atque avia
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:84" n="6">sic maternus avus dixerat atque avia</l>

lines.text: hoc misso in Syriam requierant omnibus aures:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:84" n="7">hoc misso in Syriam requierant omnibus aures:</l>

lines.text: audibant eadem haec leniter et leviter,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:84" n="8">audibant eadem haec leniter et leviter,</l>

lines.text: nec sibi postilla metuebant talia verba,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:84" n="9">nec sibi postilla metuebant talia verba,</l>

lines.text: cum subito adfertur nuntius horribilis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:84" n="10">cum subito adfertur nuntius horribilis</l>

lines.text: Ionios fluctus, postquam illuc Arrius isset,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:84" n="11">Ionios fluctus, postquam illuc Arrius isset,</l>

lines.text: iam non Ionios esse, sed Hionios.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:84" n="12">iam non Ionios esse, sed Hionios.</l>

lines.text: Odi et amo. quare id faciam fortasse requiris
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:85" n="1">Odi et amo. quare id faciam fortasse requiris</l>

lines.text: nescio, sed fieri sentio et excrucior.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:85" n="2">nescio, sed fieri sentio et excrucior.</l>

lines.text: Quintia formosa est multis, mihi candida, longa,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:86" n="1">Quintia formosa est multis, mihi candida, longa,</l>

lines.text: recta est. haec ego sic singula confiteor,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:86" n="2">recta est. haec ego sic singula confiteor,</l>

lines.text: totum illud formosa nego: nam nulla venustas,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:86" n="3">totum illud <q rend="single">formosa</q> nego: nam nulla venustas,</l>

lines.text: nulla in tam magno est corpore mica salis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:86" n="4">nulla in tam magno est corpore mica salis.</l>

lines.text: Lesbia formosa est, quae cum pulcherrima tota est,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:86" n="5">Lesbia formosa est, quae cum pulcherrima tota est,</l>

lines.text: tum omnibus una omnis subripuit Veneres.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:86" n="6">tum omnibus una omnis subripuit Veneres.</l>

lines.text: Nulla potest mulier tantum se dicere amatam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:87" n="1">Nulla potest mulier tantum se dicere amatam</l>

lines.text: vere, quantum a me Lesbia amata mea es
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:87" n="2">vere, quantum a me Lesbia amata mea es</l>

lines.text: nulla fides ullo fuit unquam in foedere tanta
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:87" n="3">nulla fides ullo fuit unquam in foedere tanta</l>

lines.text: quanta in amore tuo ex parte reperta mea est.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:87" n="4">quanta in amore tuo ex parte reperta mea est.</l>

lines.text: Quid facit is, Gelli, qui cum matre atque sorore
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:88" n="1">Quid facit is, Gelli, qui cum matre atque sorore</l>

lines.text: prurit et abiectis pervigilat tunicis?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:88" n="2">prurit et abiectis pervigilat tunicis?</l>

lines.text: quid facit is patruum qui non sinit esse maritum?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:88" n="3">quid facit is patruum qui non sinit esse maritum?</l>

lines.text: ecquid scis quantum suscipiat sceleris?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:88" n="4">ecquid scis quantum suscipiat sceleris?</l>

lines.text: suscipit, o Gelli, quantum non ultima Tethys
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:88" n="5">suscipit, o Gelli, quantum non ultima Tethys</l>

lines.text: nec genitor nympharum abluit Oceanus:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:88" n="6">nec genitor nympharum abluit Oceanus:</l>

lines.text: nam nihil est quicquam sceleris quo prodeat ultra,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:88" n="7">nam nihil est quicquam sceleris quo prodeat ultra,</l>

lines.text: non si demisso se ipse voret capite.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:88" n="8">non si demisso se ipse voret capite.</l>

lines.text: Gellius est tenuis: quid ni? cui tam bona mater
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:89" n="1">Gellius est tenuis: quid ni? cui tam bona mater</l>

lines.text: tamque valens vivat tamque venusta soror
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:89" n="2">tamque valens vivat tamque venusta soror</l>

lines.text: tamque bonus patruus tamque omnia plena puellis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:89" n="3">tamque bonus patruus tamque omnia plena puellis</l>

lines.text: cognatis, quare is desinat esse macer?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:89" n="4">cognatis, quare is desinat esse macer?</l>

lines.text: qui ut nihil attingat, nisi quod fas tangere non est,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:89" n="5">qui ut nihil attingat, nisi quod fas tangere non est,</l>

lines.text: quantumvis quare sit macer invenies.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:89" n="6">quantumvis quare sit macer invenies.</l>

lines.text: Nascatur magus ex Gelli matrisque nefando
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:90" n="1">Nascatur magus ex Gelli matrisque nefando</l>

lines.text: coniugio et discat Persicum haruspicium:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:90" n="2">coniugio et discat Persicum haruspicium:</l>

lines.text: nam magus ex matre et gnato gignatur oportet,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:90" n="3">nam magus ex matre et gnato gignatur oportet,</l>

lines.text: si vera est Persarum impia religio,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:90" n="4">si vera est Persarum impia religio,</l>

lines.text: gratus ut accepto veneretur carmine divos
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:90" n="5">gratus ut accepto veneretur carmine divos</l>

lines.text: omentum in flamma pingue liquefaciens.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:90" n="6">omentum in flamma pingue liquefaciens.</l>

lines.text: Non ideo, Gelli, sperabam te mihi fidum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:91" n="1">Non ideo, Gelli, sperabam te mihi fidum</l>

lines.text: in misero hoc nostro, hoc perdito amore fore
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:91" n="2">in misero hoc nostro, hoc perdito amore fore</l>

lines.text: quod te cognossem bene constantemve putarem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:91" n="3">quod te cognossem bene constantemve putarem</l>

lines.text: aut posse a turpi mentem inhibere probro,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:91" n="4">aut posse a turpi mentem inhibere probro,</l>

lines.text: sed neque quod matrem nec germanam esse videbam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:91" n="5">sed neque quod matrem nec germanam esse videbam</l>

lines.text: hanc tibi cuius me magnus edebat amor;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:91" n="6">hanc tibi cuius me magnus edebat amor;</l>

lines.text: et quamvis tecum multo coniungerer usu,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:91" n="7">et quamvis tecum multo coniungerer usu,</l>

lines.text: non satis id causae credideram esse tibi.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:91" n="8">non satis id causae credideram esse tibi.</l>

lines.text: tu satis id duxti: tantum tibi gaudium in omni
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:91" n="9">tu satis id duxti: tantum tibi gaudium in omni</l>

lines.text: culpa est in quacumque est aliquid sceleris.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:91" n="10">culpa est in quacumque est aliquid sceleris.</l>

lines.text: Lesbia mi dicit semper male nec tacet unquam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:92" n="1">Lesbia mi dicit semper male nec tacet unquam</l>

lines.text: de me: Lesbia me dispeream nisi amat.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:92" n="2">de me: Lesbia me dispeream nisi amat.</l>

lines.text: quo signo? quia sunt totidem mea: deprecor illam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:92" n="3">quo signo? quia sunt totidem mea: deprecor illam</l>

lines.text: adsidue, verum dispeream nisi amo.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:92" n="4">adsidue, verum dispeream nisi amo.</l>

lines.text: Nil nimium studeo, Caesar, tibi velle placere,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:93" n="1">Nil nimium studeo, Caesar, tibi velle placere,</l>

lines.text: nec scire utrum sis albus an ater homo.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:93" n="2">nec scire utrum sis albus an ater homo.</l>

lines.text: Mentula moechatur. moechatur mentula certe.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:94" n="1">Mentula moechatur. moechatur mentula certe.</l>

lines.text: hoc est quod dicunt, ipsa olera olla legit.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:94" n="2">hoc est quod dicunt, ipsa olera olla legit.</l>

lines.text: Zmyrna mei Cinnae nonam post denique messem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:95" n="1">Zmyrna mei Cinnae nonam post denique messem</l>

lines.text: quam coepta est nonamque edita post hiemem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:95" n="2">quam coepta est nonamque edita post hiemem,</l>

lines.text: milia cum interea quingenta Hortensius uno
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:95" n="3">milia cum interea quingenta Hortensius uno</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:95" n="4"><gap reason="lost" rend=" . . . . . . . . . "/></l>

lines.text: Zmyrna cavas Satrachi penitus mittetur ad undas,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:95" n="5">Zmyrna cavas Satrachi penitus mittetur ad undas,</l>

lines.text: Zmyrnam cana diu saecula pervolvent.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:95" n="6">Zmyrnam cana diu saecula pervolvent.</l>

lines.text: at Volusi annales Paduam morientur ad ipsam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:95" n="7">at Volusi annales Paduam morientur ad ipsam</l>

lines.text: et laxas scombris saepe dabunt tunicas.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:95" n="8">et laxas scombris saepe dabunt tunicas.</l>

lines.text: parva mei mihi sint cordi monumenta sodalis:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:95" n="9">parva mei mihi sint cordi monumenta sodalis:</l>

lines.text: at populus tumido gaudeat Antimacho.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:95" n="10">at populus tumido gaudeat Antimacho.</l>

lines.text: Si quicquam mutis gratum acceptumve sepulcris
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:96" n="1">Si quicquam mutis gratum acceptumve sepulcris</l>

lines.text: accidere a nostro, Calve, dolore potest,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:96" n="2">accidere a nostro, Calve, dolore potest,</l>

lines.text: quo desiderio veteres renovamus amores
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:96" n="3">quo desiderio veteres renovamus amores</l>

lines.text: atque olim missas flemus amicitias,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:96" n="4">atque olim missas flemus amicitias,</l>

lines.text: certe non tanto mors immatura dolori est
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:96" n="5">certe non tanto mors immatura dolori est</l>

lines.text: Quintiliae, quantum gaudet amore tuo.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:96" n="6">Quintiliae, quantum gaudet amore tuo.</l>

lines.text: Non (ita me di ament) quicquam referre putavi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:97" n="1">Non (ita me di ament) quicquam referre putavi</l>

lines.text: utrumne os an culum olfacerem Aemilio.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:97" n="2">utrumne os an culum olfacerem Aemilio.</l>

lines.text: nilo mundius hoc, nihiloque immundius illud,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:97" n="3">nilo mundius hoc, nihiloque immundius illud,</l>

lines.text: verum etiam culus mundior et melior:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:97" n="4">verum etiam culus mundior et melior:</l>

lines.text: nam sine dentibus est. hoc dentis sesquipedalis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:97" n="5">nam sine dentibus est. hoc dentis sesquipedalis,</l>

lines.text: gingivas vero ploxeni habet veteris,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:97" n="6">gingivas vero ploxeni habet veteris,</l>

lines.text: praeterea rictum qualem diffissus in aestu
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:97" n="7">praeterea rictum qualem diffissus in aestu</l>

lines.text: meientis mulae cunnus habere solet.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:97" n="8">meientis mulae cunnus habere solet.</l>

lines.text: hic futuit multas et se facit esse venustum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:97" n="9">hic futuit multas et se facit esse venustum,</l>

lines.text: et non pistrino traditur atque asino?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:97" n="10">et non pistrino traditur atque asino?</l>

lines.text: quem si qua attingit, non illam posse putemus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:97" n="11">quem si qua attingit, non illam posse putemus</l>

lines.text: aegroti culum lingere carnificis?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:97" n="12">aegroti culum lingere carnificis?</l>

lines.text: In te, si in quemquam, dici pose, putide Victi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:98" n="1">In te, si in quemquam, dici pose, putide Victi,</l>

lines.text: id quod verbosis dicitur et fatuis:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:98" n="2">id quod verbosis dicitur et fatuis:</l>

lines.text: ista cum lingua, si usus veniat tibi, possis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:98" n="3">ista cum lingua, si usus veniat tibi, possis</l>

lines.text: culos et crepidas lingere carpatinas.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:98" n="4">culos et crepidas lingere carpatinas.</l>

lines.text: si nos omnino vis omnes perdere, Victi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:98" n="5">si nos omnino vis omnes perdere, Victi,</l>

lines.text: hiscas: omnino quod cupis efficies.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:98" n="6">hiscas: omnino quod cupis efficies.</l>

lines.text: Subripui tibi, dum ludis, mellite Iuventi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:99" n="1">Subripui tibi, dum ludis, mellite Iuventi,</l>

lines.text: saviolum dulci dulcius ambrosia.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:99" n="2">saviolum dulci dulcius ambrosia.</l>

lines.text: verum id non impune tuli: namque amplius horam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:99" n="3">verum id non impune tuli: namque amplius horam</l>

lines.text: suffixum in summa me memini esse cruce,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:99" n="4">suffixum in summa me memini esse cruce,</l>

lines.text: dum tibi me purgo nec possum fletibus ullis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:99" n="5">dum tibi me purgo nec possum fletibus ullis</l>

lines.text: tantillum vestrae demere saevitiae.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:99" n="6">tantillum vestrae demere saevitiae.</l>

lines.text: nam simul id factum est, multis diluta labella
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:99" n="7">nam simul id factum est, multis diluta labella</l>

lines.text: guttis abstersisti omnibus articulis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:99" n="8">guttis abstersisti omnibus articulis,</l>

lines.text: ne quicquam nostro contractum ex ore maneret,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:99" n="9">ne quicquam nostro contractum ex ore maneret,</l>

lines.text: tanquam commictae spurca saliva lupae.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:99" n="10">tanquam commictae spurca saliva lupae.</l>

lines.text: praeterea infesto miserum me tradere Amori
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:99" n="11">praeterea infesto miserum me tradere Amori</l>

lines.text: non cessasti omnique excruciare modo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:99" n="12">non cessasti omnique excruciare modo,</l>

lines.text: ut mi ex ambrosia mutatum iam fores illud
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:99" n="13">ut mi ex ambrosia mutatum iam fores illud</l>

lines.text: saviolum tristi tristius elleboro.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:99" n="14">saviolum tristi tristius elleboro.</l>

lines.text: quam quoniam poenam misero proponis amori,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:99" n="15">quam quoniam poenam misero proponis amori,</l>

lines.text: nunquam iam posthac basia subripiam.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:99" n="16">nunquam iam posthac basia subripiam.</l>

lines.text: Caelius Aufilenum et Quintius Aufilenam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:100" n="1">Caelius Aufilenum et Quintius Aufilenam</l>

lines.text: flos Veronensum depereunt iuvenum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:100" n="2">flos Veronensum depereunt iuvenum,</l>

lines.text: hic fratrem, ille sororem. hoc est quod dicitur illud
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:100" n="3">hic fratrem, ille sororem. hoc est quod dicitur illud</l>

lines.text: fraternum vere dulce sodalicium.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:100" n="4">fraternum vere dulce sodalicium.</l>

lines.text: cui faveam potius? Caeli, tibi: nam tua nobis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:100" n="5">cui faveam potius? Caeli, tibi: nam tua nobis</l>

lines.text: per facta exhibita est unica amicitia
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:100" n="6">per facta exhibita est unica amicitia</l>

lines.text: cum vesana meas torreret flamma medullas.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:100" n="7">cum vesana meas torreret flamma medullas.</l>

lines.text: sis felix, Caeli, sis in amore potens.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:100" n="8">sis felix, Caeli, sis in amore potens.</l>

lines.text: Multas per gentes et multa per aequora vectus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:101" n="1">Multas per gentes et multa per aequora vectus</l>

lines.text: advenio has miseras, frater, ad inferias,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:101" n="2">advenio has miseras, frater, ad inferias,</l>

lines.text: ut te postremo donarem munere mortis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:101" n="3">ut te postremo donarem munere mortis</l>

lines.text: et mutam nequiquam adloquerer cinerem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:101" n="4">et mutam nequiquam adloquerer cinerem,</l>

lines.text: quandoquidem fortuna mihi tete abstulit ipsum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:101" n="5">quandoquidem fortuna mihi tete abstulit ipsum,</l>

lines.text: heu miser indigne frater adempte mihi.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:101" n="6">heu miser indigne frater adempte mihi.</l>

lines.text: nunc tamen interea haec, prisco quae more parentum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:101" n="7">nunc tamen interea haec, prisco quae more parentum</l>

lines.text: tradita sunt tristi munere ad inferias,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:101" n="8">tradita sunt tristi munere ad inferias,</l>

lines.text: accipe fraterno multum manantia fletu
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:101" n="9">accipe fraterno multum manantia fletu</l>

lines.text: atque in perpetuum, frater, ave atque vale.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:101" n="10">atque in perpetuum, frater, ave atque vale.</l>

lines.text: Si quicquam tacito commissum est fido ab amico
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:102" n="1">Si quicquam tacito commissum est fido ab amico</l>

lines.text: cuius sit penitus nota fides animi,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:102" n="2">cuius sit penitus nota fides animi,</l>

lines.text: meque esse invenies illorum iure sacratum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:102" n="3">meque esse invenies illorum iure sacratum,</l>

lines.text: Corneli, et factum me esse puta Harpocratem.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:102" n="4">Corneli, et factum me esse puta Harpocratem.</l>

lines.text: Aut sodes mihi redde decem sestertia, Silo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:103" n="1">Aut sodes mihi redde decem sestertia, Silo,</l>

lines.text: deinde esto quamvis saevus et indomitus:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:103" n="2">deinde esto quamvis saevus et indomitus:</l>

lines.text: aut, si te nummi deIectant, desine quaeso
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:103" n="3">aut, si te nummi deIectant, desine quaeso</l>

lines.text: Leno esse atque idem saevus et indomitus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:103" n="4">Leno esse atque idem saevus et indomitus.</l>

lines.text: Credis me potuisse meae maledicere vitae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:104" n="1">Credis me potuisse meae maledicere vitae,</l>

lines.text: ambobus mihi quae carior est oculis?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:104" n="2">ambobus mihi quae carior est oculis?</l>

lines.text: non potui, nec, si possem, tam perdite amarem:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:104" n="3">non potui, nec, si possem, tam perdite amarem:</l>

lines.text: sed tu cum Tappone omnia monstra facis.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:104" n="4">sed tu cum Tappone omnia monstra facis.</l>

lines.text: Mentula conatur Pipleum scandere montem:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:105" n="1">Mentula conatur Pipleum scandere montem:</l>

lines.text: Musae furcillis praecipitem eiciunt.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:105" n="2">Musae furcillis praecipitem eiciunt.</l>

lines.text: Cum puero bello praeconem qui videt esse,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:106" n="1">Cum puero bello praeconem qui videt esse,</l>

lines.text: quid credat, nisi se vendere discupere?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:106" n="2">quid credat, nisi se vendere discupere?</l>

lines.text: Si cui quid cupido optantique obtigit unquam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:107" n="1">Si cui quid cupido optantique obtigit unquam</l>

lines.text: insperanti, hoc est gratum animo proprie.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:107" n="2">insperanti, hoc est gratum animo proprie.</l>

lines.text: quare hoc est gratum nobis quoque, carius auro,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:107" n="3">quare hoc est gratum nobis quoque, carius auro,</l>

lines.text: quod te restituis, Lesbia, mi cupido:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:107" n="4">quod te restituis, Lesbia, mi cupido:</l>

lines.text: restituis cupido atque insperanti, ipsa refers te
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:107" n="5">restituis cupido atque insperanti, ipsa refers te</l>

lines.text: nobis. o lucem candidiore nota!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:107" n="6">nobis. o lucem candidiore nota!</l>

lines.text: quis me uno vivit felicior, aut magis hac res
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:107" n="7">quis me uno vivit felicior, aut magis hac res</l>

lines.text: optandas vita dicere quis poterit?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:107" n="8">optandas vita dicere quis poterit?</l>

lines.text: Si, Comini, populi arbitrio tua cana senectus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:108" n="1">Si, Comini, populi arbitrio tua cana senectus</l>

lines.text: spurcata impuris moribus intereat,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:108" n="2">spurcata impuris moribus intereat,</l>

lines.text: non equidem dubito quin primum inimica bonorum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:108" n="3">non equidem dubito quin primum inimica bonorum</l>

lines.text: lingua exsecta avido sit data vulturio,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:108" n="4">lingua exsecta avido sit data vulturio,</l>

lines.text: effossos oculos voret atro gutture corvus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:108" n="5">effossos oculos voret atro gutture corvus,</l>

lines.text: intestina canes, cetera membra lupi.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:108" n="6">intestina canes, cetera membra lupi.</l>

lines.text: Iucundum, mea vita, mihi proponis amorem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:109" n="1">Iucundum, mea vita, mihi proponis amorem</l>

lines.text: hunc nostrum inter nos perpetuumque fore.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:109" n="2">hunc nostrum inter nos perpetuumque fore.</l>

lines.text: di magni, facite ut vere promittere possit
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:109" n="3">di magni, facite ut vere promittere possit</l>

lines.text: atque id sincere dicat et ex animo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:109" n="4">atque id sincere dicat et ex animo,</l>

lines.text: ut liceat nobis tota perducere vita
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:109" n="5">ut liceat nobis tota perducere vita</l>

lines.text: aeternum hoc sanctae foedus amicitiae.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:109" n="6">aeternum hoc sanctae foedus amicitiae.</l>

lines.text: Aufilena, bonae semper laudantur amicae:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:110" n="1">Aufilena, bonae semper laudantur amicae:</l>

lines.text: accipiunt pretium quod facere instituunt.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-lat2:110" n="2">accipiunt pretium quod facere instituunt.</l>

lines.text: tu, quod promisti mihi, quod mentita, inimica es;
