lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:42" n="23">An we would anywise our cause advance.</l>

lines.text: Restore (chaste, honest Maid!) our noting books!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:42" n="24"><q rend="double">Restore (chaste, honest Maid!) our noting books!</q></l>

lines.text: Hail, girl who neither nose of minim size
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:43" n="1">Hail, girl who neither nose of minim size</l>

lines.text: Owns, nor a pretty foot, nor jetty eyes,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:43" n="2">Owns, nor a pretty foot, nor jetty eyes,</l>

lines.text: Nor thin long fingers, nor mouth dry of slaver
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:43" n="3">Nor thin long fingers, nor mouth dry of slaver</l>

lines.text: Nor yet too graceful tongue of pleasant flavour,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:43" n="4">Nor yet too graceful tongue of pleasant flavour,</l>

lines.text: Leman to Formian that rake-a-hell.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:43" n="5"><placeName key="tgn,7003763">Leman</placeName> to Formian that rake-a-hell.</l>

lines.text: What, can the Province boast of thee as belle?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:43" n="6">What, can the Province boast of thee as belle?</l>

lines.text: Thee with my Lesbia durst it make compare?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:43" n="7">Thee with my Lesbia durst it make compare?</l>

lines.text: O Age insipid, of all humour bare!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:43" n="8">O Age insipid, of all humour bare!</l>

lines.text: O Farm our own, Sabine or Tiburtine,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="1">O Farm our own, <placeName key="tgn,7021127">Sabine</placeName> or Tiburtine,</l>

lines.text: (For style thee Tiburs Who have not at heart
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="2">(For style thee <q rend="double">Tiburs</q> Who have not at heart</l>

lines.text: To hurt Catullus, whereas all that have
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="3">To hurt Catullus, whereas all that have</l>

lines.text: Wage any Wager thou be Sabine classed)
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="4">Wage any Wager thou be <placeName key="tgn,7021127">Sabine</placeName> classed)</l>

lines.text: But whether Sabine or of Tiburs truer
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="5">But whether <placeName key="tgn,7021127">Sabine</placeName> or of Tiburs truer</l>

lines.text: To thy suburban Cottage fared I fain
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="6">To thy suburban Cottage fared I fain</l>

lines.text: And fro’ my bronchials drave that cursèd cough
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="7">And fro’ my bronchials drave that cursèd cough</l>

lines.text: Which not unmerited on me my maw,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="8">Which not unmerited on me my maw,</l>

lines.text: A-seeking sumptuous banquetings, bestowed.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="9">A-seeking sumptuous banquetings, bestowed.</l>

lines.text: For I requesting to be Sestius’ guest
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="10">For I requesting to be Sestius’ guest</l>

lines.text: Read against claimant Antius a speech,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="11">Read against claimant Antius a speech,</l>

lines.text: Full-filled with poisonous pestilential trash.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="12">Full-filled with poisonous pestilential trash.</l>

lines.text: Hence a grave frigid rheum and frequent cough
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="13">Hence a grave frigid rheum and frequent cough</l>

lines.text: Shook me till fled I to thy bosom, where
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="14">Shook me till fled I to thy bosom, where</l>

lines.text: Repose and nettle-broth healed all my ills.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="15">Repose and nettle-broth healed all my ills.</l>

lines.text: Wherefore recruited now best thanks I give
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="16">Wherefore recruited now best thanks I give</l>

lines.text: To thee for nowise punishing my sins:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="17">To thee for nowise punishing my sins:</l>

lines.text: Nor do I now object if noisome writs
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="18">Nor do I now object if noisome writs</l>

lines.text: Of Sestius hear I, but that cold and cough
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="19">Of Sestius hear I, but that cold and cough</l>

lines.text: And rheum may plague, not me, but Sestius’ self
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="20">And rheum may plague, not me, but Sestius’ self </l>

lines.text: Who asks me only his ill writs to read.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:44" n="21">Who asks me only his ill writs to read.</l>

lines.text: To Acmé quoth Septumius who his fere
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="1">To Acmé quoth Septumius who his fere </l>

lines.text: Held on his bosom—Acmé, mine! next year,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="2">Held on his bosom—<q rend="double">Acmé, mine! next year,</q> </l>

lines.text: Unless I love thee fondlier than before,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="3"><q rend="double; merge">Unless I love thee fondlier than before,</q></l>

lines.text: And with each twelve month love thee more and more,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="4"><q rend="double; merge">And with each twelve month love thee more and more,</q></l>

lines.text: As much as lover’s life can slay with yearning,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="5"><q rend="double; merge">As much as lover’s life can slay with yearning,</q></l>

lines.text: Alone in Lybia, or Hind’s clime a-burning,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="6"><q rend="double; merge">Alone in Lybia, or Hind’s clime a-burning,</q></l>

lines.text: Be mine to encounter Lion grisly-eyed!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="7"><q rend="double; merge">Be mine to encounter Lion grisly-eyed!</q></l>

lines.text: While he was speaking Love on leftward side
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="8">While he was speaking Love on leftward side</l>

lines.text: (As wont) approving sneeze from dextral sped.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="9">(As wont) approving sneeze from dextral sped.</l>

lines.text: But Acmé backwards gently bending head,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="10">But Acmé backwards gently bending head,</l>

lines.text: And the love-drunken eyes of her sweet boy
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="11">And the love-drunken eyes of her sweet boy</l>

lines.text: Kissing with yonder rosy mouth, My joy,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="12">Kissing with yonder rosy mouth, <q rend="double">My joy,</q></l>

lines.text: She murmured, my life-love Septumillus mine!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="13">She murmured, <q rend="double">my life-love Septumillus mine!</q></l>

lines.text: Unto one master’s hest let’s aye incline,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="14"><q rend="double; merge">Unto one master’s hest let’s aye incline,</q></l>

lines.text: As burns with fuller and with fiercer fire
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="15"><q rend="double; merge">As burns with fuller and with fiercer fire</q></l>

lines.text: In my soft marrow set, this love-desire!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="16"><q rend="double; merge">In my soft marrow set, this love-desire!</q></l>

lines.text: While she was speaking, Love from leftward side
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="17">While she was speaking, Love from leftward side</l>

lines.text: (As wont) with sneeze approving rightwards hied.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="18">(As wont) with sneeze approving rightwards hied.</l>

lines.text: Now with boon omens wafted on their way,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="19">Now with boon omens wafted on their way,</l>

lines.text: In mutual fondness, love and loved are they.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="20">In mutual fondness, love and loved are they.</l>

lines.text: Love-sick Septumius holds one Acmé’s love,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="21">Love-sick Septumius holds one Acmé’s love,</l>

lines.text: Of Syrias or either Britains high above,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="22">Of Syrias or either Britains high above,</l>

lines.text: Acmé to one Septumius full of faith
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="23">Acmé to one Septumius full of faith</l>

lines.text: Her love and love-liesse surrendereth.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="24">Her love and love-liesse surrendereth.</l>

lines.text: Who e’er saw mortals happier than these two?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="25">Who e’er saw mortals happier than these two?</l>

lines.text: Who e’er a better omened Venus knew?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:45" n="26">Who e’er a better omened <persName><surname>Venus</surname></persName> knew?</l>

lines.text: Now Spring his cooly mildness brings us back,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:46" n="1">Now Spring his cooly mildness brings us back,</l>

lines.text: Now th’ equinoctial heaven’s rage and wrack
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:46" n="2">Now th’ equinoctial heaven’s rage and wrack</l>

lines.text: Hushes at hest of Zephyr’s bonny breeze.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:46" n="3">Hushes at hest of Zephyr’s bonny breeze.</l>

lines.text: Far left (Catullus!) be the Phrygian leas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:46" n="4">Far left (Catullus!) be the Phrygian leas</l>

lines.text: And summery Nicaea’s fertile downs:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:46" n="5">And summery <placeName key="tgn,7008773">Nicaea</placeName>’s fertile downs:</l>

lines.text: Fly we to Asia’s fame-illumined towns.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:46" n="6">Fly we to <placeName key="tgn,2097781">Asia</placeName>’s fame-illumined towns.</l>

lines.text: Now lust my fluttering thoughts for wayfare long,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:46" n="7">Now lust my fluttering thoughts for wayfare long,</l>

lines.text: Now my glad eager feet grow steady, strong.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:46" n="8">Now my glad eager feet grow steady, strong.</l>

lines.text: O fare ye well, my comrades, pleasant throng,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:46" n="9">O fare ye well, my comrades, pleasant throng,</l>

lines.text: Ye who together far from homesteads flying,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:46" n="10">Ye who together far from homesteads flying,</l>

lines.text: By many various ways come homewards hieing.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:46" n="11">By many various ways come homewards hieing.</l>

lines.text: Porcius and Socration, pair sinister
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:47" n="1">Porcius and Socration, pair sinister</l>

lines.text: Of Piso, scabs and starvelings of the world,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:47" n="2">Of <placeName key="tgn,2040810">Piso</placeName>, scabs and starvelings of the world,</l>

lines.text: You to Fabúllus and my Verianiólus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:47" n="3">You to Fabúllus and my Verianiólus,</l>

lines.text: Hath dared yon snipt Priapus to prefer?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:47" n="4">Hath dared yon snipt Priapus to prefer?</l>

lines.text: Upon rich banquets sumptuously spread
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:47" n="5">Upon rich banquets sumptuously spread</l>

lines.text: Still gorge you daily while my comrades must
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:47" n="6">Still gorge you daily while my comrades must </l>

lines.text: Go seek invitals where the three roads fork?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:47" n="7">Go seek invitals where the three roads fork?</l>

lines.text: Those honied eyes of thine (Juventius!)
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:48" n="1">Those honied eyes of thine (Juventius!)</l>

lines.text: If any suffer me sans stint to buss,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:48" n="2">If any suffer me sans stint to buss,</l>

lines.text: I’d kiss of kisses hundred thousands three,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:48" n="3">I’d kiss of kisses hundred thousands three,</l>

lines.text: Nor ever deem I’d reach satiety,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:48" n="4">Nor ever deem I’d reach satiety,</l>

lines.text: Not albe denser than dried wheat-ears show
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:48" n="5">Not albe denser than dried wheat-ears show</l>

lines.text: The kissing harvests our embraces grow.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:48" n="6">The kissing harvests our embraces grow.</l>

lines.text: Most eloquent ’mid race of Romulus>
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:49" n="1">Most eloquent ’mid race of <persName><surname>Romulus</surname></persName>></l>

lines.text: That is or ever was (Marc Tullius!)
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:49" n="2">That is or ever was (Marc Tullius!)</l>

lines.text: Or in the coming years the light shall see,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:49" n="3">Or in the coming years the light shall see,</l>

lines.text: His thanks, the warmest, offers unto thee
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:49" n="4">His thanks, the warmest, offers unto thee</l>

lines.text: Catullus, poet sorriest that be,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:49" n="5">Catullus, poet sorriest that be, </l>

lines.text: And by such measure poet sorriest,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:49" n="6">And by such measure poet sorriest, </l>

lines.text: As thou of pleaders art the bestest best.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:49" n="7">As thou of pleaders art the bestest best.</l>

lines.text: Idly (Licinius!) we our yesterday,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="1">Idly (Licinius!) we our yesterday,</l>

lines.text: Played with my tablets much as pleased us play,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="2">Played with my tablets much as pleased us play,</l>

lines.text: In mode becoming souls of dainty strain.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="3">In mode becoming souls of dainty strain.</l>

lines.text: Inditing verses either of us twain
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="4">Inditing verses either of us twain</l>

lines.text: Now in one measure then in other line
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="5">Now in one measure then in other line</l>

lines.text: We rang the changes amid wit and wine.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="6">We rang the changes amid wit and wine.</l>

lines.text: Then fared I homewards by thy fun so fired
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="7">Then fared I homewards by thy fun so fired</l>

lines.text: And by thy jests (Licinius!) so inspired,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="8">And by thy jests (Licinius!) so inspired,</l>

lines.text: Nor food my hapless appetite availed
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="9">Nor food my hapless appetite availed</l>

lines.text: Nor sleep in quiet rest my eyelids veiled,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="10">Nor sleep in quiet rest my eyelids veiled,</l>

lines.text: But o’er the bedstead wild in furious plight
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="11">But o’er the bedstead wild in furious plight</l>

lines.text: I tossed a-longing to behold the light,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="12">I tossed a-longing to behold the light,</l>

lines.text: So I might talk wi’ thee, and be wi’ thee.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="13">So I might talk wi’ thee, and be wi’ thee.</l>

lines.text: But when these wearied limbs from labour free
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="14">But when these wearied limbs from labour free</l>

lines.text: Were on my couchlet strewn half-dead to lie,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="15">Were on my couchlet strewn half-dead to lie,</l>

lines.text: For thee (sweet wag!) this poem for thee wrote I,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="16">For thee (sweet wag!) this poem for thee wrote I,</l>

lines.text: Whereby thou mete and weet my cark and care.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="17">Whereby thou mete and weet my cark and care.</l>

lines.text: Now be not over-bold, nor this our prayer
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="18">Now be not over-bold, nor this our prayer</l>

lines.text: Outspit thou (apple of mine eyes !): we pray
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="19">Outspit thou (apple of mine eyes !): we pray</l>

lines.text: Lest doom thee Nemesis hard pain repay:—
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="20">Lest doom thee Nemesis hard pain repay:— </l>

lines.text: She’s a dire Goddess, ’ware thou cross her way.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:50" n="21">She’s a dire Goddess, ’ware thou cross her way.</l>

lines.text: Peer of a God meseemeth he,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:51" n="1">Peer of a God meseemeth he, </l>

lines.text: Nay passing Gods (and that can be!)
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:51" n="2">Nay passing Gods (and that can be!) </l>

lines.text: Who all the while sits facing thee
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:51" n="3">Who all the while sits facing thee</l>

lines.text: Sees thee and hears
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:51" n="4">Sees thee and hears</l>

lines.text: Thy low sweet laughs which (ah me!) daze
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:51" n="5">Thy low sweet laughs which (ah me!) daze</l>

lines.text: Mine every sense, and as I gaze
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:51" n="6">Mine every sense, and as I gaze </l>

lines.text: Upon thee (Lesbia!) o’er me strays
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:51" n="7">Upon thee (Lesbia!) o’er me strays</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:51" n="8"><gap reason="lost" rend=" * * * * "/></l>

lines.text: My tongue is dulled, my limbs adown
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:51" n="9">My tongue is dulled, my limbs adown</l>

lines.text: Flows subtle flame; with sound its own
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:51" n="10">Flows subtle flame; with sound its own </l>

lines.text: Rings either ear, and o’er are strown
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:51" n="11">Rings either ear, and o’er are strown</l>

lines.text: Mine eyes with night.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:51" n="12">Mine eyes with night.</l>

lines.text: Ease has thy lot, Catullus, crost,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:51" n="13">Ease has thy lot, Catullus, crost,</l>

lines.text: Ease gladdens thee at heaviest cost,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:51" n="14">Ease gladdens thee at heaviest cost,</l>

lines.text: Ease killed the Kings ere this and lost
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:51" n="15">Ease killed the Kings ere this and lost </l>

lines.text: the tallest towns.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:51" n="16">the tallest towns.</l>

lines.text: What is’t, Catullus? Why delay to out die?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:52" n="1">What is’t, Catullus? Why delay to out die?</l>

lines.text: That Wen hight Nonius sits in curule chair,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:52" n="2">That Wen hight Nonius sits in curule chair,</l>

lines.text: For Consulship Vatinius false doth swear;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:52" n="3">For Consulship Vatinius false doth swear;</l>

lines.text: What is’t, Catullus? Why delay to out die?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:52" n="4">What is’t, Catullus? Why delay to out die?</l>

lines.text: I laughed at one ’mid Forum-crowd unknown
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:53" n="1">I laughed at one ’mid Forum-crowd unknown</l>

lines.text: Who, when Vatinius’ crimes in wondrous way
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:53" n="2">Who, when Vatinius’ crimes in wondrous way</l>

lines.text: Had by my Calvus been explained, exposed,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:53" n="3">Had by my Calvus been explained, exposed,</l>

lines.text: His hand upraising high admiring cried
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:53" n="4">His hand upraising high admiring cried</l>

lines.text: Great Gods! the loquent little Doodle-diddle!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:53" n="5"><q rend="double">Great Gods! the loquent little Doodle-diddle!</q> </l>

lines.text: The head of Otho, puniest of pates
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:54" n="1">The head of <placeName key="tgn,2561794">Otho</placeName>, puniest of pates</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:54" n="1a"><gap reason="lost" rend=" * * * * "/></l>

lines.text: The rustic half-washt shanks of Nerius
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:54" n="2">The rustic half-washt shanks of Nerius </l>

lines.text: And Libo’s subtle silent fizzling-farts.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:54" n="3">And Libo’s subtle silent fizzling-farts.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:54" n="3a"><gap reason="lost" rend=" * * * * "/></l>

lines.text: I wish that leastwise these should breed disgust
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:54" n="4">I wish that leastwise these should breed disgust </l>

lines.text: In thee and old Fuficius, rogue twice-cookt.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:54" n="5">In thee and old Fuficius, rogue twice-cookt.</l>

lines.text: Again at these mine innocent iamb-lines
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:54" n="6">Again at these mine innocent iamb-lines </l>

lines.text: Wi’ wrath be wrothest; unique Emperor!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:54" n="7">Wi’ wrath be wrothest; unique Emperor!</l>

lines.text: We pray, an’ haply irk it not when prayed,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="1">We pray, an’ haply irk it not when prayed,</l>

lines.text: Show us where shadowed hidest thou in shade!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="2">Show us where shadowed hidest thou in shade!</l>

lines.text: Thee throughout Campus Minor sought we all,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="3">Thee throughout Campus Minor sought we all,</l>

lines.text: Thee in the Circus, thee in each bookstall,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="4">Thee in the Circus, thee in each bookstall,</l>

lines.text: Thee in Almighty Jove’s fane consecrate.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="5">Thee in Almighty Jove’s fane consecrate.</l>

lines.text: Nor less in promenade titled from The Great
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="6">Nor less in promenade titled from The Great</l>

lines.text: (Friend!) I accosted each and every quean,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="7">(Friend!) I accosted each and every quean,</l>

lines.text: But mostly madams showing mien serene,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="8">But mostly madams showing mien serene,</l>

lines.text: For thee I pestered all with many pleas—
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="9">For thee I pestered all with many pleas—</l>

lines.text: Give me Camérius, wanton baggages!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="10"><q rend="double">Give me Camérius, wanton baggages!</q></l>

lines.text: Till answered certain one a-baring breasts
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="11">Till answered certain one a-baring breasts</l>

lines.text: Lo, ’twixt these rosy paps he haply rests!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="12"><q rend="double">Lo, ’twixt these rosy paps he haply rests!</q></l>

lines.text: But now to find thee were Herculean feat.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="13">But now to find thee were Herculean feat.</l>

lines.text: Not if I feigned me that guard of Crete,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="23">Not if I feigned me that guard of <placeName key="tgn,7012056">Crete</placeName>,</l>

lines.text: Not if with Pegasèan wing I sped,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="24">Not if with Pegasèan wing I sped,</l>

lines.text: Or Ladas I or Perseus plumiped,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="25">Or Ladas I or Perseus plumiped,</l>

lines.text: Or Rhesus borne in swifty car snow-white:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="26">Or Rhesus borne in swifty car snow-white:</l>

lines.text: Add the twain foot-bewing’d and fast of flight,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="27">Add the twain foot-bewing’d and fast of flight,</l>

lines.text: And of the cursive’ winds require the blow:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="28">And of the cursive’ winds require the blow:</l>

lines.text: All these (Camérius!) couldst on me bestow.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="29">All these (Camérius!) couldst on me bestow.</l>

lines.text: Tho’ were I wearied to each marrow bone
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="30">Tho’ were I wearied to each marrow bone</l>

lines.text: And by many o’ languors clean forgone
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="31">And by many o’ languors clean forgone</l>

lines.text: Yet I to seek thee (friend!) would still assay.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="32">Yet I to seek thee (friend!) would still assay.</l>

lines.text: In such proud lodging (friend) wouldst self denay?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="14">In such proud lodging (friend) wouldst self denay?</l>

lines.text: Tell us where haply dwell’st thou, speak outright,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="15">Tell us where haply dwell’st thou, speak outright,</l>

lines.text: Be bold and risk it, trusting truth to light,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="16">Be bold and risk it, trusting truth to light,</l>

lines.text: Say do these milk-white girls thy Steps detain?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="17">Say do these milk-white girls thy Steps detain?</l>

lines.text: If aye in tight-sealed lips thy tongue remain,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="18">If aye in tight-sealed lips thy tongue remain,</l>

lines.text: All Amor’s fruitage thou shalt cast away:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="19">All Amor’s fruitage thou shalt cast away:</l>

lines.text: Verbose is Venus, loving verbal play!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="20">Verbose is Venus, loving verbal play!</l>

lines.text: But, an it please thee, padlockt palate bear,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="21">But, an it please thee, padlockt palate bear,</l>

lines.text: So in your friendship I have partner-share.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:55" n="22">So in your friendship I have partner-share.</l>

head: TO CATO, DESCRIBING A BLACK JOKER.

lines.text: O risible matter (Cato!) and jocose,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:56" n="1">O risible matter (<persName><surname>Cato</surname></persName>!) and jocose,</l>

lines.text: Digne of thy hearing, of thy sneering digne.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:56" n="2">Digne of thy hearing, of thy sneering digne.</l>

lines.text: Laugh (Cato!) an thou love Catullus thine;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:56" n="3">Laugh (Cato!) an thou love Catullus thine;</l>

lines.text: The thing is risible, nay, too jocose.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:56" n="4">The thing is risible, nay, too jocose.</l>

lines.text: Erstwhile I came upon a lad who a lass
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:56" n="5">Erstwhile I came upon a lad who a lass</l>

lines.text: Was . . . and (so please it Dion!) I
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:56" n="6">Was <gap reason="ellipsis" rend=" . . ."/> and (so please it Dion!) I</l>

lines.text: Pierced him with stiffest staff and did him die.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:56" n="7">Pierced him with stiffest staff and did him die.</l>

lines.text: Right well are paired these Cinaedes sans shame
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:57" n="1">Right well are paired these Cinaedes sans shame</l>

lines.text: Mamurra and Caesar, both of pathic fame.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:57" n="2">Mamurra and Caesar, both of pathic fame.</l>

lines.text: No wonder!Both are fouled with foulest blight,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:57" n="3">No wonder!Both are fouled with foulest blight,</l>

lines.text: One urban being, Formian t’other wight,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:57" n="4">One urban being, Formian t’other wight,</l>

lines.text: And deeply printed with indelible stain:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:57" n="5">And deeply printed with indelible stain:</l>

lines.text: Morbose is either, and the twin-like twain
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:57" n="6">Morbose is either, and the twin-like twain</l>

lines.text: Share single Couchlet; peers in shallow lore,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:57" n="7">Share single Couchlet; peers in shallow lore,</l>

lines.text: Nor this nor that for lechery hungers more,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:57" n="8">Nor this nor that for lechery hungers more,</l>

lines.text: As rival wenchers who the maidens claim
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:57" n="9">As rival wenchers who the maidens claim</l>

lines.text: Right well are paired these Cinaedes sans shame.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:57" n="10">Right well are paired these Cinaedes sans shame. </l>

lines.text: Caelius! That Lesbia of ours, that Lesbia,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:58" n="1">Caelius! That <persName><surname>Lesbia</surname></persName> of ours, that <persName><surname>Lesbia</surname></persName>,</l>

lines.text: That only Lesbia by Catullus loved,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:58" n="2">That only Lesbia by Catullus loved,</l>

lines.text: Than self, far fondlier, than all his friends,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:58" n="3">Than self, far fondlier, than all his friends,</l>

lines.text: She now Where four roads fork, and wind the wynds
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:58" n="4">She now Where four roads fork, and wind the wynds</l>

lines.text: Husks the high-minded scions Remus-sprung.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:58" n="5">Husks the high-minded scions Remus-sprung.</l>

lines.text: Rufa the Bolognese drains Rufule dry,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:59" n="1">Rufa the Bolognese drains Rufule dry,</l>

lines.text: (Wife to Menenius) she ’mid tombs you’ll spy,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:59" n="2">(Wife to Menenius) she ’mid tombs you’ll spy,</l>

lines.text: The same a-snatching supper from the pyre
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:59" n="3">The same a-snatching supper from the pyre</l>

lines.text: Following the bread-loaves rolling forth the fire
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:59" n="4">Following the bread-loaves rolling forth the fire</l>

lines.text: Till frapped by half-shaved body-burner’s ire.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:59" n="5">Till frapped by half-shaved body-burner’s ire.</l>

lines.text: Bare thee some lioness wild in Lybian wold?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:60" n="1">Bare thee some lioness wild in Lybian wold?</l>

lines.text: Or Scylla barking from low’st inguinal fold?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:60" n="2">Or Scylla barking from low’st inguinal fold?</l>

lines.text: With so black spirit, of so dure a mould,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:60" n="3">With so black spirit, of so dure a mould,</l>

lines.text: E’en voice of suppliant must thou disregard
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:60" n="4">E’en voice of suppliant must thou disregard</l>

lines.text: In latest circumstance ah, heart o’er hard?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:60" n="5">In latest circumstance ah, heart o’er hard?</l>

lines.text: Of Helicon-hill, O Thou that be
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="1">Of Helicon-hill, O Thou that be</l>

lines.text: Haunter, Urania’s progeny,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="2">Haunter, <persName><surname>Urania</surname></persName>’s progeny,</l>

lines.text: Who hurriest soft virginity
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="3">Who hurriest soft virginity</l>

lines.text: To man, O Hymenaeus Hymen,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="4">To man, O Hymenaeus Hymen,</l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymenaeus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="5">O Hymen Hymenaeus.</l>

lines.text: About thy temples bind the bloom,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="6">About thy temples bind the bloom,</l>

lines.text: Of Marjoram flow’ret scented sweet;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="7">Of Marjoram flow’ret scented sweet;</l>

lines.text: Take flamey veil: glad hither come
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="8">Take flamey veil: glad hither come</l>

lines.text: Come hither borne by snow-hue’d feet
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="9">Come hither borne by snow-hue’d feet</l>

lines.text: Wearing the saffron’d sock.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="10">Wearing the saffron’d sock.</l>

lines.text: And, roused by day of joyful cheer,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="11">And, roused by day of joyful cheer,</l>

lines.text: Carolling nuptial lays and chaunts
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="12">Carolling nuptial lays and chaunts</l>

lines.text: With voice as silver ringing clear,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="13">With voice as silver ringing clear,</l>

lines.text: Beat ground with feet, while brandisht flaunts
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="14">Beat ground with feet, while brandisht flaunts</l>

lines.text: Thy hand the piney torch.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="15">Thy hand the piney torch.</l>

lines.text: For Vinia comes by Manlius woo’d,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="16">For Vinia comes by <persName><surname>Manlius</surname></persName> woo’d,</l>

lines.text: As Venus on th’ Idalian crest,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="17">As <persName><surname>Venus</surname></persName> on th’ Idalian crest,</l>

lines.text: Before the Phrygian judge she stood
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="18">Before the Phrygian judge she stood</l>

lines.text: And now with blessed omens blest,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="19">And now with blessed omens blest,</l>

lines.text: The maid is here to wed.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="20">The maid is here to wed.</l>

lines.text: A maiden shining bright of blee,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="21">A maiden shining bright of blee,</l>

lines.text: As Myrtle branchlet Asia bred,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="22">As Myrtle branchlet <placeName key="tgn,2097781">Asia</placeName> bred,</l>

lines.text: Which Hamadryad deity
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="23">Which Hamadryad deity</l>

lines.text: As toy for joyance aye befed
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="24">As toy for joyance aye befed</l>

lines.text: With humour of the dew.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="25">With humour of the dew.</l>

lines.text: Then hither come thou, hieing lief,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="26">Then hither come thou, hieing lief,</l>

lines.text: Awhile to leave th’ Aonian cave,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="27">Awhile to leave th’ Aonian cave,</l>

lines.text: Where ’neath the rocky Thespian cliff
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="28">Where ’neath the rocky Thespian cliff</l>

lines.text: Nymph Aganippe loves to lave
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="29">Nymph Aganippe loves to lave</l>

lines.text: In cooly waves outpoured.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="30">In cooly waves outpoured.</l>

lines.text: And call the house-bride, homewards bring
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="31">And call the house-bride, homewards bring</l>

lines.text: Maid yearning for new married fere,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="32">Maid yearning for new married fere,</l>

lines.text: Her mind with fondness manacling,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="33">Her mind with fondness manacling,</l>

lines.text: As the tough ivy here and there
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="34">As the tough ivy here and there</l>

lines.text: Errant the tree enwinds.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="35">Errant the tree enwinds.</l>

lines.text: And likewise ye, clean virginal
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="36">And likewise ye, clean virginal</l>

lines.text: Maidens, to whom shall haps befall
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="37">Maidens, to whom shall haps befall</l>

lines.text: Like day, in measure join ye all
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="38">Like day, in measure join ye all</l>

lines.text: Singing, O Hymenaeus Hymen,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="39">Singing, O Hymenaeus Hymen,</l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymenaeus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="40">O Hymen Hymenaeus.</l>

lines.text: That with more will-full will a-hearing
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="41">That with more will-full will a-hearing</l>

lines.text: The call to office due, he would
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="42">The call to office due, he would</l>

lines.text: Turn footsteps hither, here appearing,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="43">Turn footsteps hither, here appearing,</l>

lines.text: Guide to good Venus, and the good
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="44">Guide to good <persName><surname>Venus</surname></persName>, and the good</l>

lines.text: Lover conjoining strait.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="45">Lover conjoining strait.</l>

lines.text: What God than other Godheads more
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="46">What God than other Godheads more</l>

lines.text: Must love-sick wights for aid implore?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="47">Must love-sick wights for aid implore?</l>

lines.text: Whose Godhead foremost shall adore
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="48">Whose Godhead foremost shall adore</l>

lines.text: Mankind? O Hymenaeus Hymen,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="49">Mankind? O Hymenaeus Hymen,</l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymenaeus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="50">O Hymen Hymenaeus.</l>

lines.text: Thee for his own the trembling sire
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="51">Thee for his own the trembling sire</l>

lines.text: Invokes, thee Virgins ever sue
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="52">Invokes, thee Virgins ever sue</l>

lines.text: Who laps of zone to loose aspire,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="53">Who laps of zone to loose aspire,</l>

lines.text: And thee the bashful bridegrooms woo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="54">And thee the bashful bridegrooms woo</l>

lines.text: With ears that long to hear.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="55">With ears that long to hear.</l>

lines.text: Thou to the hand of love-fierce swain
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="56">Thou to the hand of love-fierce swain</l>

lines.text: Deliverest maiden fair and fain,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="57">Deliverest maiden fair and fain,</l>

lines.text: From mother’s fondling bosom ta’en
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="58">From mother’s fondling bosom ta’en</l>

lines.text: Perforce, O Hymenaeus Hymen
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="59">Perforce, O Hymenaeus Hymen</l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymenaeus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="60">O Hymen Hymenaeus.</l>

lines.text: Thou lacking, Venus ne’er avails—
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="61">Thou lacking, <persName><surname>Venus</surname></persName> ne’er avails—</l>

lines.text: While Fame approves for honesty—
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="62">While Fame approves for honesty—</l>

lines.text: Love-joys to lavish: ne’er she fails
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="63">Love-joys to lavish: ne’er she fails</l>

lines.text: Thou willing:—with such Deity
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="64">Thou willing:—with such Deity</l>

lines.text: Whoe’er shall dare compare?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="65">Whoe’er shall dare compare?</l>

lines.text: Thou wanting, never son and heir
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="66">Thou wanting, never son and heir</l>

lines.text: The Hearth can bear, nor parents be
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="67">The Hearth can bear, nor parents be</l>

lines.text: By issue girt, yet can it bear,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="68">By issue girt, yet can it bear,</l>

lines.text: Thou willing:—with such Deity,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="69">Thou willing:—with such Deity,</l>

lines.text: Whoe’er shall dare compare?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="70">Whoe’er shall dare compare?</l>

lines.text: An lack a land thy sacring rite,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="71">An lack a land thy sacring rite,</l>

lines.text: The perfect rule we ne’er shall see
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="72">The perfect rule we ne’er shall see</l>

lines.text: Reach Earth’s far bourne; yet such we sight,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="73">Reach Earth’s far bourne; yet such we sight,</l>

lines.text: Thou willing:—with such Deity
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="74">Thou willing:—with such Deity</l>

lines.text: Whoe’er shall dare compare?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="75">Whoe’er shall dare compare?</l>

lines.text: Your folds ye gateways wide-ope swing!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="76">Your folds ye gateways wide-ope swing!</l>

lines.text: The maiden comes.Seest not the sheen
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="77">The maiden comes.Seest not the sheen</l>

lines.text: Of links their splendent tresses fling?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="78">Of links their splendent tresses fling?</l>

lines.text: Let shame retard the modest mien.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="83"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_79"/>Let shame retard the modest mien.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="79"><gap reason="lost" rend=" * * * "/></l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="80"><gap reason="lost" rend=" * * * "/></l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="81"><gap reason="lost" rend=" * * * "/></l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="82"><gap reason="lost" rend=" * * * "/></l>

lines.text: Who more she hears us weeps the more,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="84"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_80"/>Who more she hears us weeps the more,</l>

lines.text: That needs she must advance.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="85"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_81"/>That needs she must advance.</l>

lines.text: Cease raining tear-drops! not for thee,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="86">Cease raining tear-drops! not for thee,</l>

lines.text: Aurunculeia, risk we deem,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="87">Aurunculeia, risk we deem,</l>

lines.text: That fairer femininety
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="88">That fairer femininety</l>

lines.text: Clear day outdawned from Ocean stream
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="89"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_85"/>Clear day outdawned from Ocean stream</l>

lines.text: Shall ever more behold.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="90">Shall ever more behold.</l>

lines.text: Such in the many-tinted bower
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="91">Such in the many-tinted bower</l>

lines.text: Of rich man’s garden passing gay
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="92">Of rich man’s garden passing gay</l>

lines.text: Upstands the hyacinthine flower.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="93">Upstands the hyacinthine flower.</l>

lines.text: But thou delayest, wanes the day:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="94"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_90"/>But thou delayest, wanes the day:</l>

lines.text: “Prithee, come forth new Bride.”
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="95">“Prithee, come forth new Bride.”</l>

lines.text: Prithee, come forth new Bride! methinks,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="96">Prithee, come forth new Bride! methinks,</l>

lines.text: Drawing in sight, the talk we hold
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="97">Drawing in sight, the talk we hold</l>

lines.text: Thou haply hearest.See the Links!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="98">Thou haply hearest.See the Links!</l>

lines.text: How shake their locks begilt with gold:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="99"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_95"/>How shake their locks begilt with gold:</l>

lines.text: Prithee, new Bride come forth.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="100">Prithee, new Bride come forth.</l>

lines.text: Not lightly given thy mate to ill
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="101">Not lightly given thy mate to ill</l>

lines.text: Joys and adulterous delights
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="102">Joys and adulterous delights</l>

lines.text: Foul fleshly pleasures seeking still
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="103">Foul fleshly pleasures seeking still</l>

lines.text: Shall ever choose he lie o’ nights
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="104"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_100"/>Shall ever choose he lie o’ nights</l>

lines.text: Far from thy tender paps.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="105">Far from thy tender paps.</l>

lines.text: But as with pliant shoots the vine
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="106">But as with pliant shoots the vine</l>

lines.text: Round nearest tree-trunk winds her way,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="107">Round nearest tree-trunk winds her way,</l>

lines.text: He shall be ever twined in thine
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="108">He shall be ever twined in thine</l>

lines.text: Embraces:— yet, lo! wanes the day:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="109"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_105"/>Embraces:— yet, lo! wanes the day:</l>

lines.text: Prithee, come forth new Bride!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="110">Prithee, come forth new Bride!</l>

lines.text: Couchlet which to me and all
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="111">Couchlet which to me and all</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="112"><gap reason="lost" rend=" * * * "/></l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="113"><gap reason="lost" rend=" * * * "/></l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="114"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_110"/><gap reason="lost" rend=" * * * "/></l>

lines.text: With bright white bedstead foot.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="115">With bright white bedstead foot.</l>

lines.text: What joys the lord of thee betide!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="116">What joys the lord of thee betide!</l>

lines.text: What love-liesse on vaguing way
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="117">What love-liesse on vaguing way</l>

lines.text: O’ nights! What sweets in morning tide
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="118">O’ nights! What sweets in morning tide</l>

lines.text: For thee be stored! Yet wanes the day:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="119"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_115"/>For thee be stored! Yet wanes the day:</l>

lines.text: Prithee, come forth fresh Bride!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="120">Prithee, come forth fresh Bride!</l>

lines.text: Your lighted links, O boys, wave high:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="121">Your lighted links, O boys, wave high:</l>

lines.text: I see the flamey veil draw nigh:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="122">I see the flamey veil draw nigh:</l>

lines.text: Hie, sing in merry mode and cry
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="123">Hie, sing in merry mode and cry</l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymenaeus io,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="124"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_120"/><q rend="double">O Hymen Hymenaeus io,</q></l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymenaeus!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="125"><q rend="double; merge">O Hymen Hymenaeus!</q></l>

lines.text: Lest longer mute tongue stays that joys
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="126">Lest longer mute tongue stays that joys</l>

lines.text: In festal jest, from Fescennine,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="127">In festal jest, from Fescennine,</l>

lines.text: Nor yet denay their nuts to boys,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="128">Nor yet denay their nuts to boys,</l>

lines.text: He-Concubine! who learns in fine
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="129"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_125"/>He-Concubine! who learns in fine</l>

lines.text: His lordling’s love is fled.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="130">His lordling’s love is fled.</l>

lines.text: Throw nuts to boys thou idle all
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="131">Throw nuts to boys thou idle all</l>

lines.text: He-Concubine! wast fain full long
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="132">He-Concubine! wast fain full long</l>

lines.text: With nuts to play: now pleased as thrall
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="133">With nuts to play: now pleased as thrall</l>

lines.text: Be thou to swell Talasios’ throng:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="134"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_130"/>Be thou to swell Talasios’ throng:</l>

lines.text: He-Concubine throw nuts.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="135">He-Concubine throw nuts.</l>

lines.text: Wont thou at peasant-girls to jape
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="136">Wont thou at peasant-girls to jape</l>

lines.text: He-whore! Thy Lord’s delight the while:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="137">He-whore! Thy Lord’s delight the while:</l>

lines.text: Now shall hair-curling chattel scrape
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="138">Now shall hair-curling chattel scrape</l>

lines.text: Thy cheeks: poor wretch, ah! poor and vile:—
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="139"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_135"/>Thy cheeks: poor wretch, ah! poor and vile:—</l>

lines.text: He-Concubine, throw nuts.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="140">He-Concubine, throw nuts.</l>

lines.text: ’Tis said from smooth-faced ingle train
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="141">’Tis said from smooth-faced ingle train</l>

lines.text: (Anointed bridegroom!) hardly fain
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="142">(Anointed bridegroom!) hardly fain</l>

lines.text: Hast e’er refrained; now do refrain!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="143">Hast e’er refrained; now do refrain!</l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymenaeus io,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="144"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_140"/>O Hymen Hymenaeus io,</l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymenaeus!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="145">O Hymen Hymenaeus!</l>

lines.text: We know that naught save licit rites
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="146">We know that naught save licit rites</l>

lines.text: Be known to thee, but wedded wights
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="147">Be known to thee, but wedded wights</l>

lines.text: No more deem lawful such delights.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="148">No more deem lawful such delights.</l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymenaeus io,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="149"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_145"/>O Hymen Hymenaeus io,</l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymenaeus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="150">O Hymen Hymenaeus.</l>

lines.text: Thou too, O Bride, whatever dare
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="151">Thou too, O Bride, whatever dare</l>

lines.text: Thy groom, of coy rebuff beware,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="152">Thy groom, of coy rebuff beware,</l>

lines.text: Lest he to find elsewhither fare.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="153">Lest he to find elsewhither fare.</l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymenaeus io,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="154"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_150"/>O Hymen Hymenaeus io,</l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymenaeus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="155">O Hymen Hymenaeus.</l>

lines.text: Lo! here the house of high degree
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="156">Lo! here the house of high degree</l>

lines.text: Thy husband’s puissant home to be,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="157">Thy husband’s puissant home to be,</l>

lines.text: Which ever shall obey thy gree.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="158">Which ever shall obey thy gree.</l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymenaeus io,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="159"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_155"/>O Hymen Hymenaeus io,</l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymenaeus!
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="160">O Hymen Hymenaeus!</l>

lines.text: Till Time betide when eld the hoar
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="161">Till Time betide when eld the hoar</l>

lines.text: Thy head and temples trembling o’er
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="162">Thy head and temples trembling o’er</l>

lines.text: Make nod to all things evermore.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="163">Make nod to all things evermore.</l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymenaeus io,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="164"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_160"/>O Hymen Hymenaeus io,</l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymenaeus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="165">O Hymen Hymenaeus.</l>

lines.text: O’erstep with omen meetest meet
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="166">O’erstep with omen meetest meet</l>

lines.text: The threshold-stone thy golden feet
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="167">The threshold-stone thy golden feet</l>

lines.text: Up, past the polisht panels fleet.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="168">Up, past the polisht panels fleet.</l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymenaeus io,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="169"><milestone unit="throughline" n="throughline_165"/>O Hymen Hymenaeus io,</l>

lines.text: O Hymen Hymerneus.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:base="urn:cts:latinLit:phi0472.phi001.perseus-eng3:61" n="170">O Hymen Hymerneus.</l>

lines.text: Within bestrewn thy bridegroom see
